operations.description:
Initiate a password reset process for users who have forgotten their passwords. This operation sends a secure password reset link or token to the user's registered email address.

The system validates that the provided email address exists in the database and corresponds to an active user account. If valid, it generates a time-limited, cryptographically secure reset token and sends it via email. The token is designed to expire after a configurable time period (typically 1-4 hours) to maintain security.

Security measures include rate limiting to prevent abuse, email validation, token generation with sufficient entropy, and logging of reset attempts for audit purposes. The operation does not reveal whether the email exists to prevent user enumeration attacks.

Related operations: Password change (PUT /auth/password/change), User login (POST /auth/login).

The new password must meet security requirements (minimum length, complexity requirements). Upon successful validation, the password is updated and the reset token is immediately invalidated to prevent reuse.

Security considerations include token validation with time expiration checking, password strength requirements enforcement, immediate token invalidation after use, and comprehensive audit logging of the password change event. The operation also triggers any related security measures like sending confirmation emails.

This operation requires the reset token to be included in the request body along with the new password. The token is typically obtained from the password reset email sent by the reset request operation.

IShoppingMallCustomer.ILogin.description:
Customer authentication login request enabling secure marketplace access through email and password validation.

This DTO facilitates customer authentication by collecting essential credentials and session context information necessary for secure token generation and multi-device session management. The authentication process integrates comprehensive security measures including IP tracking, geographic verification, and behavioral monitoring to protect customer accounts while enabling seamless shopping experiences across multiple devices and browsing sessions.

Authentication requests validate customer credentials against stored password hashes, generate JWT access tokens with 15-minute expiration, and create refresh tokens valid for 30 days. The system implements progressive security including account lockout after 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes, device fingerprinting for new device logins, and comprehensive activity logging for security monitoring and fraud prevention.

email.description: Customer email address serving as primary authentication credential and account identifier. Must be unique across all customer accounts and verified through email confirmation process before enabling full platform access. Supports RFC 5322 compliant email formats and enables secure account recovery mechanisms.

password.description: Customer password for authentication validation against bcrypt-encrypted password hash stored in database. Must meet platform security requirements including minimum length, character diversity, and complexity standards. Passwords are never stored in plain text and undergo rigorous encryption for maximum security protection.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring (OPTIONAL - server can extract from request headers, but client may provide for SSR scenarios or enhanced tracking accuracy). Enables geographic verification, device fingerprinting, and suspicious activity detection for comprehensive account protection.

href.description: Current page URL (connection URL) - MANDATORY field for session context tracking and security validation. Captures the exact page where authentication request originated, enabling proper session initialization, referrer validation, and comprehensive audit trail maintenance for security compliance and user journey analysis.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY field for complete session context and security monitoring. Documents the navigation path leading to authentication, supports traffic source analysis, enables proper session attribution, and maintains comprehensive authentication audit trails for platform analytics and security oversight.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRefresh.description:
Customer token refresh request enabling secure session renewal for continuous platform access without repeated authentication requirements.

This DTO facilitates seamless authentication token renewal using valid refresh tokens, ensuring uninterrupted customer shopping experiences across multiple devices and extended browsing sessions. The refresh mechanism implements enterprise-grade security through token rotation with 70% probability, comprehensive validation of token integrity, and integration with behavioral monitoring systems for fraud detection and account protection.

Refresh operations validate token authenticity, check expiration periods against security policies, and issue new access tokens with updated cryptographic signatures while maintaining session continuity. The system supports multi-device compatibility, implements refresh token blacklisting for compromised scenarios, and provides comprehensive audit trails for security monitoring throughout the authentication lifecycle.

refresh_token.description: Valid JWT refresh token from previous authentication enabling secure session renewal without password re-entry. Must be cryptographically valid, unexpired, and linked to active customer session for successful validation. Token undergoes comprehensive security verification including signature validation, expiration checking, and blacklist verification to ensure account protection and prevent unauthorized access attempts.

IShoppingMallSeller.ILogin.description:

The authentication process implements comprehensive security measures including encrypted password validation, multi-factor authentication support, IP-based access controls, device fingerprinting, and detailed session tracking for compliance and audit purposes. All authentication attempts are logged for security monitoring and business activity tracking.

Session context information (href, referrer, IP) enables comprehensive traffic analysis, security monitoring, and personalized dashboard experiences while maintaining detailed audit trails for seller business activities across the marketplace platform.

The refresh process implements advanced security measures including token rotation patterns that replace refresh tokens with new ones to prevent replay attacks, detailed session metadata updates for audit trail maintenance, and comprehensive device fingerprinting for security monitoring. IShoppingMallGuest.ICreate.description:
Guest session creation request for establishing anonymous browsing sessions within the shopping mall marketplace platform.

This DTO enables unauthenticated visitors to create temporary guest accounts that provide basic marketplace access without requiring personal information submission or permanent account creation. Guest sessions facilitate anonymous product browsing, shopping cart management, and activity tracking while maintaining user privacy and session continuity across page visits.

The request captures essential session metadata including IP address for security monitoring, connection URLs for session context, and referrer information for traffic source analysis. This anonymous tracking supports personalized experiences, browser compatibility detection, and marketing attribution while preserving guest anonymity and complying with privacy requirements.

Guest accounts automatically expire through systematic cleanup processes, ensuring platform performance and data hygiene while providing immediate marketplace access for product discovery and conversion opportunities. This foundation enables seamless transition from anonymous browsing to registered customer accounts when users choose to complete purchases or access enhanced features.

IShoppingMallPasswordReset.description:
Password reset request entity managing the complete password recovery workflow for the shopping mall platform.

Records all password reset attempts with comprehensive security tracking including IP address monitoring, token lifecycle management, and usage audit trails. Supports cryptographically secure token-based authentication with configurable expiration periods ranging from 1-4 hours to maintain security standards while providing sufficient time for users to complete the reset process.

The reset system includes multiple security layers: rate limiting to prevent abuse, email validation to ensure account existence, token generation with cryptographic entropy, and comprehensive logging for audit compliance. Status tracking enables monitoring of pending requests, completed resets, and expired tokens for system administration and security analysis.

Integration with the broader authentication system enables seamless password recovery while maintaining security boundaries. The entity maintains relationships with user accounts through email addresses and provides the foundation for secure password reset workflows across customer, seller, and administrative accounts within the marketplace platform.

id.description: Unique identifier serving as the primary key for password reset record operations. Generated automatically using UUID v4 to ensure global uniqueness across all reset requests in the system.

email.description: Customer email address used for password reset requests and user identification. Must correspond to an existing active account in the shopping mall customer database. Supports standard email format validation and enables secure account recovery workflows.

token.description: Cryptographically secure reset token generated using high-entropy algorithms. Automatically created by the system with sufficient randomness to prevent prediction or brute force attacks. Tokens are single-use and time-limited to maintain security standards.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the password reset request was initiated in the system. Used for audit trails, rate limiting calculations, and token expiration determination. Follows ISO 8601 datetime format for consistent timezone handling.

expires_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the reset token becomes invalid and can no longer be used for password recovery. Configurable expiration period typically ranges from 1-4 hours based on security requirements and user experience considerations.

used_at.description: Timestamp recording when the reset token was successfully consumed to complete a password change. Enables audit trail maintenance and prevents token reuse for security protection. Null until token is successfully utilized.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the password reset request. Valid values include 'pending' for active unused tokens, 'completed' for successfully used tokens, and 'expired' for tokens that exceeded their time limit or were invalidated.

ip_address.description: Client IP address from which the password reset request originated. Used for security monitoring, geographic analysis, and fraud detection. Supports both IPv4 and IPv6 formats for comprehensive network tracking.

phone.description: Customer contact phone number for order notifications, delivery coordination, and customer service communications. Supports international format validation including optional country code prefixes for global marketplace compatibility. Phone validation regex ensures proper formatting while accommodating various international numbering systems and common formatting variations.

date_of_birth.description: Customer birth date for age verification, demographic analytics, personalized content delivery, and regulatory compliance requirements. Supports updates for corrections or additions while maintaining privacy protection standards. Must be provided in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD) when specified, enabling accurate age calculations and age-appropriate content filtering.

search.description: Free-text search filter for customer email addresses, names, and phone numbers. Enables administrators to locate customers based on partial information across multiple data fields. Case-insensitive matching supports fuzzy search functionality to improve customer discovery in administrative interfaces. Minimum of 3 characters recommended for effective filtering results.

email.description: Email address filter for precise customer identification. Enables administrators to locate specific customers by their registered email address. Validates against standard email format requirements and ensures exact match filtering for administrative operations requiring specific customer lookup.

verification_status.description: Account verification status filter enabling administrators to distinguish between verified and unverified customer accounts for targeted administrative actions and compliance monitoring. Provides complete verification context without requiring additional API calls for status lookup.

account_status.description: Account lifecycle status filter enabling administrators to identify suspended, deactivated, or active customer segments for administrative monitoring and communication management. Provides complete status context for efficient customer segmentation and lifecycle management workflows.

created_after.description: Creation date filter identifying customers registered after the specified timestamp. Enables temporal filtering for customer acquisition analysis and recent registration monitoring in administrative reporting and trend analysis.

created_before.description: Creation date filter identifying customers registered before the specified timestamp. Enables historical customer analysis and long-term retention monitoring for administrative oversight and business intelligence reporting.

Supports field-based ordering by registration date, name, email, or activity status to optimize administrative browsing and case management workflows. Primary field must be specified with optional direction modifier for precise result ordering.

page.description: Pagination page number controlling customer result set navigation. Enables administrators to browse through large customer datasets efficiently while maintaining consistent result ordering and performance optimization for administrative interfaces.

limit.description: Result limit per page for pagination control in customer listing interfaces. Balances administrative interface performance with comprehensive data access needs through configurable result set sizes optimized for efficient browsing and management workflows.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRequest.description:
Advanced customer search and filtering parameters for administrative customer discovery and management.

This request object provides comprehensive filtering capabilities enabling administrators to locate specific customer segments based on verification status, account lifecycle, registration timelines, and engagement metrics. The flexible filtering system supports complex search combinations for sophisticated customer analysis and targeted administrative actions through proper entity references.

Administrative effectiveness is enhanced through multi-field search capabilities, temporal filtering options, and flexible sorting controls that enable efficient customer account management across large marketplace populations. The progressive enhancement approach allows basic search functionality while supporting advanced filtering requirements for specialized administrative workflows.

The request structure balances comprehensive filtering flexibility with platform performance through pagination controls and result set optimization. Administrative security is maintained through access control integration and audit trail requirements that track customer search activities for compliance and security monitoring purposes. Entity references ensure complete contextual information without additional API calls for status verification.

business_name.description: Official registered business name or company name for the seller entity. This optional field enables sellers to update their public business name while maintaining verification continuity. Business names must be between 1-255 characters to support international business registration standards and maintain marketplace display compatibility across various seller types and business entity classifications.

business_registration_number.description: Official government-issued business registration number used for tax and regulatory compliance within the marketplace platform. This optional update field allows qualified sellers to update business registration information while maintaining marketplace verification standards. The field follows the same 6-20 alphanumeric character format to accommodate various international business registration systems and maintain database consistency during seller account modifications.

tax_id_number.description: Tax identification or social security number for business taxation and financial reporting purposes. Accepts 9-12 numeric digits representing official tax identifiers. Set to null to remove tax ID for international sellers who may not have domestic tax identification or need to update to different tax systems. Maintains nullable constraint to support various international tax environments during business information modifications.

license_file_url.description: URL linking to updated or revised business license documentation files. Supports file version management for documents such as renewed business registration certificates, updated tax certificates, or industry-specific licensing changes. Maintains 500-character limit for URL consistency and system performance. Sellers use this to provide current verification documents required for marketplace compliance, account verification renewal, or additional business authority demonstrations.

verification_status.description: Updated verification status of the seller account for administrative workflow management. Standard verification lifecycle states managed through proper entity references include approval processes, rejection reasons, and suspension details. Provides complete verification context for marketplace trust rating and seller capability management without additional API lookups.

business_type.description: Updated legal business entity type classification for tax compliance and operational categorization within the marketplace platform. Defines organizational structure including business entity categories through proper entity references. Enables business restructuring to different entity types while maintaining appropriate tax classification, regulatory compliance, and documentation requirements for marketplace operations with complete contextual information.

contact_phone.description: Primary business contact phone number update utilizing international E.164 format. Supports country codes and domestic phone numbers up to 15 digits for updated contact information management. Maintains phone number format validation for customer service communications and business inquiry purposes. Nullable for privacy preference updates or international sellers who may remove phone contact options during contact preference management processes.

contact_email.description: Primary business contact email address update for marketplace communications including finance notifications, customer inquiry forwarding, platform updates, and administrative correspondence. Email address validation ensures proper format compliance and maintains 100-character limit for system integrity. Sellers use this for updating primary business contact information for operational communications throughout marketplace workflows and administrative processes.

website_url.description: Updated business website URL for brand verification and customer transparency purposes. Supports domain changes, website migrations, or brand updates within the multi-seller marketplace platform. Limited to 200 characters for international domain system compatibility while maintaining system performance and preventing link abuse within platform interfaces. Sellers use this field during business website updates, brand evolution, and customer research facilitation within marketplace environments.

store_description.description: Comprehensive business description update providing detailed overview of seller operations, product offerings, business values, and brand story evolution. Rich text format maintains 10-2000 character guidelines for effective marketing content while preventing spam or inappropriate content that could damage marketplace platform reputation. Optional updates enable sellers to maintain current business positioning, reflect product portfolio changes, communicate brand evolution, and optimize marketplace visibility through contemporary business narratives that enhance customer engagement and platform credibility.

logo_image_url.description: Updated logo or brand image URL for seller business profiles and marketplace listings. Supports revised brand representation including updated visual identity, seasonal branding changes, or improved image quality within product catalogs, seller profile pages, and storefront interfaces. Limited to 500 characters for URL storage efficiency while supporting cloud storage and CDN integration for optimal marketplace performance. Sellers implement this during brand refreshes, visual identity updates, and image optimization throughout marketplace business operations.

is_featured.description: Updated featured seller status for marketplace promotional programs. Controls premium listing placement, homepage marketing opportunities, and elevated search result visibility for participating sellers. Optional boolean flag enables administrative updates or seller maintenance of featured status based on qualifying performance metrics, promotional campaign participation, or marketplace business development opportunities that enhance brand recognition and sales conversion throughout shopping mall marketplace promotion workflows.

IShoppingMallSeller.IUpdate.description:
Seller account update DTO enabling modification of business information including contact details, verification documents, business descriptions, and operational preferences while maintaining data integrity and audit trails.

This update interface is designed for authenticated sellers to modify their account information while preserving system-managed fields and verification workflows. The optional field structure allows sellers to selectively update specific aspects of their business profile such as contact information, business descriptions, branding materials, and operational settings without affecting unchanged aspects of their account.

Security measures include authentication verification to prevent unauthorized account modifications, business validation to ensure bank account compatibility with business entities, and change tracking for audit trail management. The DTO supports seller account management workflows including profile updates, business restructuring through proper entity references, verification renewal, brand evolution, and operational preference adjustments while maintaining marketplace trust and compliance requirements.

Update operations preserve existing data through optional field support, preventing unintended overwrites while enabling precise modifications when needed. Entity references ensure complete contextual information for verification status and business type classifications without additional API calls. All updates include validation checks, business continuity verification, and compliance screening to protect marketplace integrity during business information modifications across the shopping mall platform ecosystem.

IShoppingMallPasswordChange.IUpdate.description:
Password change request for shopping mall platform supporting customer, seller, and admin password resets. Validates reset tokens while providing comprehensive security tracking for password change operations across all user account types.

This DTO establishes the complete security context for password reset operations by including user account reference, device fingerprinting, and audit trail correlation. The user reference enables clear identification of the target account while maintaining security boundaries.

The device information provides comprehensive security monitoring capabilities, replacing simple string fields with structured device fingerprinting for enhanced fraud detection and security analytics.

Audit correlation ensures password change events are properly tracked and can be linked to broader authentication workflows and security incident management.

reset_token.description: Password reset token received via email for password change authorization. Generated during password reset request and valid for single use with customizable expiration timeframe

user.description: Reference to the user account requesting password change. Provides account context and enables security validation while maintaining user privacy through summary-level information

new_password.description: New password meeting shopping mall security requirements. Must be at least 8 characters with mixed case, numbers, and special characters for strong authentication

confirm_password.description: Password confirmation field for new password verification. Must exactly match new_password field to prevent typing errors and ensure password accuracy

device.description: Comprehensive device fingerprinting information for security monitoring and fraud detection. Replaces simple user agent strings with complete device context for enhanced security analytics

audit_log_id.description: Unique identifier for audit trail correlation. Links this password change request to security logs and enables comprehensive incident tracking across the platform

security_metadata.description: Security context and validation metadata for password change operations. Contains validation results, attempt tracking, and security assessment information

validation_results.description: Array of validation check results performed during password change request processing. Includes token validation, security checks, and business rule compliance

attempt_count.description: Number of password reset attempts for this user within the current session or time window. Used for rate limiting and security monitoring

session_correlation.description: Correlation identifier linking this password change to the broader authentication session. Enables tracking of password changes within user journey contexts

device_fingerprint.description: Device fingerprint hash for security tracking and fraud detection. Enables identification of suspicious access patterns across password change attempts

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when password change request was initiated. Used for tracking reset token usage and measuring token expiration compliance

IShoppingMallPasswordConfirm.description:
Response confirming successful password change completion for shopping mall platform users. Contains success status, user account reference, and comprehensive security metadata for audit logging of password reset operations across customer, seller, and admin accounts.

This response provides complete context about the password change operation, including the affected user account for clear identification and audit trail maintenance. The security metadata enables comprehensive tracking and fraud detection capabilities.

The audit correlation ensures this password change event can be linked to the original request and broader security workflows, maintaining complete operational visibility.

success.description: Indicates whether the password change was successful. Returns true when password reset process completes without errors, false if any validation or system issues occurred

user.description: Reference to the user account that completed password change. Provides clear identification of the affected account while maintaining security through summary-level information

message.description: Human-readable confirmation message about the password change process. Provides user-friendly feedback about the completion status with appropriate security warnings and next steps

audit_log_id.description: Audit log correlation identifier linking this response to the original password change request. Ensures complete traceability across the security operation lifecycle

security_metadata.description: Comprehensive security context and validation results from password change processing. Contains detailed validation information and security assessment results

validation_results.description: Detailed validation results from password change processing. Includes security checks, business rule validations, and system integrity verifications

password_strength_score.description: Calculated password strength score indicating the security level of the new password. Higher scores indicate stronger passwords meeting complexity requirements

session_actions_taken.description: List of security actions taken during password change completion. May include session invalidation, device notifications, and security alert generation

next_security_recommendations.description: Recommended next steps for user security enhancement. Provides guidance on additional security measures and best practices following password changes

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the password change was completed. Used for audit trails, security tracking, and customer service reference across all user types

verification_code.description: Six-digit numeric verification code sent to the customer's email address during registration. Must be exactly 6 digits matching the code generated and sent via email notification system. This code expires after 15 minutes for security purposes and can only be used once. The code generation uses cryptographically secure random number generation to prevent prediction attacks.

verification_token.description: UUID-based verification token contained in email verification links. This token is generated when customers click verification links sent to their registered email address. The token must be a valid UUID v4 format and expires after 24 hours from generation. Token-based verification provides a more user-friendly experience compared to manual code entry while maintaining equivalent security characteristics.

IShoppingMallEmailVerify.description:
Email verification request for shopping mall platform supporting both code-based and token-based verification methods.

This DTO enables customers, sellers, and administrators to verify registered email addresses as part of the account registration and activation workflow. The verification process serves as a critical security checkpoint to ensure email address authenticity and prevent fraudulent account creation across all user types in the marketplace ecosystem.

The system supports two complementary verification methods to accommodate different user preferences and security requirements. Code-based verification provides explicit user control through manual entry of security codes, while token-based verification offers seamless one-click confirmation through secure email links. Both methods utilize cryptographically secure token generation with appropriate expiration periods to balance security with user experience.

Email verification integrates comprehensively with customer onboarding workflows, seller registration processes, and administrative account verification. The verification mechanism supports comprehensive audit trails for security tracking and compliance requirements while providing robust fraud prevention capabilities through rate limiting, attempt restrictions, and automated suspicious activity detection.

This verification process is mandatory for all new account registrations and serves as a prerequisite for accessing platform features. Failed verification attempts trigger appropriate security responses including temporary account suspension after excessive failures and automated review processes for potential fraud indicators.

The design accommodates various email delivery scenarios including delays, spam folder placement, and corporate email filtering while maintaining secure verification integrity throughout the validation process.

Used exclusively in email verification API operations with comprehensive error handling for expired tokens, invalid formats, previously verified addresses, and security violations including rate limiting enforcement.

success.description:
Boolean success indicator for email verification attempt outcomes. True indicates successful email verification with corresponding account activation in the marketplace platform system. False indicates verification failure due to various causes including expired tokens, invalid verification data, previously verified addresses, rate limit violations, or system authentication errors.

This field serves as the primary response status indicator for client-side logic branching and user interface state management. Success responses trigger account activation workflows, dashboard redirects, and session establishment processes. Failure responses initiate appropriate error handling flows, retry mechanisms, and user guidance systems.

The boolean nature provides simple API response parsing while maintaining comprehensive status indication across all verification scenario outcomes including edge cases and security violation responses.
success.x-prisma-description: Verification operation success status indicating email verification completion

message.description:
Comprehensive human-readable message providing detailed information about the verification result in multiple languages. This message serves dual purposes of API debugging assistance and user-facing notification text for various verification scenarios including successful verification confirmation, expired token notifications, already verified address confirmation, rate limit violation warnings, and general verification failure explanations.

Message content varies based on verification outcome, user language preferences, and specific error conditions encountered during the verification process. Successful verification messages provide positive confirmation and next-step guidance to newly activated accounts. Error condition messages explain specific failure reasons and provide actionable remediation steps such as requesting a new verification email, checking spam folders, or contacting support for persistent verification issues.

The message format supports internationalization requirements and provides appropriate context for both automated system processing and direct user display in various application interfaces including web browsers, mobile applications, and API integration environments. Message length constraints ensure appropriate display across different user interface elements while maintaining comprehensive explanatory content.
message.x-prisma-description: Detailed verification result message providing user feedback and guidance

customerId.description:
UUID identifier of the successfully verified customer account within the shopping mall marketplace platform. This field is exclusively populated for successful verification responses (success=true) and provides the unique customer reference required for subsequent API operations including profile retrieval, order management, cart operations, and personal preference modifications.

The customerId represents the primary identity key for customer entities across the entire shopping mall ecosystem including authentication systems, transaction processing, order fulfillment, customer service interactions, and administrative oversight functions. This identifier enables seamless integration with other platform features while maintaining proper account security boundaries.

For verification failure scenarios (success=false) this field remains null and should not be used for any customer-related operations. The field presence serves as an additional success confirmation mechanism alongside the boolean success flag while providing mandatory reference data for activated account workflows.
customerId.x-prisma-description: Reference to verified customer record when verification completes successfully

verifiedAt.description:
ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating the exact moment of email verification completion and corresponding account activation in the shopping mall platform system. This timestamp serves multiple critical functions including audit trail documentation, security event tracking, account age calculation for trust scoring, and verification expiration monitoring for various security policies.

The timestamp format follows standard ISO 8601 conventions (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) ensuring consistent temporal data processing across different system components, time zone handling, and international customer support scenarios. This value enables comprehensive analytics including verification velocity tracking, account activation pattern analysis, and security breach timeline reconstruction when required.

The verifiedAt field provides essential chronological context for various account lifecycle operations including grace period calculations, verification timeout enforcement, and account maturity assessments used throughout the marketplace ecosystem for security and compliance purposes.
verifiedAt.x-prisma-description: Timestamp when verification was completed and customer account activated

IShoppingMallEmailVerifyResponse.description:
Email verification operation response providing comprehensive result information and account activation confirmation.

This response type encapsulates all possible outcomes of email verification attempts within the shopping mall platform authentication system. The response structure accommodates both successful verification scenarios triggering account activation workflows and verification failure conditions requiring appropriate error handling and user guidance.

Successful verification responses include complete customer identification data required for immediate platform access and feature utilization. Failure responses provide detailed failure analysis enabling appropriate remediation steps and user assistance workflows while maintaining security boundaries and preventing information disclosure that could facilitate fraudulent activities.

The response design prioritizes API consumer flexibility through comprehensive status indication while ensuring clear user communication through detailed messaging systems. Response content adapts dynamically based on verification method used, customer type (buyer, seller, administrator), verification history, and specific security policies applicable to account verification workflows across the marketplace platform.

Response messaging supports complex scenarios including token expiration handling, verification queue management, suspicious activity detection responses, and system maintenance notifications. The structure enables robust error handling across diverse client implementations including web applications, mobile platforms, and third-party system integrations while maintaining consistent user experience standards throughout the shopping mall ecosystem.

sku.description: Unique stock keeping unit identifier for this product. Must be globally unique across all sellers and products in the marketplace. Required for inventory reference and order processing.

name.description: Product name with clear, descriptive title. Should be customer-friendly and include key product characteristics for discovery and search optimization.

description.description: Comprehensive product description. Include features, benefits, specifications, and usage instructions. Well-written descriptions improve SEO and reduce customer inquiries.

price.description: Selling price of the product. Must be positive and reflect market pricing. Price will be displayed to customers in all product listings and calculations.

oneOf.description: Original price for discount display. Used to show savings when product is offered at promotional pricing. Optional - can be omitted for products without promotional pricing.

compare_at_price.description: Original price for discount display. Used to show savings when product is offered at promotional pricing. Optional - can be omitted for products without promotional pricing.

oneOf.description: Product cost for seller analytics. Used internally for profit margin calculations and business intelligence. Optional - can be omitted if seller prefers not to track cost data.

cost.description: Product cost for seller analytics. Used internally for profit margin calculations and business intelligence. Optional - can be omitted if seller prefers not to track cost data.

condition.description: Product condition. Valid values: new, used, refurbished. Determines customer expectations, return policies, and marketplace categorization standards.

weight.description: Product weight in kilograms. Required for accurate shipping calculations and delivery cost determination. Also affects warehouse storage and handling requirements.

weight_unit.description: Unit of measurement for product weight. Valid values: kg, g, lb, oz. Must be compatible with weight value and marketplace regional preferences.

oneOf.description: Universal product code or barcode. Enables inventory scanning, POS system integration, and automated warehouse management. Optional - can be omitted for products without barcodes.

barcode.description: Universal product code or barcode. Enables inventory scanning, POS system integration, and automated warehouse management. Optional - can be omitted for products without barcodes.

track_quantity.description: Enable inventory tracking for this product. When active, available quantity will be monitored and customers will receive stock-out notifications when inventory depletes.

allow_backorder.description: Allow orders when inventory reaches zero. Enables customers to purchase out-of-stock items with delivery once restocked. Important for customer experience during supply chain issues.

is_shipping_required.description: Enable shipping requirements for this product. Set to false for digital products, downloadable content, or services that don't require physical delivery.

is_taxable.description: Apply sales tax to this product. Determines whether jurisdiction-specific sales taxes will be calculated and added to customer purchase totals.

oneOf.description: SEO-optimized metatitle for product. Improves search engine visibility and click-through rates. Optional - system will use product name if not provided.

seo_title.description: SEO-optimized metatitle for product. Improves search engine visibility and click-through rates. Optional - system will use product name if not provided.

oneOf.description: SEO meta description for product. Summarizes product benefits and features for search engine results pages. Optional - autogenerated if not provided.

seo_description.description: SEO meta description for product. Summarizes product benefits and features for search engine results pages. Optional - autogenerated if not provided.

oneOf.description: Coma-separated tags for product categorization. Enhances searchability and enables targeted promotional campaigns. Use descriptive, relevant keywords.

tags.description: Coma-separated tags for product categorization. Enhances searchability and enables targeted promotional campaigns. Use descriptive, relevant keywords.

oneOf.description: URL of primary product image. Will be displayed in search results, category listings, and product pages. Supports multiple image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP).

featured_image.description: URL of primary product image. Will be displayed in search results, category listings, and product pages. Supports multiple image formats (JPG, PNG, WebP).

category_id.description: Primary product category identifier. Must reference an existing category in the shopping mall category system. Determines product placement in navigation and search results.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Seller account identifier for product ownership. Must reference existing seller account to establish proper marketplace relationship and enable seller dashboard management capabilities.

variants.description: Product variants enabling multiple product configurations. Create variants for size, color, material differences while maintaining unified product identity and discoverability.

images.description: Additional product images showcasing different angles, usage scenarios, or product features. Supports comprehensive visual presentation and customer decision-making.

oneOf.description: Client IP address for session recording and audit purposes. Optional field provided to maintain compatibility with various access methods while preserving logging requirements. JSON Schema type supports null to accommodate system variations.

ip.description: Client IP address for session recording and audit purposes. Optional field provided to maintain compatibility with various access methods while preserving logging requirements. JSON Schema type supports null to accommodate system variations.

href.description: Connection URL representing the current page or context from which the request originates. Critical for proper form submission tracking and maintaining consistent user experience across the product management workflow. Must be a valid URI format for proper routing and tracking.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page visited by the user before navigating to the current product creation workflow. Essential for complete user journey tracking, analytics, and understanding navigation paths through the seller dashboard. Must be a valid URI format for comprehensive tracking and analysis purposes.

IShoppingMallProduct.ICreate.description:
Request data for creating new product listings in the shopping mall marketplace.

Requires comprehensive product information including unique SKU identification, customer-friendly description, competitive pricing, and complete product specifications. Inventory settings control stock management behavior including backorder permissions and real-time tracking capabilities.

Product variants enable configuration differences while maintaining unified marketplace presence and discovery. SEO optimization settings improve search visibility and organic traffic potential. Image galleries and tag systems enhance visual presentation and categorization effectiveness.

Critical session context fields (ip, href, referrer) support comprehensive user tracking and analytics while maintaining compatibility security requirements for proper audit trail maintenance. Includes proper seller ownership relationship through shopping_mall_seller_id for marketplace relationship establishment and seller dashboard integration.

name.description: Product name with clear, descriptive title for customer understanding

description.description: Comprehensive product description with features, benefits, and specifications

price.description: Current selling price of the product in the marketplace currency

compare_at_price.description: Original price for discount comparison and promotional display purposes

cost.description: Product cost for profit margin calculations and seller analytics

status.description: Product status (active, draft, archived) controlling visibility in marketplace

condition.description: Product condition (new, used, refurbished) for quality transparency

weight.description: Product weight in kilograms for shipping calculations and logistics

weight_unit.description: Unit of measurement for product weight (kg, g, lb, oz)

barcode.description: Universal product code or barcode for inventory scanning

track_quantity.description: Whether to track inventory levels for this product across all variants

allow_backorder.description: Whether to allow orders when inventory reaches zero

is_shipping_required.description: Whether this product requires physical shipping or is digital/downloadable

is_taxable.description: Whether sales tax should be applied to this product

seo_title.description: SEO-optimized title for search engine visibility and ranking

seo_description.description: SEO meta description for search engine results pages

tags.description: Comma-separated tags for product discovery and categorization

featured_image.description: URL of the primary product image for catalog display

shopping_mall_product_category_id.description: Category selection - can be changed to recategorize the product

IShoppingMallProduct.IUpdate.description:
Update request for modifying an existing product listing. This DTO allows sellers to update specific fields while maintaining data integrity and compliance with marketplace policies.

Updates can include pricing adjustments, description modifications, inventory settings changes, and category recategorization. The system maintains comprehensive audit trails through product snapshots and ensures all changes comply with marketplace policies. Product updates trigger automatic re-indexing for search functionality and may require re-approval for significant changes.

Category changes are allowed while preserving the seller ownership. All other ownership fields remain immutable to maintain audit trail integrity and prevent unauthorized transfers of product ownership.

The update process integrates with inventory management systems, order processing workflows, and customer-facing product displays to ensure consistency across the entire marketplace platform.

Note: This update DTO allows optional field modification - any field can be updated independently while preserving unchanged fields from the existing product record. As with all OpenAPI object schemas, this type includes the required required property which is an empty array to indicate no fields are mandatory for partial updates.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.description:
Product variants representing different configurations of parent products within the shopping mall marketplace ecosystem.

Variants enable sellers to offer products with multiple options such as different sizes, colors, materials, or configurations while maintaining a single product listing for customer discoverability and SEO optimization. Each variant maintains its own SKU identifier, independent inventory tracking, flexible pricing adjustments, and unique display attributes while inheriting core product information like descriptions, categories, and seller details from the parent product.

This variant system is essential for supporting diverse product catalogs including apparel with size and color combinations, electronics with different technical specifications, and configurable products with selectable features. The system maintains inventory accuracy across all variations, enables granular pricing strategies, supports efficient ordering workflows, and preserves the unified product identity that customers expect during browsing and search operations.

Variants integrate with the complete order management ecosystem including shopping cart aggregation, checkout processing, inventory synchronization, order fulfillment tracking, and seller analytics reporting. The variant configuration directly impacts customer purchasing decisions, shipping calculations, and seller performance metrics.

id.description: Primary key identifier for this product variant. Auto-generated UUID v4 used for system-level operations, inventory tracking, and cross-referencing with order items, cart entries, and analytics data.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Foreign key reference to the parent product in shopping_mall_products table. Establishes the product hierarchy and enables variant grouping under a single discoverable product listing. Critical for maintaining product-variant relationships and ensuring proper seller ownership validation.

shopping_mall_product_unit_id.description: Foreign key reference to the primary product unit configuration in shopping_mall_product_units table. Defines the specific combination of selectable options (size, color, material, features) that comprise this variant for accurate inventory tracking and customer selection interfaces.

sku.description: Unique Stock Keeping Unit identifier for this specific variant configuration. Must be unique across the entire shopping mall platform and serves as the primary business identifier for inventory management, order processing, analytics reporting, and external system integration.

title.description: Customer-facing variant title that displays the selected configuration options. Examples: 'Large, Navy Blue', 'Premium Package, Size 10', 'Material: Solid Oak, Color: Walnut'. Serves as the primary variant identification for customer browsing, cart display, and order confirmation interfaces.

price_adjustment.description: Price modification applied to the base product price for this specific variant. Supports both positive values (price increases for premium configurations) and negative values (discounts for basic configurations). Enables flexible pricing strategies based on variant attributes like materials, sizes, or feature packages.

oneOf.description: Cost difference relative to base product cost for accurate profit margin tracking. Enables sellers to maintain precise accounting when different variant configurations have different manufacturing or procurement costs. Null when cost tracking per variant is not required for business operations.

cost_adjustment.description: Cost adjustment relative to base product cost for accurate profit tracking and margin calculations. Critical for maintaining business intelligence when variants have different production costs, material expenses, or supplier pricing structures.

oneOf.description: Weight modification for accurate shipping cost calculations when variant weight differs from base product specifications. Important for proper logistics planning, shipping rate determination, and fulfillment cost estimation across different product configurations.

weight_adjustment.description: Weight adjustment applied to base product weight for precise shipping calculations. Essential when variant configurations alter product weight (different materials, additional components, size variations) to ensure accurate shipping costs and carrier rate calculations.

oneOf.description: Product barcode, UPC, or EAN code for retail scanning and inventory management systems. Should be unique to this variant configuration and compatible with point-of-sale systems, warehouse management, and fulfillment center scanning operations. Null when retail scanning requirements do not apply to this product type.

barcode.description: Variant-specific barcode, Universal Product Code, or International Article Number for automated inventory tracking and retail operations. Must be unique across all product variants and compatible with industry-standard scanning systems for efficient warehouse and point-of-sale processing.

oneOf.description: URL of variant-specific product image that clearly shows this exact configuration. Critical for customer purchasing decisions as it displays the specific color, size, material combination being offered. Should be high-resolution image meeting platform quality standards.

image.description: URL of high-quality product image that specifically showcases this variant configuration with clear visibility of selected options (color accuracy, size context, material texture). Critical for customer confidence in online purchasing decisions and must meet platform image quality guidelines for resolution and content standards.

inventory_quantity.description: Current available inventory count for this specific variant configuration. Real-time stock level enables accurate availability display to customers, prevents overselling scenarios, and supports automated low-stock notifications for seller inventory management workflows.

inventory_policy.description: Determines system behavior when this variant's inventory reaches zero. 'deny' prevents any overselling by blocking orders when stock is depleted. 'continue' enables backorder processing allowing customers to purchase beyond current inventory levels. Critical for controlling overselling risk and managing customer expectations during supply chain disruptions or seasonal demand fluctuations.

position.description: Display priority order for this variant within the parent product's variant selection interface. Lower position numbers appear first in dropdown menus and variant lists. Used by sellers to highlight popular configurations, premium options, or special promotions by controlling presentation sequence in customer-facing interfaces.

is_active.description: Controls whether this variant configuration is available for customer purchasing and marketplace display. When true, variant appears in product catalogs, search results, and checkout processes. When false, variant is hidden from customer interfaces while preserving data for analytics, historical orders, and seller reference purposes. Enables lifecycle management for discontinued or seasonal variant options.

created_at.description: Timestamp of initial variant creation in the system. Auto-generated when seller creates the variant configuration. Used for audit trails, inventory tracking, and analytics reporting to understand variant lifecycle and performance over time.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of most recent variant modification. Automatically updated when any variant property changes including inventory adjustments, price modifications, or availability status changes. Critical for inventory synchronization, cart management, and seller activity tracking.

oneOf.description: Soft deletion timestamp for variant deactivation and data retention compliance. When set, variant is removed from customer interfaces while preserving historical order references and analytics data. Supports seller catalog cleanup, seasonal product management, and discontinued variant archiving without breaking existing transaction records.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for variant lifecycle management and data retention. When populated, removes variant from active catalog display while maintaining historical references in orders, analytics, and audit trails. Enables seller catalog cleanup and seasonal variant management without breaking existing transaction data integrity.

IShoppingMallCart.description:
Shopping cart management system for temporary customer product aggregation during browsing and pre-purchase phases. Serves as the primary entity for coordinating multi-seller marketplace transactions by maintaining a unified shopping session across different vendors while tracking customer intent, preferences, and conversion analytics.

The cart system enables seamless multi-seller shopping experiences by coordinating product selections from different vendors while preserving cart integrity across sessions. It maintains cart-level configuration preferences including shipping method selections, promotional code applications, and special instructions that apply to the entire cart contents regardless of individual product variations or seller-specific requirements.

Cart lifecycle is managed through comprehensive state tracking and expiration handling to optimize system performance and provide conversion analytics. The entity supports polymorphic ownership scenarios for guest browsing sessions, authenticated customer accounts, and system-managed scenarios while maintaining data integrity during status transitions across the complete order processing workflow from initial product selection through successful order placement and payment completion.

id.description: Primary key identifier for this shopping cart session. Auto-generated UUID v4 that serves as the unique system reference for cart operations, session management, and cross-referencing with cart items, order conversions, customer analytics, and abandoned cart tracking systems.

total_item_count.description: Aggregate count of all individual product items across all cart lines including quantity multipliers. Represents the total number of products customers will receive, not the number of distinct product types. Used for inventory validation, promotion eligibility checking, and customer display summaries.

total_product_count.description: Count of distinct product types in the cart regardless of quantities. Helps identify cart complexity for seller communication, shipping estimation, and promotional rule application based on product diversity rather than item volume.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the shopping cart. 'active' indicates ongoing shopping session with regular updates. 'abandoned' represents inactive sessions without customer activity for extended periods. 'converted' signifies successful transition to completed order. Status drives automated cleanup processes, analytics categorization, and customer communication workflows including abandoned cart recovery campaigns.

is_locked_for_checkout.description: Concurrency protection flag preventing simultaneous cart modifications during checkout processing. When true, blocks additional cart item additions, quantity changes, or configuration updates to maintain data consistency during payment processing, inventory reservation, and order creation workflows. Automatically released after checkout completion or timeout expiration.

converted_at.description: Timestamp marking successful cart-to-order conversion completion. Populated when customer completes checkout process and order is successfully created. Null for active or abandoned carts. Used for conversion analytics, performance tracking, and understanding cart effectiveness in driving marketplace transactions.

expires_at.description: Automatic expiration timestamp for cart cleanup and resource optimization. Typically set 30 days from creation for guest carts or extended periods for authenticated customers. Triggers automated cleanup jobs that soft-delete expired carts while preserving analytics data. Enables abandoned cart analysis and system resource management without manual intervention.

last_activity_at.description: Timestamp of most recent cart modification including item additions, quantity changes, or configuration updates. Used for session timeout determination, abandoned cart categorization, and customer activity tracking. Critical for identifying inactive carts eligible for cleanup and understanding customer engagement patterns across marketplace sessions.

oneOf.description: JSON configuration object specifying customer's preferred shipping methods, delivery speed preferences, carrier choices, and special delivery instructions. Format supports multiple shipping profiles for different product categories, address-specific preferences, and promotional shipping selections that apply to the entire cart regardless of individual seller shipping policies.

customer_shipping_preference.description: Customer's preferred shipping method and delivery configuration stored as JSON object. Supports complex shipping preferences including delivery speed options (standard, expedited), carrier choices (UPS, FedEx, USPS), address-specific instructions, and promotional method selection. Applied to the entire multi-vendor cart ensuring consistent delivery expectations across all marketplace sellers.

oneOf.description: JSON array of applied promotional codes configured for marketplace-wide or seller-specific discounts. Codes are validated during application, checked for expiration, and eligibility requirements verified against cart contents. Stored format enables promotional stacking, conflict resolution, and automatic discount calculation across multiple sellers in the single cart transaction.

promotional_codes.description: Applied promotional codes stored as JSON array containing marketplace discount configurations. Each code entry includes validation status, discount amounts, seller eligibility, and usage restrictions. Enables complex promotional scenarios including multi-seller discounts, percentage reductions, fixed amount coupons, and combination offers applied to the entire multi-vendor cart calculation.

oneOf.description: Free-form text field for customer special instructions, delivery preferences, gift messaging, or order coordination requests. Limited length to prevent abuse while enabling meaningful communication between customers and marketplace sellers for delivery coordination, special handling requirements, or order consolidation requests during cart-to-order conversion process.

customer_notes.description: Customer-provided notes and special instructions for the entire shopping cart. Used for delivery preferences, gift messaging, seller coordination requests, or special handling requirements that apply to the entire multi-seller order. Content is shared with relevant sellers during order creation while maintaining customer privacy and preventing inappropriate communication channels.

created_at.description: Timestamp of initial cart creation establishing the shopping session start time. Used for analytics tracking, session duration calculations, expiration determination, and conversion performance measurement. Critical for understanding customer shopping behavior patterns and marketplace engagement metrics across different time periods and marketing campaigns.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of most recent cart update including configuration changes, preference modifications, or status transitions. Automatically updated whenever cart properties change including shipping preference updates, promotional code applications, or status changes from active to abandoned or converted states. Enables real-time cart state synchronization and customer activity monitoring.

oneOf.description: Soft deletion timestamp for cart removal and data retention management. When set, removes cart from active customer interfaces while preserving historical analytics data for abandoned cart analysis, conversion rate calculations, and business intelligence reporting. Maintains referential integrity for completed order references while enabling efficient system cleanup.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for cart lifecycle management and data cleanup operations. When populated, removes cart from active customer view while maintaining analytics references and historical data for business intelligence, abandoned cart analysis, and conversion tracking purposes. Enables systematic cleanup of expired sessions without breaking order conversion relationships or analytics continuity.

IShoppingMallCart.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new shopping cart in the marketplace platform.

Enables initialization of shopping sessions for both authenticated customers and guest users with appropriate default configuration and session management. Supports polymorphic ownership allowing seamless transition between anonymous browsing and authenticated shopping experiences while preserving cart contents and preferences.

The cart creation establishes foundational shopping cart entity with unique identifier generation, initial status configuration, automated timestamp management, and configurable elements for enhanced customer experience. Provides the foundation for subsequent cart item additions, promotional code applications, and cart-to-order conversion workflows across multiple marketplace sellers.

Carts serve as temporary aggregation points for customer purchase intent, supporting wishlist conversion, promotional application, shipping coordination, and seamless multi-seller shopping experiences. The system maintains cart integrity through status tracking, expiration handling, and automatic cleanup processes while enabling dynamic configuration management throughout the shopping lifecycle.

customer_shipping_preference.description: Optional customer preferred shipping method configuration stored as JSON object. Contains shipping carrier preferences, delivery speed requirements, and special handling instructions that apply to the entire cart during order processing. Supports multiple shipping methods for multi-seller scenarios where different products may require separate fulfillment strategies.

promotional_codes.description: Optional JSON array of promotional codes to apply to the cart. Codes are validated against seller-specific promotions and marketplace-wide discounts during cart creation, with automatic distribution across applicable cart items. Supports complex promotion stacking rules and validates expiration dates, minimum order requirements, and seller participation eligibility for immediate discount availability.

customer_notes.description: Optional customer notes or special instructions for order processing. Human-readable preferences stored for cart-to-order conversion workflow, including gift wrapping requests, delivery instructions, product customization requirements, and communication preferences. Limited to 1000 characters with validation for appropriate content and business-relevant information.

IShoppingMallCart.IUpdate.description:
Shopping cart configuration updates for customer experience customization and dynamic cart management.

Enables comprehensive cart configuration management allowing customers to adjust shipping preferences, apply promotional codes, add special instructions, and modify cart-level settings throughout the shopping process. Supports real-time updates with automatic recalculation of shipping estimates, promotional discounts, and seller coordination requirements.

The update operation validates cart state before allowing modifications, ensuring carts are not locked for checkout processing and maintaining data integrity during concurrent access. Updates may trigger cascading effects on individual cart items, including price recalculations, shipping estimate updates, and promotional code redistribution across multiple sellers.

Integration with order fulfillment workflows ensures that cart-level configuration changes are properly applied during cart-to-order conversion, with validation of seller shipping capabilities, promotional code compatibility, and inventory availability across the marketplace ecosystem.

customer_shipping_preference.description: Customer's preferred shipping method configuration stored as JSON object. Supports dynamic updates to shipping preferences with validation against seller capabilities and delivery zone coverage. Enables customers to optimize delivery costs, speed, and reliability based on their specific requirements while coordinating with multiple sellers' fulfillment strategies.

promotional_codes.description: Applied promotional codes in JSON array format supporting real-time validation and redistribution. Updates trigger automatic recalculation of discounts across cart items with validation of code compatibility, expiration checking, and minimum requirement verification. Enables strategic promotional code application while maintaining seller margin protection and marketplace pricing integrity.

customer_notes.description: Customer notes or special instructions for the entire cart. Supports updates throughout the shopping process with validation for business-relevant content and character limit enforcement. Provides comprehensive communication channel between customers and sellers for order fulfillment coordination, including delivery preferences, gift requirements, and product-specific instructions.

IShoppingMallCart.ISummary.description:
Shopping cart summary representation optimized for list views, dashboard displays, and quick reference scenarios across the marketplace platform.

This lightweight DTO provides essential cart information while excluding detailed item listings to optimize performance in high-volume cart retrieval operations. The summary includes critical cart metrics, lifecycle status indicators, and temporal tracking data necessary for cart management workflows, conversion analytics, and customer experience monitoring.

The summary serves multiple operational contexts including customer dashboard cart displays, administrative cart monitoring, abandoned cart analytics, and order conversion tracking interfaces. It maintains the complete cart lifecycle context while providing quick access to key performance indicators like item counts, status states, and activity timestamps.

Cart summaries enable efficient cart state management by providing immediate visibility into cart health, customer engagement levels, and conversion readiness without requiring expensive item detail queries. This optimization is crucial for scalable cart operations across the multi-seller marketplace ecosystem.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping cart serving as the primary key for cart reference, tracking, and relationship management across all cart-related operations in the marketplace platform.

total_item_count.description: Total number of individual items across all cart lines representing the complete quantity of products selected by the customer. This count includes all units of all variants and provides the overall cart size metric used for inventory management and cart complexity assessment.

total_product_count.description: Total number of distinct products in the cart indicating the diversity of customer selections and shopping breadth. This metric helps assess customer engagement levels and cross-selling opportunities while supporting cart analysis and recommendation algorithms.

status.description: Cart lifecycle status managing the operational state of the shopping cart throughout its existence. Status values include 'active' for current shopping sessions, 'abandoned' for inactive carts past expiration, and 'converted' for carts successfully transformed into orders. This field drives automated cart management workflows, cleanup processes, and conversion analytics.

is_locked_for_checkout.description: Checkout lock status preventing concurrent modifications during payment processing and order finalization. When set to true, this flag indicates the cart is undergoing checkout operations and should not accept quantity changes, item additions, or other modifications that could compromise order integrity during the critical payment authorization phase.

customer_shipping_preference.description: Customer's preferred shipping method stored as JSON configuration containing delivery preferences, carrier selections, and shipping instruction details. This data enables personalized shipping experiences and supports multi-seller cart coordination by maintaining customer logistics preferences across complex order compositions.

promotional_codes.description: Applied promotion codes stored as JSON array containing coupon identifiers, discount details, and promotional campaign references. This field tracks active promotions affecting cart pricing and enables automatic discount application, promotional campaign analytics, and cross-selling opportunity identification within the shopping experience.

customer_notes.description: Customer-provided notes and special instructions containing delivery preferences, gift messaging, packaging requests, and other personalization requirements. This free-text field enables customer communication of specific needs that should be considered during order fulfillment and supports enhanced customer service experiences.

expires_at.description: Cart expiration timestamp typically set 30 days from creation for automated lifecycle management and abandoned cart analytics. This field enables cleanup processes, conversion tracking, and inventory reservation release while preserving data integrity during status transitions and serving as reference for automated maintenance jobs.

last_activity_at.description: Most recent cart modification timestamp tracking customer interactions, quantity updates, and item management activities. This temporal data supports engagement analysis, abandonment prediction, and cart health monitoring while enabling proactive customer outreach and conversion optimization strategies.

converted_at.description: Order conversion timestamp recording successful purchase completion and cart lifecycle conclusion. This field marks the transition from cart to order entity and provides conversion analytics data for performance measurement, funnel analysis, and revenue attribution across the marketplace platform.

created_at.description: Cart creation timestamp establishing the initial creation time for cart lifecycle tracking, customer behavior analysis, and temporal analytics. This field supports cohort analysis, shopping pattern identification, and cart age-based workflow triggers throughout the customer journey.

updated_at.description: Last cart modification timestamp capturing all updates including item additions, quantity changes, status transitions, and property modifications. This temporal tracking enables audit trails, change detection, and synchronization management across distributed cart operations within the multi-seller marketplace ecosystem.

IShoppingMallCartItem.description:
Complete shopping cart item entity representing a specific product selection within a customer's shopping cart with comprehensive pricing, variant specification, and fulfillment coordination data for accurate order processing and multi-seller marketplace operations.

This entity serves as the fundamental building block of the shopping cart system by capturing detailed product selections including specific variants, quantities, pricing calculations, tax computations, and seller-specific fulfillment requirements. The cart item maintains relationships across the entire product catalog hierarchy while preserving customer choices and business rules throughout the shopping session.

Cart items support complex marketplace scenarios including multi-seller compositions, variant-specific pricing, promotional discount application, inventory reservation management, and shipping coordination across multiple vendors. The entity provides the necessary data structure for seamless conversion from cart to order while maintaining data integrity and business rule compliance.

The comprehensive nature of this DTO enables sophisticated cart operations including real-time pricing updates, inventory availability checking, tax calculation based on location and product category, promotional code application, and gift service integration while supporting the complete customer shopping experience from product discovery through order placement.

id.description: Primary key identifier for this cart item serving as the unique reference for item management, quantity updates, and cart operations throughout the shopping session lifecycle in the marketplace platform.

shopping_mall_cart_id.description: Foreign key reference to the shopping cart containing this item establishing the parent-child relationship for cart composition management and ensuring proper cart ownership validation across customer sessions.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Foreign key reference to the product being ordered providing the core product identification for catalog lookups, inventory management, and seller attribution within the multi-seller marketplace ecosystem.
