shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Foreign key reference to the selected product variant containing specific options like color, size, material, or configuration enabling precise product specification and inventory tracking for complex product catalogs.

quantity.description: Number of units of this specific product variant within the cart representing the customer purchase quantity for inventory allocation, pricing calculations, and fulfillment planning across the seller network.

unit_price.description: Price per individual unit before tax and shipping calculations providing the base pricing foundation for line item totals, promotional discount application, and tax computation throughout the order processing workflow.

line_item_price.description: Total price for this line item before additional services calculated as unit_price multiplied by quantity forming the pre-tax, pre-shipping subtotal for this specific cart item within the overall cart composition.

tax_rate.description: Applicable tax rate based on product category classification and customer location enabling accurate tax computation for compliance with regional tax regulations and automatic tax calculation during checkout processes.

tax_amount.description: Calculated tax amount for this line item computed by applying the tax_rate to the taxable portion of the line_item_price ensuring accurate tax collection and remittance across different tax jurisdictions and product categories.

seller_shipping_estimate.description: Seller's shipping cost estimate for this specific SKU providing preliminary shipping cost calculation for customer transparency and multi-seller order coordination while enabling shipping method selection and cost optimization during checkout.

promotional_discount.description: Discount amount applied from promotions, coupon codes, or special offers reducing the line_item_price and providing customer savings while maintaining accurate revenue tracking and promotional campaign analytics across the marketplace platform.

option_summary.description: Human-readable summary of selected variant options and customizations providing customer confirmation of product configuration choices including color, size, material, and other selectable attributes for order verification and customer service reference.

is_gift_wrapped.description: Gift wrapping service indicator marking whether this item should receive special gift packaging, wrapping paper, and gift messaging services during fulfillment enabling personalized customer experiences and special occasion support.

seller_notes.description: Vendor-specific notes and special handling instructions for this item including delivery preferences, packaging requirements, customization details, and fulfillment coordination information supporting seller-to-customer communication and order customization.

inventory_reserved_at.description: Inventory reservation timestamp marking when inventory was allocated for this cart item preventing overselling and ensuring product availability throughout the shopping session while enabling automatic reservation release upon cart expiration or abandonment.

created_at.description: Cart item creation timestamp recording when the item was first added to the cart supporting temporal analytics, shopping pattern analysis, and cart age-based workflow triggers throughout the customer journey and marketplace operations.

updated_at.description: Last cart item modification timestamp capturing quantity changes, option updates, and property modifications enabling audit trails, change detection, and synchronization management across distributed cart operations within the multi-seller marketplace ecosystem.

product.description: Summary reference to the product being ordered containing essential product details for customer display, seller attribution, and catalog validation while maintaining the product relationship for comprehensive cart item representation.

product_variant.description: Summary reference to the selected product variant with specific options like color, size, or configuration enabling precise product specification validation and inventory tracking while supporting variant-specific pricing and availability management.

product_unit.description: Summary reference to the product unit specification for configurable quantity management and measurement system integration while supporting complex product configurations and unit-based pricing calculations within the marketplace catalog.

seller.description: Summary reference to the seller providing this product enabling multi-seller cart composition, seller-specific fulfillment coordination, and comprehensive marketplace operations while maintaining seller attribution and business relationship context.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new shopping cart item in the multi-seller marketplace platform.

This DTO represents the essential information required when customers add specific product variants to their shopping carts during the purchase decision process. The schema supports complex product configurations including size, color, material selections while maintaining compatibility with the shopping_mall_cart_items database structure.

Cart item creation triggers comprehensive business logic including inventory availability validation, pricing calculation with promotional discounts, tax rate determination based on customer location and product category, and seller-specific shipping cost estimation. The operation integrates with real-time inventory management to reserve stock during the cart session, preventing overselling while customers complete their purchase journey.

In multi-seller marketplace scenarios, each cart item maintains relationships to specific sellers, enabling independent shipping calculations, tax rules, and fulfillment processes. The system supports gift wrapping services, special handling instructions, and customer notes that flow through to order fulfillment workflows.

Security considerations include cart ownership validation through JWT authentication, inventory availability verification before creation, and prevention of duplicate items for identical product variants (instead updating quantities on existing items). The schema design enables seamless conversion from cart items to order items during checkout processes.

The create operation establishes the foundational cart-item relationship while maintaining consistency with product catalog pricing, inventory systems, and seller business rules across the entire marketplace ecosystem.

quantity.description:
Number of product units to add to the shopping cart. Must be a positive integer within available inventory limits for the selected product variant.

Validation includes checking against real-time inventory levels, seller stock policies, and maximum purchase quantity restrictions. The system automatically reserves inventory upon successful cart item creation to prevent overselling during the customer's shopping session.

Quantity changes trigger automatic recalculation of line item totals, tax amounts, and shipping estimates based on updated volume. Multi-seller carts maintain separate calculations per seller for accurate fulfillment processing.

option_summary.description:
Human-readable summary of selected product variant options and customizations for customer confirmation and display purposes.

Examples include 'Large, Blue Cotton' for apparel items or '64GB, Space Gray' for electronics. This field provides immediate visual confirmation of product configuration choices and serves as a quick reference during cart review and checkout processes.

The option summary is particularly valuable for products with multiple variant dimensions (size, color, material, style) where customers need to verify their selections before purchase completion. This information flows through to order fulfillment for accurate product picking and packing.

is_gift_wrapped.description:
Optional selection indicating whether the customer wants this cart item gift wrapped during order fulfillment.

When set to true, this flag triggers special handling workflows including gift wrapping service application, decorative packaging, and removal of pricing information from packing slips. The service may incur additional fees based on seller policies and item characteristics.

Gift wrapping selections are preserved through the order conversion process and communicated to fulfillment centers for proper handling. This service enhances customer experience for gift purchases while maintaining operational efficiency for sellers.

seller_notes.description:
Optional customer notes, special instructions, or delivery preferences for this specific cart item that should be communicated to the seller during order fulfillment.

Common examples include delivery time preferences, special handling requirements, customization requests, or coordination instructions for multi-item orders. These notes provide essential communication between customers and sellers while maintaining professional marketplace standards.

Seller notes are displayed prominently in seller dashboards and order management interfaces, ensuring fulfillment teams have access to customer requirements. The field supports enhanced customer service by enabling personalized order processing and special accommodation requests.

quantity.description:
Updated quantity for the existing cart item. Must be a positive integer representing the new desired quantity within available inventory limits.

Quantity updates trigger comprehensive business logic including inventory availability verification, pricing recalculation with promotional discounts, tax amount adjustments, and seller shipping estimate updates. The system validates that sufficient stock is available before accepting quantity increases.

When quantity is reduced, excess inventory reservations are automatically released for other customers. When increased, additional inventory is reserved if available. Zero quantities are handled through separate deletion operations to maintain data integrity and cart cleanliness.

The update process maintains consistency with seller inventory policies, category-specific purchase limits, and platform-wide business rules while preserving the customer shopping experience.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing shopping cart item's quantity and optional properties in the multi-seller marketplace platform.

This schema enables modification of cart item properties while maintaining data consistency with inventory management, pricing systems, and seller business rules. The update operation supports scenarios including quantity adjustments due to customer preference changes, availability updates, and promotional offer applications.

Quantity modifications trigger automatic recalculation of line item pricing, tax amounts based on updated volumes, and seller-specific shipping cost estimates. The system validates inventory availability for quantity increases and releases reservations for quantity decreases to maintain accurate stock representation.

In multi-seller marketplace contexts, updates may affect seller-specific calculations including commission rates, shipping policies, and fulfillment requirements. The operation ensures cart integrity while providing flexibility for customer shopping decisions throughout their session.

Security validation includes cart ownership verification, item existence confirmation, and business rule compliance checking. The update process maintains audit trails for inventory movements and pricing changes while supporting seamless conversion to order items during checkout workflows.

This flexible update mechanism accommodates various customer scenarios including quantity corrections, promotional offer applications, and preference adjustments while preserving the underlying cart structure and seller relationships essential for accurate order processing.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary of individual cart items for quick reference and status displays.

This summary provides essential cart item information without full product details. Used for cart overviews, item lists, and quick status checks on specific items.

Provides:
- Basic item identification and pricing
- Quantity and option information
- Inventory reservation status
- Gift wrapping and special handling flags

Common uses:
- Cart item quick views
- Inventory status indicators
- Price checking and validation
- Order preparation summaries

id.description: Unique identifier for the cart item. Primary key for item-specific operations and tracking.

quantity.description: Number of this specific product variant in the cart. Shows customer purchase intent for the SKU.

unit_price.description: Price per individual unit before tax and shipping. Base price for cost calculations and comparisons.

promotional_discount.description: Discount amount applied from promotions. Shows savings and marketing effectiveness for specific items.

is_gift_wrapped.description: Whether the item is gift wrapped. Indicates special handling requirements and customer preferences.

option_summary.description: Human-readable summary of selected variant options. Provides quick visual confirmation of product configuration without full variant details.

inventory_reserved_at.description: When inventory was reserved for this item. Critical for availability tracking and order fulfillment preparation.

created_at.description: When item was added to cart. Provides temporal context for customer intent and engagement analysis.

updated_at.description: Last quantity or option update. Tracks item lifecycle and customer preference evolution.

email.description: Customer email address where the verification email should be resent. This must be the same email that was used during registration and is currently awaiting verification.

customerId.description: Optional customer identifier for existing accounts. If provided, this takes precedence over email address for verification lookup.

oneOf.description: Client IP address for IPv4 format

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (OPTIONAL - server can extract, but client may provide for SSR)

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - MANDATORY for this operation

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY for this operation

IShoppingMallResendVerification.description:
Request to resend email verification to a customer who needs to complete email verification during registration.

This type represents a request to resend the email verification message to a customer. It can be used when the customer didn't receive the original verification email, needs to resend due to expired tokens, or experiences email delivery failures.

The operation is available during the registration process when accounts remain in unverified status, typically within the first 24-48 hours after account creation. The system generates fresh verification tokens with updated expiration times while implementing rate limiting to prevent abuse.

success.description: Indicates whether the verification email was successfully sent.

message.description: Human-readable message describing the result of the verification email resend operation.

delivery_status.description: Technical delivery status from email service provider, indicating success or failure reason.

next_retry_after.description: Timestamp indicating when the next verification email can be requested, for rate limiting purposes.

IShoppingMallResendVerificationResponse.description:
Response for email verification resend operations in shopping mall platform.

This DTO confirms the status of email verification resend requests sent to customers. It provides both user-facing confirmation and technical delivery details. The response includes information about rate limiting to prevent abuse of the verification resend functionality.

The data structure supports comprehensive delivery tracking and provides customers with clear feedback about their verification request status. This helps ensure successful onboarding completion and reduces customer support inquiries about missing verification emails. By not exposing sensitive user email addresses in responses, this implementation follows security best practices for data minimization.

IShoppingMallAuthentication.IEnableMfa.description:
Multi-factor authentication enablement request containing authentication preferences and security validation. This request initiates the MFA enrollment process by specifying the preferred authentication method and providing necessary security context for the setup process.

The request includes information about the desired MFA method (TOTP, SMS, or email), optional setup preferences, and security context to validate the authenticity of the enrollment request. The system verifies customer authentication status and session validity before proceeding with MFA configuration.

oneOf.description: Preferred multi-factor authentication method type for setup. TOTP provides time-based one-time passwords, SMS sends codes via text message, and email sends codes to the registered email address.
Preferred multi-factor authentication method type for setup. TOTP provides time-based one-time passwords, SMS sends codes via text message, and email sends codes to the registered email address.
Preferred multi-factor authentication method type for setup. TOTP provides time-based one-time passwords, SMS sends codes via text message, and email sends codes to the registered email address.

mfa_type.description: Preferred multi-factor authentication method type for setup. TOTP provides time-based one-time passwords, SMS sends codes via text message, and email sends codes to the registered email address.

backup_email.description: Alternative email address for backup MFA delivery when primary method is unavailable. Must be a valid email format different from the account's primary email address. Used for authentication method redundancy and account recovery.

backup_phone.description: Backup phone number for MFA delivery in E.164 format (e.g., +1234567890). Required when SMS is the primary method or for backup authentication. Used for security code delivery and account recovery.

security_context.description: Security context validation including session information and device fingerprinting. Contains validation data to ensure the MFA setup request originates from a legitimate authenticated session and trusted device context.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security context validation during MFA operations. Used for audit logging and to detect suspicious setup attempts from unusual locations or devices. The IP address is extracted from the request context if not provided.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) for session tracking and security context during MFA setup operations. Provides context about the environment where MFA setup was initiated for audit and support purposes.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) for session tracking and security context validation during MFA setup. Helps identify the navigation path that led to MFA setup initiation for security monitoring and user experience optimization.

IShoppingMallAuthentication.IMfaSetupRes.description:
Multi-factor authentication setup response containing configuration details and setup instructions for the customer. This response provides all necessary information to complete MFA enrollment including QR codes, backup codes, and step-by-step setup guidance.

The response includes configuration details such as the authentication method type, secret keys for TOTP applications, QR code data for easy scanning, and backup codes for account recovery. Setup instructions guide customers through the enrollment process with clear steps and security best practices.

qr_code_data.description: QR code data reference pointing to base64-encoded image containing TOTP configuration for authenticator app setup

backup_codes.description: Backup authentication codes reference providing account recovery options when primary MFA method is unavailable

verification_required.description: Indicates whether immediate verification of the MFA setup is required before the method becomes active. When true, customers must complete a verification challenge to confirm successful configuration, ensuring proper authentication method functionality before relying on it for account access.

oneOf.description: Type of multi-factor authentication method configured (e.g., 'totp', 'sms', 'email')
Type of multi-factor authentication method configured (e.g., 'totp', 'sms', 'email')
Type of multi-factor authentication method configured (e.g., 'totp', 'sms', 'email')

mfa_type.description: Type of multi-factor authentication method configured (e.g., 'totp', 'sms', 'email')

secret_key.description: Secret key for TOTP authentication setup in authenticator applications. This 32-character base32 encoded string should be entered manually or via QR code into the customer's authenticator app to enable time-based one-time password generation.

setup_instructions.description: Step-by-step instructions for completing the multi-factor authentication setup process. Includes guidance on installing authenticator apps, scanning QR codes, and testing the setup to ensure proper configuration for enhanced account security.

IShoppingMallAuthentication.IUpdateMfa.description:
Multi-factor authentication update request containing security confirmation and credential validation for MFA management operations. This request handles both enablement and disablement of multi-factor authentication methods while maintaining comprehensive security validation throughout the process.

Security requirements include enhanced validation procedures requiring current password confirmation, recent activity verification, session validation checks, and potential re-authentication confirmation before MFA changes. The system validates requesting customer authentication strength with complete session validity verification, creating comprehensive audit logs documenting all security configuration changes through the customer session management system.

oneOf.description: MFA management action to perform. 'disable' deactivates existing MFA configuration, 'verify' confirms successful setup completion, 'regenerate' creates new backup codes, 'remove' removes a specific authentication method.

IShoppingMallAuthentication.IMfaDisableR.description:
Response confirming successful two-factor authentication disablement for customer accounts in the shopping mall platform.

This response documents the completion of sensitive security configuration changes with comprehensive audit trail information and user notification details. The response structure supports both customer-facing confirmation and backend security monitoring systems.

Response components include operation success status, detailed messaging for user communication, and timestamp information for security audit integration. The timestamp field enables chronological tracking of all MFA configuration changes across the platform.

Integration capabilities support security information systems, customer notification services, and compliance reporting requirements. The response format ensures consistent handling of MFA disablement operations across all customer authentication interfaces and administrative oversight systems.

Used in customer-facing MFA disablement endpoints to provide immediate feedback about security configuration changes while maintaining comprehensive security oversight and regulatory compliance documentation requirements.

success.description: Operation success indicator for MFA disablement confirmation. Indicates whether the two-factor authentication disablement completed successfully without security validation errors. Used for immediate client-side feedback and downstream system integration decisions.

message.description: Detailed status message explaining the MFA disablement result and security implications. Provides user-friendly explanation about the deactivation process completion, confirmation of security notifications sent, and guidance for future account security management. Supports multi-language messaging capabilities for international customer bases.

timestamp.description: Operation completion timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Used for security audit logging, regulatory compliance tracking, and chronological integration with external security information systems. Enables precise temporal correlation of MFA configuration changes with other security events and user activities.

IShoppingMallAuthentication.IDisableMfa.description:
Multi-factor authentication disablement request for customer security configuration management in the shopping mall platform.

This request type handles the sensitive operation of removing two-factor authentication protection from customer accounts. The disablement process requires comprehensive security validation including current password verification and mandatory session context tracking to prevent unauthorized security downgrades.

Security requirements enforce multi-step verification procedures where customers must provide current authentication credentials and complete session validation checks. The system validates authentication strength, recent activity patterns, and session integrity before processing MFA removal requests.

Request validation includes mandatory href and referrer tracking for security audit logging, with optional IP address and confirmation code fields supporting enhanced security monitoring. The reason field enables security education opportunities and legitimate use case identification.

Used exclusively in customer-facing MFA disablement endpoints where authenticated customers request removal of their multi-factor authentication configuration while maintaining comprehensive security oversight and audit trail documentation.

password.description: Current account password for primary authentication verification during MFA disablement operations. Required to prove legitimate account ownership before allowing sensitive security configuration changes. Must match the current authentication credentials stored in the customer account system.

confirmation_code.description: One-time confirmation code received through registered communication channels (email or SMS). Used as additional security verification when primary MFA method is unavailable or as enhanced validation for sensitive security operations. Optional but recommended for high-security accounts.

reason.description: Optional explanatory reason for disabling two-factor authentication. Helps platform security teams understand user preferences and identify legitimate disablement scenarios. Common reasons include device loss, accessibility needs, or temporary convenience requirements. Supports security education and user experience improvement initiatives.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring. Optional field that can be provided by client applications for enhanced security logging and fraud detection. Server automatically extracts IP address from request headers when not provided, ensuring comprehensive audit trail documentation.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - MANDATORY field for session tracking and security audit logs. Required to document the complete security operation context including page navigation history. Must be a valid URI representing the current application location where the MFA disablement request originates.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY field for session tracking and traffic source analysis. Used to document the complete security operation context and understand user navigation patterns during sensitive account configuration changes. Must be a valid URI representing the previous page location.

IShoppingMallAuthentication.ITokenRespon.description:
Authentication token pair response issued after successful token refresh operation, providing new access token for immediate use within the shopping mall platform.

This response structure delivers the essential authentication credentials needed for continued platform access while maintaining security through JWT token-based session management. The token renewal process ensures seamless user experience without requiring re-authentication while implementing rotation mechanisms to enhance security posture.

Note: refresh_token is handled via secure HTTP-only cookies and not exposed in response body for enhanced security protection against token interception and cross-site scripting vulnerabilities.

access_token.description: New JWT access token providing authenticated session continuity across the shopping mall platform. Contains updated expiration timing and refreshed security signatures for enhanced session management and protection against token replay attacks.

expires_in.description: Access token validity duration in seconds before requiring renewal through refresh token operation or re-authentication. Used for client-side token expiration management with typical values ranging from 900 (15 minutes) to 3600 (1 hour) for security-conscious implementations.

token_type.description: Authentication token type specification, confirming 'Bearer' protocol for HTTP header formatting and client-side request preparation in accordance with OAuth 2.0 authorization framework standards.

IShoppingMallMfaVerify.ICreate.description:
Multi-factor authentication verification request containing security verification information for account access confirmation within the shopping mall marketplace platform.

This request structure captures all necessary authentication credentials and security context for comprehensive multi-factor verification processing. The implementation supports both primary authentication methods (TOTP codes) and fallback mechanisms (backup codes) while maintaining detailed audit trails for security monitoring and compliance requirements.

Mandatory session context fields including href and referrer are required for proper self-authentication operations, ensuring comprehensive audit trail establishment and security monitoring across the marketplace platform ecosystem.

code.description: Six-digit TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) authentication code generated by an authenticator application or received via SMS for the current login attempt. Must be exactly six numeric characters and valid for the current 30-second time window.

backup_code.description: Emergency backup authentication code for account recovery when primary MFA methods are unavailable. Optional alternative verification method typically consisting of eight alphanumeric characters provided during initial MFA setup.

session_id.description: Unique identifier linking this verification attempt to the established authentication session context for security correlation and audit trail consistency across the shopping mall platform.

ip_address.description: Client IP address for geographical verification and security monitoring. Used for anomaly detection and access restriction enforcement to prevent unauthorized access attempts from suspicious locations.

device_info.description: Device fingerprint information including user agent and basic device characteristics for security tracking and fraud detection. Captures browser information, operating system details, and device identifiers.

timestamp.description: Verification attempt timestamp for time-sensitive code validation and replay attack prevention. Must be in ISO 8601 format with timezone information for accurate time window validation.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - MANDATORY session context field for self-authentication operations to establish proper audit trail and maintain security correlation across verification flows.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY session context field for self-authentication operations to establish proper audit trail and enable comprehensive security analysis of user navigation patterns.

refresh_token.description: Current valid refresh token used to request new access and refresh tokens. Must be a previously issued token from a successful authentication operation such as login, registration, or previous token refresh event.

device_fingerprint.description: Optional device identification fingerprint for enhanced security validation during token refresh. Used to detect unauthorized device changes that might indicate token theft or session compromise.

user_agent.description: Optional client user agent string providing browser, device, or application identification information for security analysis and session tracking purposes.

IShoppingMallTokenRefresh.ICreate.description: Request payload for token refresh operations, containing the existing refresh token and optional device security information to validate the session and issue fresh authentication tokens in the shopping mall platform.

token.description: JWT access token for authentication validation. Must be a valid JWT token issued by the platform's authentication system with proper signature and claims.

isValid.description: Indicates whether the session is currently valid and authenticated. False indicates an expired, invalid, or corrupted token that requires re-authentication.

metadata.description: Additional session metadata including security information, activity tracking, and device details. This data helps monitor account security and provides context for session management decisions.

IShoppingMallProduct.IRequest.description:
Comprehensive product search and filtering request format for the shopping mall marketplace.

Enables sophisticated product discovery through multiple filtering dimensions including text search, price ranges, category navigation, inventory status, and seller-specific filtering. The request structure supports both general browsing and targeted product searches for enhanced customer experience.

Provides flexible pagination and sorting controls for optimal interface performance while maintaining comprehensive search capabilities across the entire product catalog. The format accommodates complex filtering scenarios including multi-category browsing, price-constrained searches, and condition-specific discovery workflows.

Designed for responsive user interfaces that need to balance search sophistication with performance requirements. The filtering system supports incremental search loading, real-time result updates, and adaptive query refinement based on user interaction patterns in the marketplace environment.

Critical for enabling efficient product discovery across large catalogs while maintaining user engagement and conversion optimization through personalized search experiences and targeted product recommendations within the shopping mall platform.

Supports both random access browsing and specific target searches for comprehensive catalog navigation capabilities in the e-commerce marketplace ecosystem.

average_rating.description: Average customer rating for this product

IShoppingMallProduct.description:
Core product catalog representing items available for sale in the marketplace.

Products form the foundation of the e-commerce catalog, representing individual items that sellers can list for sale. Each product belongs to a specific seller and category, with comprehensive metadata including pricing, descriptions, and inventory tracking. Products support multiple variants (different sizes, colors, configurations) and maintain complete historical records through snapshots for audit trails and change tracking.

Products serve as the central reference point for all marketplace activities including search, discovery, recommendations, and order fulfillment. The product catalog supports advanced features like SEO optimization, promotional pricing, and multi-media content while maintaining strict quality standards through approval workflows and policy compliance checking.

This detail view provides complete product context including seller information, category hierarchy, available variants, visual gallery, customer reviews with statistical aggregation, and real-time inventory status across all warehouse locations for comprehensive customer decision-making support.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-based indexing)

limit.description: Number of results per page (max 100)

search.description: Text search within variant SKU, title, and attributes

is_active.description: Filter by variant availability status - whether variant is active for sale

min_inventory_quantity.description: Minimum inventory level filter - variants with inventory >= this value

max_inventory_quantity.description: Maximum inventory level filter - variants with inventory <= this value

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by - supports variant-specific fields

sort_order.description: Sorting direction - ascending or descending order

IShoppingMallProductVariant.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and filtering parameters for product variant discovery. This request DTO enables comprehensive variant filtering based on multiple business criteria including inventory levels, pricing adjustments, and availability status.

The search functionality supports text-based discovery across variant SKUs, titles, and attribute compositions. Advanced filtering capabilities enable sellers to manage inventory effectively and customers to find specific product configurations like particular sizes, colors, or material combinations.

Pagination and sorting controls optimize user experience when dealing with large variant catalogs. The filtering system supports inventory management workflows by allowing targeted searches for low-stock items, price-competitive variants, or recently created configurations.

This DTO is specifically designed for variant discovery within the context of a parent product, providing focused search capabilities that respect the product-variant hierarchy while enabling flexible discovery options.

Note: All fields are optional for flexible search configuration - the system supports empty requests for browsing all variants of a product. In compliance with OpenAPI schema requirements, this type includes the required required property set as an empty array to indicate all fields are optional for maximum search flexibility.

id.description: Primary Key for variant identification

sku.description: Unique SKU for this specific variant configuration

title.description: Variant title showing selected options (e.g., 'Large, Blue')

price_adjustment.description: Price difference from base product price for this variant

inventory_quantity.description: Current inventory level for this variant

is_active.description: Availability status for customer purchase

product.description: Parent product this variant belongs to

IShoppingMallProductVariant.ISummary.description:
Concise product variant overview for variants in cart and listings.

Essentially variant representation for scenarios where product options need to be displayed alongside parent product information. Provides quick variant identification including key attributes and inventory status for commerce contexts where variant selection is critical.

Derived from shopping_mall_product_variants table containing the core attributes customers need to understand product variations and make purchasing decisions.

IShoppingMallProductCategory.ISummary.description:
Hierarchical product categorization system forming the backbone of marketplace organization and product discovery mechanisms.

Product categories provide the primary navigational structure for the shopping mall catalog, enabling sophisticated customer browsing experiences while supporting sellers in optimal product placement strategies. The hierarchical system accommodates detailed categorization from broad top-level segments to highly specific subcategories and specialized product groupings.

Categories serve as the foundation for advanced search functionality, intelligent filtering systems, recommendation algorithms, and comprehensive merchandising strategies. They enable drill-down navigation patterns, cross-category discovery experiences, and sophisticated product recommendation while maintaining catalog organization integrity across diverse product types and multi-seller inventories.

The system integrates deeply with SEO optimization, meta tag management, and search engine visibility strategies. Category hierarchies support analytics tracking, performance monitoring, and strategic business intelligence for platform growth and seller success metrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the category matching the primary key from shopping_mall_product_categories table. Used for database operations and API reference integrity.

code.description: Unique category code used for API references, URL routing, and system identification throughout the platform. Must be URL-friendly and maintain consistency across integrations.

name.description: Category name displayed in navigation menus, search results, breadcrumbs, and customer-facing interfaces. Supports localization and should be customer-friendly for optimal discovery.

description.description: Brief category description providing contextual information for customers, improving search discovery, and supporting SEO meta descriptions. Should be concise yet informative for browsing optimization.

path.description: Hierarchical category path showing complete ancestry within category tree (e.g., 'Electronics/Computers/Laptops'). Enables breadcrumb navigation and hierarchical filtering across the platform.

level.description: Hierarchy depth indicator within category tree structure, with 0 representing root-level categories and increasing values for deeper nesting. Critical for navigation rendering and search filtering logic.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this category was last modified, supporting cache invalidation, audit trails, and content synchronization across distributed systems. Used for incremental updates and change detection.

parent.description: Parent category reference maintaining complete hierarchical context in summary views. Enables recursive navigation, breadcrumb generation, and hierarchical product organization across the catalog.

is_active.description: Visibility control determining category appearance in customer-facing navigation, search interfaces, and merchandising displays. Inactive categories remain accessible through direct links and administrative interfaces.

is_featured.description: Promotional status indicating prominent homepage placement, special merchandising campaigns, and enhanced visibility in marketing materials. Featured categories receive priority in recommendation algorithms.

product_count.description: Count of active products directly associated with this category for inventory display, analytics reporting, and seller dashboard metrics. Automatically updated through product category assignments and inventory changes.

IShoppingMallProductUnit.ISummary.description:
Product unit configuration system enabling comprehensive product variation management and flexible configuration options for marketplace sellers.

Product units represent definable product characteristics including size dimensions, color variations, material compositions, style options, or any attribute that creates distinct product variations. The unit system empowers sellers to create sophisticated product configurations while maintaining granular inventory control and dynamic pricing capabilities for each variation type.

Units function as fundamental building blocks for product variant creation, enabling customers to select specific product configurations matching their preferences while allowing sellers to manage separate inventory levels, pricing strategies, and availability controls for each variation. The system accommodates unlimited unit types and complex combinations to support diverse product catalogs and sophisticated configuration requirements across multiple marketplace categories.

The configuration integrates with inventory management systems, order processing workflows, and fulfillment operations to ensure accurate stock tracking and seamless customer experiences across all product variations and seller operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for this product unit configuration. Primary key for database operations, API reference integrity, and system-wide unit identification across all product configurations.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Parent product reference linking this unit configuration to the specific product in shopping_mall_products table. Establishes the product-variant relationship and enables product-specific unit management.

name.description: Unit type designation such as 'Size', 'Color', 'Material', 'Style', or custom variation names. Defines the specific product characteristic customers will select during purchase configuration.

type.description: Unit category classification (size, color, material, style, custom) defining the variation domain this unit represents. Enables filtering, grouping, and interface optimization for different variation types.

display_style.description: User interface presentation method for unit options including dropdown menus, selection buttons, color swatches, text input fields, or custom display widgets. Affects customer experience and conversion optimization.

is_required.description: Purchase requirement indicator determining whether customers must select an option for this unit before order completion. Critical for cart validation, checkout process, and order processing workflows.

is_multiple.description: Multi-selection capability allowing customers to choose multiple options within this unit type, enabling complex variations like multiple colors or material combinations within single product configurations.

sort_order.description: Display sequence control within product configuration interfaces. Controls presentation order to customers and enables strategic arrangement of variation options for optimal user experience.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this product unit configuration was initially created in the system. Supports audit trails, configuration history tracking, and seller activity monitoring across the marketplace platform.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this product unit configuration was last modified, supporting configuration change tracking, cache management, and audit trail maintenance for seller operations and system administration.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for unit configuration cleanup, historical preservation, and audit compliance. Enables configuration retirement while maintaining referential integrity and historical reporting capabilities.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.ICreate.description:
Request data for creating a new product variant within an existing product listing in the shopping mall marketplace.

Product variants enable sellers to offer multiple configurations of the same base product while maintaining unified discoverability through the parent product. Variants represent different combinations of product attributes such as size, color, material, or feature packages, each with unique pricing, inventory tracking, and display settings.

The variant system is essential for marketplace flexibility, allowing customers to select specific product configurations while enabling sellers to manage different inventory levels, pricing strategies, and availability for each variation. Each variant maintains its own SKU for inventory management, supports unique pricing adjustments from the base product price, and can have variant-specific images showcasing the particular configuration.

Variants are created through product units which define the available attribute combinations. The system enforces SKU uniqueness across the platform and validates seller ownership of the parent product. Created variants immediately become available for customer selection and purchase while maintaining relationships to their parent product for unified catalog presentation.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Reference to the parent shopping_mall_products record that this variant belongs to. Establishes the product relationship and ensures the variant inherits core product information including name, description, and primary categorization. Must reference an existing product that the authenticated seller owns. Critical for catalog organization and variant discoverability.

shopping_mall_product_unit_id.description: Reference to the shopping_mall_product_units record that defines the specific product configuration for this variant. Product units represent different aspects of product variation such as size, color, material, or style options. Specifies which combination of unit options comprises this variant. Required for variant creation to establish the exact configuration being offered to customers.

sku.description: Unique SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) identifier for this specific variant configuration. Global marketplace identifier required for variant creation. Must be unique across the entire platform to prevent inventory conflicts and ensure proper order fulfillment. Should follow seller's internal SKU formatting conventions but will be validated for uniqueness before creation. Critical for inventory management, order processing, and fulfillment operations.

title.description: Human-readable variant title that describes the configuration options selected by the customer. Examples include 'Large, Blue', 'Premium Package, Size 10', 'Material: Oak, Electronics: Included'. Helps customers identify specific variant characteristics at a glance during product selection. Should clearly indicate the key differentiating attributes of this variant configuration. Used in cart displays, order summaries, and customer communications.

price_adjustment.description: Price adjustment applied to the base product price for this variant. Enables flexible pricing based on variant attributes like premium materials, different sizes, or additional features. Use positive values to increase price (for premium configurations) or negative values to decrease price (for simplified versions). Applied after base product price calculation. Critical for accurate pricing display and revenue tracking across variant configurations.

oneOf.description: Cost difference relative to base product cost for accurate profit tracking and financial reporting.

cost_adjustment.description: Cost difference relative to base product cost for accurate profit tracking and financial reporting. Optional field that enables sellers to maintain proper accounting when different variants have different manufacturing or procurement costs. Positive values indicate higher costs, negative values indicate cost savings. Used for margin calculations, supplier payments, and financial analysis. Null when cost tracking is not required per variant or when costs match the base product exactly.

oneOf.description: Weight difference for shipping cost calculations when variant weight differs from base product.

weight_adjustment.description: Weight difference for shipping cost calculations when variant weight differs from base product weight. Important for accurate shipping rates and logistics planning. Positive values indicate heavier variants, negative values indicate lighter variants. Used by shipping calculators to determine appropriate delivery charges. Critical for international shipping where weight-based pricing varies significantly. Null when variant has identical weight to base product or when weight differences are negligible for shipping calculations.

oneOf.description: Product barcode or Universal Product Code for retail scanning and inventory management.

barcode.description: Product barcode or Universal Product Code (UPC/EAN) for retail scanning and inventory management. Should be unique to this variant for proper tracking in fulfillment centers and retail environments. Supports standard barcode formats for compatibility with point-of-sale systems and warehouse management. Critical for automated inventory scanning, retail partnerships, and fulfillment center operations. Null when retail scanning is not required or when variants share barcodes with the base product.

oneOf.description: URL of variant-specific product image highlighting this configuration option.

image.description: URL of variant-specific product image highlighting this configuration option and showcasing the exact variant attributes. Should display the specific color, size, material, or feature combination clearly visible to customers. Upload high-quality image that clearly differentiates this variant from other options. Used in product galleries, zoom functionality, and mobile displays. Critical for customer purchasing decisions when variant appearance significantly differs from base product. Null when variant appearance is identical to base product or when product images sufficiently represent all variants.

inventory_quantity.description: Initial inventory level for this specific variant variant. Starting inventory count enables immediate sales while providing accurate availability information to customers. Represents the total quantity available across all warehouse locations for this variant configuration. Inventory levels are tracked separately per variant to maintain precise stock management across all product options. Critical for preventing overselling and ensuring accurate customer expectations about product availability.

oneOf.description: Prevents overselling by blocking orders when inventory reaches zero. Ensures accurate fulfillment and prevents customer disappointment from backordered items.
Enables backorder processing and continued sales beyond inventory levels. Allows flexible supply chain management when restocking is expected.

inventory_policy.description: Inventory policy determining system behavior when variant inventory reaches zero quantity. 'deny' prevents overselling by blocking new orders and displaying out-of-stock messages to customers. 'continue' enables backorder processing allowing continued sales beyond current inventory levels for flexible supply chain management. Critical for inventory accuracy, customer expectations, and fulfillment planning. Selection depends on supplier reliability, restocking timelines, and business strategy for managing stockouts.

position.description: Display position within the product's variant listing determining customer-facing sort order. Lower position numbers appear first in variant selection dropdowns, product pages, and search results. Controls customer visibility and consideration sequence to highlight popular or profitable variant configurations. Used for merchandising strategy and conversion optimization. Range from 0 (first position) upward with higher numbers appearing later in lists.

is_active.description: Toggle variant availability for customer purchasing and marketplace visibility. True enables immediate sales and displays variant in product selection interfaces. False hides variant from product pages while preserving data for analytics, order references, and administrative purposes. Sellers can activate variants after configuration completion or deactivate when temporarily unavailable. Critical for seasonal products, limited editions, and inventory management strategies.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.IUpdate.description:
Update request for an existing product variant in the shopping mall marketplace.

Allows sellers to modify variant-specific attributes including pricing adjustments, inventory levels, SKU management, and variant configuration details. This operation supports dynamic marketplace pricing strategies, real-time inventory synchronization, and comprehensive variant lifecycle management throughout the product catalog.

The update operation maintains data integrity by validating SKU uniqueness, ensuring proper variant ownership through seller authentication, and synchronizing inventory changes with cart and order management systems to prevent overselling scenarios. Sellers can manage variant availability based on supplier status changes, seasonal demand fluctuations, market pricing adjustments, and strategic product positioning decisions.

Update scenarios include price modifications based on competitive analysis, inventory adjustments from warehouse receipts or sales, SKU changes for better organization, and availability toggling for seasonal products or limited-time offers. The system provides atomic updates ensuring consistency across the marketplace while maintaining comprehensive audit trails for business intelligence and compliance requirements.

sku.description: Updated unique SKU for this specific variant configuration. Must remain unique across the entire marketplace platform to prevent inventory conflicts and ensure proper order fulfillment. Changes to SKU should be carefully coordinated with inventory management systems, existing orders, and fulfillment processes. Sellers typically update SKUs for better organization, supplier changes, or business system integration requirements.

title.description: Updated variant title showing selected configuration options. Examples: 'Large, Blue', 'Premium Package, Size 10', 'Material: Oak, Electronics: Included'. Should clearly communicate the key differentiating attributes to customers during product selection, cart management, and order review processes. Updates often reflect improved product descriptions, corrected option names, or enhanced customer clarity.

price_adjustment.description: Updated price difference from base product price for this variant. Enables dynamic pricing strategies based on market conditions, competitive analysis, supplier costs, or promotional activities. Positive values increase variant price above base product, negative values decrease price. Critical for margin optimization, sales event participation, and competitive positioning in the marketplace.

oneOf.description: Updated cost difference from base product cost for accurate profit tracking and financial reporting.

cost_adjustment.description: Updated cost difference from base product cost for accurate profit tracking and financial reporting. Positive values indicate higher procurement or manufacturing costs, negative values indicate cost savings. Used for real-time margin calculations, supplier payment adjustments, and financial performance analysis. Null when costs match base product or when cost tracking is managed at the product level rather than variant level.

oneOf.description: Updated weight difference from base product weight for accurate shipping cost calculations.

weight_adjustment.description: Updated weight difference from base product weight for accurate shipping cost calculations. Positive values indicate heavier variants, negative values indicate lighter variants. Critical for accurate shipping rate calculations, logistics planning, and international shipping cost management. Updates often reflect improved product specifications, packaging changes, or shipping cost optimization strategies. Null when variant weight matches base product exactly.

oneOf.description: Updated variant-specific barcode for inventory scanning and retail operations.

barcode.description: Updated variant-specific barcode for inventory scanning and retail operations. Should maintain uniqueness within the variant scope and compatibility with point-of-sale systems, warehouse management, and fulfillment center operations. Updates typically reflect supplier changes, retail partner requirements, or inventory system integration needs. Null when barcode management is handled at the product level or when retail scanning functionality is not required.

oneOf.description: Updated URL of variant-specific product image showing the exact configuration.

image.description: Updated URL of variant-specific product image showing the exact configuration and highlighting key variant attributes. Should clearly display the specific color, size, material, or feature combination to support customer purchasing decisions. Updates often include higher quality images, lifestyle photography, or images that better showcase variant characteristics. Null when variant appearance is identical to base product or when existing product images sufficiently represent all available variants.

inventory_quantity.description: Updated current inventory level for this specific variant across all warehouse locations. Represents the total available quantity and is synchronized in real-time with sales, returns, and warehouse operations. Critical for preventing overselling, managing customer expectations, and enabling accurate availability displays. Updates reflect warehouse receipts, sales transactions, returns processing, and inventory adjustments from various business operations.

inventory_policy.description: Updated inventory handling policy when depleted determining system behavior at zero inventory. 'deny' prevents overselling by blocking new orders and displaying out-of-stock messages. 'continue' enables backorder processing allowing continued sales beyond current inventory levels. Updates often reflect supplier reliability changes, seasonal demand patterns, or strategic inventory management decisions.

position.description: Updated display order position within the product's variant listing affecting customer-facing sort order. Lower position numbers appear first in variant selection interfaces, product pages, and search results. Used for merchandising optimization and conversion rate improvement. Updates enable strategic repositioning of popular variants, new product highlighting, or promotional campaign support.

is_active.description: Updated availability status for customer purchasing and marketplace visibility. True enables immediate sales and displays variant in all customer interfaces. False hides variant from product pages while preserving data for analytics, order history, and administrative purposes. Updates support seasonal product management, limited edition releases, supplier availability changes, and strategic product lifecycle decisions.

IShoppingMallProductUnit.description:
Product unit definitions enabling flexible product configuration and variant creation within the shopping mall marketplace platform.

Product units represent different aspects of product variation including size, color, material, style, or any definable characteristic that creates distinct product options for customers. The unit system enables sellers to create comprehensive product configurations while maintaining inventory control and pricing flexibility for each variation type across their product catalog.

Units serve as the building blocks for product variants, allowing customers to select specific product configurations that meet their preferences while enabling sellers to manage different inventory levels, pricing, and availability for each variation. The system supports unlimited unit types and combinations to accommodate diverse product catalogs and complex configuration requirements throughout the shopping mall platform.

Each unit configuration defines how customers interact with product variations during the shopping experience through display preferences, selection requirements, and interface organization. Unit types can be customized or selected from standard categories to provide the most intuitive product selection experience for different product categories and customer segments.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for this product unit configuration in the shopping_mall_product_units database table. Primary key for database operations, API references, and entity relationships throughout the marketplace system.

product.description: Complete product information this unit configuration applies to, including product name, SKU code, category reference, pricing information, and essential metadata for product management workflows. Links the unit configuration to its parent product in the shopping_mall_products table.

name.description: Unit type name such as 'Size', 'Color', 'Material', or 'Style' that defines the specific variation characteristic customers will select from. Displayed prominently in product configuration interfaces to help customers understand their selection options.

type.description: Unit category (size, color, material, style, custom) defining the type of variation this unit represents in the product configuration system. Determines available display options, validation rules, and how the unit integrates with the broader product catalog categorization within the shopping mall platform.

display_style.description: How to display unit options to customers including dropdown menus, visual button selections, color swatches, text input fields, or custom display formats. Selected based on unit type and customer experience optimization to provide the most intuitive interface for each product characteristic.

is_required.description: Whether customers must select an option for this unit before completing their purchase transaction. Required units enforce selection validation during cart management and checkout processes, ensuring proper product configuration completion for order fulfillment and customer satisfaction.

is_multiple.description: Whether customers can select multiple options for this unit simultaneously, enabling multiple variations within a single unit type such as selecting multiple colors or sizes for complex product configurations like custom apparel or bundled product sets.

sort_order.description: Display order of this unit within the product configuration interface from 1 to highest priority. Controls the presentation sequence to customers and allows sellers to optimize the configuration flow by placing the most important variation options first for improved customer experience and conversion rates.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this product unit was configured in the system. Used for audit trails, configuration history tracking, and business intelligence analysis to understand when sellers established each unit configuration for their product catalog management operations.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this product unit configuration was last modified or updated by the seller. Enables tracking of configuration changes over time, supports audit trails for marketplace compliance, and provides visibility into when sellers actively manage their product variant systems within the shopping mall platform.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for unit management, cleanup operations, and audit trail preservation within the shopping mall platform. When present, indicates the unit has been logically removed from active configuration while maintaining historical references for existing orders, inventory records, and business transaction analysis.

IShoppingMallProductUnit.IRequest.description:
Query parameters for filtering, searching, and sorting product unit configurations in marketplace catalog searches with comprehensive filtering capabilities for sellers and administrators to locate specific unit configurations based on various criteria including product association, unit types, requirement status, and display characteristics.

This request DTO enables efficient product catalog management through targeted searches and organized result presentation across the shopping mall platform. Advanced filtering capabilities support complex product catalog management workflows including bulk configuration updates, category-based organizational reviews, and business intelligence analysis of seller product variation strategies.

Search parameters provide flexible discovery mechanisms that accommodate both administrative oversight needs and seller self-service catalog management. Pagination and sorting options ensure scalable data retrieval for large vendor catalogs and comprehensive product databases within the competitive marketplace environment.

type.description: Unit type category to filter units (size, color, material, style, custom) enabling sellers to quickly locate similar variation configurations across their product catalog or marketplace administrators to analyze unit type distribution trends across the platform for catalog optimization and business intelligence reporting purposes.

isRequired.description: Filter by requirement status - true for required units that customers must complete before purchase, false for optional units that enhance product configuration but don't prevent transaction completion. Enables sellers to audit purchase workflow validation and marketplace administrators to evaluate catalog complexity across different seller segments within the shopping mall platform.

isMultiple.description: Filter by multiple selection capability - true for units allowing customers to select multiple options within a single variation type, false for units restricted to single choice per configuration. Enables analysis of advanced product customization strategies and marketplace complexity trends across different product categories and vendor specializations.

search.description: Text search query to find units by name or type with fuzzy matching capabilities enabling flexible product configuration discovery. Supports partial matches for unit names like 'size' or 'color' and broad category searches for material types, style definitions, or custom unit variations used across the marketplace catalog for comprehensive vendor inventory analysis and comparison reporting.

page.description: Page number for paginated results starting from 1 for the first page. Enables scalable data retrieval for large product catalogs with hundreds of unit configurations per product, supporting seller dashboard pagination and administrative catalog review workflows across diverse vendor segments within the shopping mall marketplace platform.

limit.description: Number of results per page, defaults to 20 and supports up to 100 configurations per page for efficient catalog browsing. Configurable based on user interface requirements and data processing needs for bulk configuration management versus quick browsing scenarios across different seller tools and administrative interfaces within the marketplace system.

orderBy.description: Sort order for results by specified field including name for alphabetical organization, type for category-based grouping, sort_order for display position prioritization, created_at for chronological filtering, and updated_at for recent modification searches within the shopping mall product catalog configuration management system.

orderType.description: Sorting direction - asc for ascending order providing chronological progression or alphabetical organization, or desc for descending order showing newest configurations first, highest priority units at the top, or reverse alphabetical sequences based on the selected orderBy field within the marketplace catalog management workflow.

IShoppingMallProductUnit.ICreate.description:
Product unit creation configuration enabling sellers to define product variation types and customer selection interfaces.

is_required.description: Purchase requirement flag determining whether customers must select an option for this unit before completing checkout. is_multiple.description: Multiple selection capability enabling customers to choose more than one option within the same unit type. sort_order.description: Display sequence ordering within the product configuration interface determining the presentation order of units to customers. IShoppingMallProductUnit.IUpdate.description:
Product unit configuration update enabling modification of existing variation settings, display preferences, and customer selection requirements.

name.description: Updated human-readable unit type name displayed to customers during product selection. Name changes affect only the display label and do not impact variant generation, inventory tracking, or existing order configurations. type.description: Updated system-level unit category classification affecting system processing behavior and validation logic. Type modifications should be carefully evaluated as they may impact existing product variant structures, customer selection interfaces, integration systems, and historical reporting. Category changes should align with business requirements and maintain compatibility with existing configurations across the marketplace platform.

display_style.description: Updated user interface presentation method for unit options allowing sellers to optimize customer experience based on performance data, user feedback, or product category evolution.
