is_required.description: Updated purchase requirement status modifying whether customers must select an option for this unit before checkout completion. Requirement changes affect purchase workflow validation and must be carefully managed to prevent conflicts with existing cart configurations, saved customer preferences, and order processing rules. Status updates should consider impact on customer experience and conversion rates.

is_multiple.description: Updated multiple selection capability allowing or restricting customers from choosing more than one option within the same unit type. This modification significantly impacts variant generation logic, pricing calculations, inventory management complexity, and customer configuration flexibility. Changes should be evaluated for compatibility with existing product configurations and pricing structures across the marketplace platform.

sort_order.description: Updated display sequence ordering modifying the presentation priority of units within product configuration interfaces. Sort order adjustments enable sellers to optimize customer decision-making flow by presenting the most important or commonly selected variation options first. Changes affect customer experience and should be based on analytics data, user behavior insights, and conversion optimization strategies.

oneOf.description: Alphabetical sorting by unit type name (Size, Color, Material, Style) for consistent UI organization and catalog browsing. Enables alphabetical product catalog layouts standardizing customer experience across marketplace interfaces.

Category-based grouping by unit type classification (size, color, material, style, custom) for administrative workflows. Groups similar variation types together facilitating bulk catalog management and inventory organization across seller inventories.

Manual sorting by configurable display position prioritizing user interface experience. Enables sellers to control product option presentation sequence optimizing customer selection workflow and conversion rates.

Chronological sorting by creation timestamp for tracking new product configurations and inventory additions. Supports administrative workflows monitoring catalog growth and identifying recently added variation options.

Temporal sorting by last modification timestamp for identifying configuration changes and recent updates. Essential for catalog change management and administrative monitoring of product variation system modifications.

IShoppingMallProductUnitOrderBy.description:
Sorting criteria enumeration for product unit configurations across the shopping mall marketplace.

Product units define product variation types (size, color, material, style) and determine how customers configure products before purchase. Sorting options enable efficient catalog organization, administrative workflows, and customer interface optimization.

Sorting fields support marketplace operations including product configuration management, inventory organization, customer search experiences, and seller catalog administration. The enumeration ensures consistent query performance and intuitive result organization across the platform.

Each sorting option serves specific business purposes: alphabetical organization for UI consistency, type-based grouping for category management, display position prioritization for user experience, and temporal filtering for recent modifications tracking.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1. Used to navigate through large result sets of categories across hierarchical levels. Higher page numbers access deeper result sets for comprehensive category discovery in large catalogs.

limit.description: Number of categories to return per page. Limit ranges from 1 to 100 to balance between response size and data retrieval efficiency. Optimal values depend on interface requirements and user experience design constraints.

search.description: Full-text search query to filter categories by name or description. Supports partial matching across category text content with intelligent relevance scoring. Searches across both primary category names and detailed descriptions for comprehensive discovery capabilities.

isActive.description: Filter by category activation status. When true, returns only active categories visible to customers in navigation and product assignment interfaces. When false, returns inactive categories hidden from customer view but available for administrative operations. When null or undefined, returns all categories regardless of activation status for comprehensive administrative access.

isFeatured.description: Filter by category featured status for promotional and merchandising purposes. When true, returns only categories marked as featured for homepage displays and marketing material priority placement. When false, returns standard categories without featured designation. When null or undefined, returns all categories regardless of featured status for complete inventory analysis.

level.description: Filter by category hierarchy level for targeted navigation and organizational analysis. Level 0 represents root categories with no parent assignments, typically representing department-level classifications. Higher levels indicate increasing specificity in product categorization, with level 1 representing first-level subcategories. Maximum supported level of 10 prevents excessive nesting complexity while supporting sophisticated classification systems.

oneOf.description: UUID reference to parent category for hierarchical filtering operations. Used to retrieve child categories within specific parent contexts for tree navigation and organizational analysis.
Explicit null value to filter for root-level categories with no parent assignments. Returns top-level categories that serve as primary navigation entry points in the marketplace catalog structure.

parentId.description: Parent category reference for hierarchical filtering and tree traversal operations. Use valid UUID to retrieve direct child categories of a specific parent, supporting efficient category tree exploration and navigation implementation. Use explicit null to identify root-level categories that serve as primary marketplace department classifications without parent relationships. This parameter enables sophisticated category browsing interfaces and administrative organization tools.

oneOf.description: Alphabetical sorting by category name for intuitive A-Z navigation ordering. Provides consistent alphabetical organization that customers naturally expect in category browsing interfaces.

Sorting by unique category code for system-level organization and administrative efficiency. Useful for technical sorting requirements and consistent API result ordering across different query operations.

Chronological sorting by category creation timestamp for newest-first or oldest-first result organization. Valuable for administrative dashboards and audit trail analysis showing category lifecycle progression.

Sorting by manual sort order position for strategic merchandising and navigation optimization. Respects administrator-defined display priorities, enabling precise control over category presentation sequence in customer interfaces.

Hierarchical sorting by category path for logical tree structure organization. Provides intuitive navigation ordering that respects parent-child relationships and enables effective breadcrumb generation across category hierarchies.

orderBy.description: Sorting criterion for category result organization with strategic control over presentation order. Multiple sorting options support different business objectives including alphabetical navigation, chronological analysis, merchandising priorities, and hierarchical organization. Selection impacts customer browsing experience and administrative workflow efficiency.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort direction providing A-Z alphabetical ordering, oldest-first chronological arrangement, or lowest-to-highest numerical sequencing. Creates intuitive forward progression in category navigation interfaces.

Descending sort direction providing Z-A reverse alphabetical ordering, newest-first chronological arrangement, or highest-to-lowest numerical sequencing. Creates reverse progression useful for highlighting newest or highest-priority categories first.

orderDirection.description: Sort direction control enabling both forward and reverse ordering of category results. Ascending direction provides natural progression through alphabetical, chronological, or numerical sequences. Descending direction reverses natural ordering for strategic presentation priorities, such as showing newest categories or highest-sort-order items first in customer interfaces and administrative dashboards.

IShoppingMallProductCategory.IRequest.description:
Advanced search and filtering request structure for product category discovery within shopping mall marketplace taxonomy systems.

This comprehensive request DTO enables sophisticated category exploration across hierarchical classification structures with granular control over result organization and presentation. The request parameters support both customer-facing navigation interfaces and administrative catalog management workflows with advanced filtering capabilities that accommodate complex business requirements.

The schema provides flexible search functionality supporting full-text queries across category names and descriptions with intelligent relevance scoring. Multi-criteria filtering enables precise category targeting through activation status, featured designation, hierarchical level positioning, and parent-child relationship navigation. Advanced sorting options support strategic merchandising objectives while pagination controls ensure efficient data retrieval for large-scale marketplace catalogs spanning extensive product classification systems.

Designed for enterprise e-commerce environments, this request structure balances comprehensive filtering capabilities with performance optimization, supporting real-time category discovery and administrative inventory analysis across complex multi-seller marketplace taxonomies.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product category. Primary key with UUID format for global uniqueness across the marketplace. Generated automatically upon category creation and used for all internal references and relationships.

parent_id.description: Reference to parent category in hierarchical structure. Null for root-level categories. Used to build category tree navigation and breadcrumb trails. Validates against existing active categories to maintain referential integrity.

parent.description:
Complete parent category information for hierarchical navigation and context. Provides full category details to enable intelligent product organization and enable efficient category tree traversal without additional API calls.

Contains essential category metadata including name, code, and path information needed for display and organizational purposes. Supports real-time category selection interfaces and enables dynamic breadcrumb generation based on complete category hierarchy. Used for immediate parent context without circular reference risks.

code.description: Unique category code used for API references and system identification. Must be alphanumeric with optional hyphens or underscores for consistency across the platform. Serves as the primary business identifier for external systems and URL path generation.

name.description: Human-readable category name displayed in navigation and product listings. Limited to 100 characters for optimal display across mobile and desktop interfaces. Should be descriptive and customer-friendly for effective product discovery.

description.description: Detailed category description explaining scope and product inclusion criteria. Supports rich text formatting and HTML for comprehensive product information display. Limited to 2000 characters for database performance and display consistency.

path.description: Hierarchical path showing category position in tree structure (e.g., 'Electronics/Computers/Laptops'). Auto-generated by system based on parent relationships but can be customized for specific SEO or navigation requirements. Used for breadcrumb navigation and SEO optimization.

level.description: Numerical level indicating depth in category hierarchy. Level 0 represents root categories, with incremental values for subcategories and specialized classifications. Maximum level of 10 prevents excessive nesting complexity.

sort_order.description: Display order position within parent category or top-level navigation. Lower values appear first in dropdown menus and category listings. Supports precise positioning for strategic merchandising and customer experience optimization.

is_active.description: Visibility status controlling category display to customers. Active categories appear in navigation and product assignment interfaces. When false, categories are hidden from customers but remain accessible for administrative operations and historical data preservation.

is_featured.description: Featured category status for homepage prominence and promotional displays. Featured categories receive priority placement in marketing materials and navigation highlights. Used strategically for seasonal campaigns and high-performing product groups.

image.description: URL of category image used for visual navigation and promotional displays. Supports standard image formats (PNG, JPG, JPEG, WebP) with maximum 500 character URL length. Images enhance customer browsing experience and support merchandising strategies through visual category recognition.

meta_title.description: SEO-optimized page title for search engine ranking and visibility. Capped at 60 characters for optimal display in search results and browser tabs. Should include primary category keywords for maximum search engine effectiveness and customer click-through rates.

meta_description.description: SEO meta description for search engine results page snippets. Limited to 160 characters for optimal visibility and click-through rates from search listings. Should provide compelling summary text that encourages customer clicks while incorporating relevant category keywords.

meta_keywords.description: Comma-separated SEO keywords for search relevance optimization. Supports long-tail keywords and category-specific terms to enable enhanced search engine visibility for category pages. Limited to 500 characters to maintain keyword effectiveness and prevent spam classification by search engines.

created_at.description: Timestamp of category creation in the system. Used for audit tracking and organizational analysis across the marketplace catalog structure. Automatically set by system upon creation and never modified thereafter.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last category modification. Tracks changes to category properties, relationships, and configuration settings for audit purposes. Automatically updated by system upon any category property modification while preserving created_at timestamp integrity.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for category removal or archiving. Enables category cleanup while preserving historical references and maintaining audit trail integrity. Used for regulatory compliance and historical data analysis without permanently removing category records from the database.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary.description:
Comprehensive order item summary representing multi-seller marketplace transaction line items with complete business context for fulfillment, pricing, and customer service operations.

This summary provides essential order processing information for marketplace operations including seller attribution for commission calculations, product identification for inventory management, pricing details for financial tracking, and fulfillment status for logistics coordination. The summary maintains critical multi-seller context needed for complex marketplace workflows including cross-seller order processing, fulfillment coordination, and customer service resolution.

Order items track complete transaction lifecycle from creation through fulfillment including pricing snapshots, discount applications, tax calculations, shipping arrangements, and return eligibility. The summary enables efficient order browsing while maintaining the business context needed for accurate pricing, proper seller attribution, and comprehensive customer service support across the multi-seller marketplace ecosystem.

IShoppingMallProductReview.ICreate.description:
Product review submission data for creating new reviews in the marketplace.

This DTO enables customers to submit comprehensive product reviews including ratings, text content, and optional media attachments. The system validates purchase verification through order item linkage and enforces content quality standards. Reviews undergo approval workflows starting with pending status and unverified verification state until validated against actual purchases. 

Transforming FK references to complete objects enables atomic creation operations where the client can provide complete context rather than just raw identifiers. This improves developer experience and ensures Create DTO structure aligns with Response DTO return formats for consistent API patterns.

The optional orderItem field allows flexibility in review creation scenarios where complete order context may not be immediately available, providing better API usability for various client implementations.

rating.description: Updated overall product rating on scale of 1-5 stars. Validates customer satisfaction changes with purchase experience and product quality assessment updates.

title.description: Updated brief review title summarizing key points. Limited to 100 characters for search optimization. Used for review title modifications and corrections.

content.description: Updated detailed review content explaining customer experience. Minimum 50 characters ensures substantive feedback updates and corrections.

IShoppingMallProductReview.IUpdate.description:
Updated product review information submitted by authenticated customers for review modification operations.

This DTO enables customers to update their existing product reviews with revised ratings, titles, content, and associated entity references while maintaining authenticity through the original order item validation link. Updates are tracked with modification timestamps and may trigger re-submission to moderation workflows if significant content changes are detected.

The update operation preserves all original metadata including customer information, product references, and verification status while allowing text content revisions, rating adjustments, and reference updates. Content changes undergo validation for community standards compliance and maintain comprehensive audit trails for all modifications. Reference fields enable explicit ownership validation ensuring customers can only update their own reviews.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ICreate.description:
Request data for creating a new order item within an existing marketplace order.

This DTO supports atomic order creation workflows by enabling complete item specification including product selections, variant choices, seller attribution, and custom processing requirements in a single API call. It handles the complexity of multi-seller marketplace scenarios where individual items may have different fulfillment workflows, shipping requirements, and seller-specific pricing.

The Create DTO provides comprehensive control over item configuration while maintaining referential integrity and business rule validation. All fields support marketplace operations including quantity management, pricing specification, shipping allocation, and fulfillment customization needs.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.IRequest.description:
Search and filtering parameters for historical product snapshot retrieval operations.

Request provides comprehensive snapshot filtering including date range queries, specific field tracking, change comparison analysis, and advanced sorting options. Supports both basic date-based filtering and complex business intelligence queries for product evolution analysis.

Pagination controls enable efficient browsing of large historical datasets while optional field slicing optimizes data transfer for specific analysis requirements. Advanced options like revenue context inclusion and change field tracking provide deep insights into product performance evolution and business impact of catalog modifications.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.description:
Complete historical snapshot of product information for audit trail and version control purposes.

Represents the full state of a product at a specific point in time, capturing comprehensive business intelligence data including all pricing, content, configuration details, and marketplace relationships. Encapsulates the complete business context of product evolution including description updates, pricing strategy changes, category assignments, and variant availability transitions.

Snapshots enable sophisticated business analytics through temporal data trending, regulatory compliance through immutable historical records, and marketplace transparency through seller accountability tracking. Critical for tracking product performance across different versions, analyzing the impact of catalog changes on sales metrics, and maintaining regulatory audit trails for marketplace operations.

Integration points span multiple platform systems including inventory management for historical stock tracking, order processing for fulfillment analytics, category management for navigation evolution analysis, and customer review systems for social proof trending. Used extensively in seller dashboards for version comparison, administrative reporting for marketplace oversight, and business intelligence systems for competitive analysis and pricing optimization.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product snapshot. Primary key for snapshot reference and audit trail tracking.

name.description: Product name at the time of snapshot. Captures the marketing title and identification used during this specific historical period. Essential for displaying product information in historical context and maintaining consistency with historical user experiences.

description.description: Complete product description as it existed at snapshot time. Includes marketing copy, feature highlights, and detailed specifications. Preserves the complete product narrative and technical information that customers would have seen when making purchase decisions during this period.

price.description: Product base price at snapshot time. Represents the primary cost customers would pay before any discounts, promotions, or variant-specific pricing adjustments. Critical for historical price analysis and competitive tracking.

original_price.description: Original list price before any discounts or promotions at snapshot time. Enables calculation of savings amounts and promotional effectiveness analysis. Helps track pricing strategies and market positioning changes over time.

is_active.description: Product visibility and availability status at snapshot time. Indicates whether the product was purchasable and visible to customers during this period. Critical for understanding historical catalog state and inventory availability.

sku_code.description: Unique stock-keeping unit identifier used at snapshot time. Enables correlation with inventory systems and order fulfillment records. Essential for historical inventory tracking and product identification across systems.

category.description: Product category assignment at snapshot time. Represents the primary classification and navigation path customers would use to discover this product. Uses category reference with complete context for historical browsing analysis.

seller.description: Product seller/merchant information at snapshot time. Captures the business entity responsible for product listing, fulfillment, and customer service during this period. Critical for historical seller performance analysis and accountability tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product variant at snapshot time. Enables precise variant tracking and correlation with historical inventory records, order fulfillment data, and customer purchase patterns. Critical for maintaining data integrity across variant-specific transactions and supporting detailed historical analysis of product performance by variant.

name.description: Variant name or option description at snapshot time. Represents the customer-facing label for different product configurations such as size, color, material, or feature sets. Preserves the exact variant presentation that customers saw when making selection decisions, enabling analysis of variant naming strategies and customer preference patterns over time.

sku_code.description: Stock-keeping unit identifier for the specific variant at snapshot time. Provides unique identification for inventory tracking, order processing, and fulfillment coordination. Essential for correlating historical sales data with inventory movements and understanding variant-specific demand patterns and stock turnover rates.

price.description: Variant-specific price at snapshot time. Captures pricing differences between product configurations such as premium materials, additional features, or size variations. Critical for historical pricing analysis, variant profitability assessment, and understanding how pricing strategies evolved across different product options and market conditions.

is_active.description: Variant availability and visibility status at snapshot time. Indicates whether customers could purchase this specific variant configuration during the historical period. Essential for analyzing variant lifecycle management, inventory availability patterns, and understanding when specific product options were introduced, discontinued, or temporarily unavailable.

variants.description: Product variant configurations available at snapshot time. Represents different product options, sizes, colors, or configurations customers could select. Maintains complete variant structure for historical product selection analysis and inventory correlation.

categories.description: All product category assignments at snapshot time. Represents the complete taxonomy and discovery paths available to customers. Multiple category assignments enable cross-category product discovery and comprehensive historical catalog organization analysis.

units.description: Product unit definitions available at snapshot time. Defines different product configurations, bundles, or purchasing options. Preserves historical product structure and enables analysis of product presentation strategies over time.

reviews_count.description: Total number of product reviews at snapshot time. Provides historical social proof metrics and customer engagement indicators. Used for historical reputation analysis and customer satisfaction trend tracking without requiring separate review API calls.

average_rating.description: Average product rating calculated from all reviews at snapshot time. Represents customer satisfaction and product quality perception during this period. Essential for historical quality analysis and comparative product performance evaluation.

created_at.description: Original product creation timestamp. Establishes the product's timeline and market entry point. Critical for product lifecycle analysis and historical market presence tracking.

updated_at.description: Last product modification timestamp before snapshot. Indicates the most recent changes made to the product information. Helps identify update patterns and modification frequency for historical audit purposes.

snapshot_created_at.description: Timestamp when this historical snapshot was captured. Establishes the specific point in time this data represents. Critical for chronological analysis and understanding when this product state existed in the marketplace.

IShoppingMallCart.IRequest.description:
Comprehensive search criteria and advanced filtering parameters for shopping cart queries across the marketplace platform.

Provides sophisticated cart discovery capabilities with support for complex multi-parameter filtering including temporal ranges, status-based selection, ownership verification, commercial analytics, and lifecycle state management. Enables advanced cart management workflows from basic customer service through comprehensive marketplace analytics.

Extends beyond simple pagination to full-featured search operations supporting abandoned cart recovery, conversion analytics, inventory reservation tracking, and multi-seller marketplace coordination. Integrates with customer authentication systems, seller analytics workflows, and comprehensive shopping cart lifecycle management across the complete e-commerce platform.

Used extensively in customer service operations, seller analytics dashboards, platform administrative monitoring, and conversion optimization workflows requiring detailed cart state analysis and historical trending capabilities.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1

order_by.description: Sorting preference for cart results. Available options include created_at_asc, created_at_desc, updated_at_asc, updated_at_desc, expires_at_asc, expires_at_desc, item_count_asc, item_count_desc

status_filter.description: Cart lifecycle status filtering options. Allows selection of specific cart states for targeted analysis including active carts, abandoned carts awaiting recovery, or completed carts for conversion tracking

from.description: Earliest cart creation timestamp for temporal filtering. Supports querying for carts created after a specific point in time

to.description: Latest cart creation timestamp for temporal filtering. Supports querying for carts created before a specific point in time

created_at_filter.description: Cart creation date range filtering for temporal cart discovery and analytics

from.description: Earliest cart modification timestamp for temporal filtering

to.description: Latest cart modification timestamp for temporal filtering

updated_at_filter.description: Cart modification date range filtering for tracking recent cart activity and customer engagement patterns

from.description: Earliest cart expiration timestamp for lifecycle filtering

to.description: Latest cart expiration timestamp for lifecycle filtering

expires_at_filter.description: Cart expiration date range filtering for cleanup analytics and abandoned cart discovery

customer_id.description: Customer ownership identifier for filtered cart analysis. Enables query of carts belonging to specific customers for individual shopping behavior analysis

from.description: Earliest last activity timestamp for engagement filtering

to.description: Latest last activity timestamp for engagement filtering

last_activity_at_filter.description: Cart activity date range filtering for customer engagement analysis and session timeout evaluation

min.description: Minimum number of cart items for quantity filtering including empty carts with 0 items

max.description: Maximum number of cart items for quantity filtering

item_count_range.description: Cart item count range filtering for analyzing cart size patterns and identifying high-value versus small shopping sessions

min.description: Minimum number of distinct products for diversity filtering

max.description: Maximum number of distinct products for diversity filtering

product_count_range.description: Product count range filtering for cart diversity analysis and customer selection complexity evaluation

IShoppingMallCartItem.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and filtering shopping cart items across the multi-seller marketplace platform.

Enables comprehensive cart item discovery and analysis for customer-facing interfaces, administrative reporting, and seller analytics without exposing cart ownership relationships for security and privacy compliance.

Supports advanced querying by various cart item attributes including product information, seller relationships, pricing characteristics, and temporal patterns. Facilitates multi-dimensional analysis of customer shopping behavior, product performance, and marketplace trends while maintaining proper access controls and data segregation between sellers.

The filtering system accommodates complex marketplace scenarios including multi-seller cart compositions, cross-category shopping patterns, and promotional effectiveness tracking. All queries respect cart ownership boundaries and implement appropriate security measures for customer data protection.

search.description:
Product name or description search text utilizing full-text search capabilities. Matches against product names, descriptions, and SKU information for cart item discovery based on customer intent, product identification, or marketplace trend analysis.

Supports partial matching and relevance scoring for efficient product discovery within cart contexts. Enables quick identification of specific products across large cart inventories and facilitates customer service workflows for product-related inquiries.

product_id.description:
Filter cart items by specific product identifier to analyze product-level cart performance, inventory allocation patterns across customer sessions, and product popularity metrics within shopping cart contexts.

Enables sellers to track their product engagement within customer carts and provides marketplace administrators with comprehensive product performance analytics. Supports inventory planning and demand forecasting through cart-based product analysis.

product_variant_id.description:
Filter items by specific variant selections to understand customer preferences for particular product configurations including colors, sizes, materials, and other variant-specific options.

Provides detailed insights into variant popularity, customer configuration preferences, and variant-level inventory allocation patterns. Enables sellers to optimize their variant offerings and inventory levels based on actual customer selection patterns within shopping carts.

seller_id.description:
Filter cart items by seller identifier to view items from specific marketplace vendors for multi-seller cart analysis, seller-specific reporting, and vendor performance evaluation.

Essential for seller dashboard analytics, commission calculations, and multi-seller order fulfillment coordination. Enables sellers to monitor their product performance within customer carts while maintaining proper data segregation between marketplace vendors.

min_quantity.description:
Filter cart items by minimum quantity threshold to identify bulk purchase patterns, wholesale customer behavior, and high-volume purchase trends within the marketplace.

Enables analysis of bulk buying patterns, quantity-based discount eligibility, and inventory reservation requirements for large-quantity purchases. Supports seller inventory planning and bulk order fulfillment preparation.

max_quantity.description:
Filter cart items by maximum quantity threshold to exclude bulk purchases or focus on typical retail purchase patterns for standard customer behavior analysis.

Useful for identifying regular retail transactions, excluding wholesale or bulk purchases from standard analytics, and focusing on typical consumer shopping patterns. Supports marketplace fee calculations and standard service level analysis.

is_gift_wrapped.description:
Filter by gift wrapping selection to understand fulfillment preference patterns and service utilization across different customer segments, product categories, and seasonal trends.

Provides insights into customer service preferences, gift-oriented purchasing behavior, and special handling requirements for marketplace logistics planning. Enables analysis of premium service adoption and customer willingness to pay for additional services.

category_id.description:
Filter items by primary product category identifier to analyze category-specific cart patterns, product category performance in shopping cart contexts, and cross-category customer behavior.

Essential for category-level analytics, inventory planning by category, and understanding customer shopping patterns across different product segments. Supports marketplace category management and promotional campaign targeting.

created_after.description:
Filter items added to carts after specific timestamp to analyze new cart additions for trending products, seasonal purchase patterns, and time-based customer behavior analysis.

Supports temporal analysis of customer shopping patterns, product trend identification, and seasonal shopping behavior research. Enables comparison of cart activity across different time periods and promotional campaign effectiveness measurement.

created_before.description:
Filter items added to carts before specific timestamp for historical analysis, cart cleanup operations for expired sessions, and comparative shopping pattern analysis over time.

Useful for identifying abandoned cart patterns, analyzing historical shopping trends, and implementing cart lifecycle management policies. Supports data retention compliance and cart cleanup automation workflows.

oneOf.description: Sort results by item creation timestamp for chronological analysis of cart building patterns and customer engagement timeline tracking.
Sort results by item quantity to identify bulk purchase patterns and quantity-based customer segmentation for targeted marketing.
Sort results by individual unit price for price-sensitive analysis and customer budget preference identification.
Sort results by total line item price for transaction value analysis and high-value purchase identification.
Sort results by product name for alphabetical organization and product catalog browsing within cart contexts.
Sort results by product category name for category-based organization and cross-category shopping pattern analysis.
Sort results by seller name for vendor-based organization and multi-seller cart analysis capabilities.

sort_by.description:
Sort results by specific field to enable organized cart item presentation, pattern analysis, and customer preference identification through systematic data ordering.

Supports various analytical approaches including chronological tracking, price analysis, category-based organization, and seller-specific workflows. Each sort option provides unique insights into customer behavior and marketplace performance patterns.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort order for chronological progression, price low-to-high, or alphabetical organization depending on selected sort field.
Descending sort order for reverse chronological order, price high-to-low, or reverse alphabetical organization depending on selected sort field.

order.description:
Sort order direction with ascending or descending arrangement for cart item listings based on selected sort criteria and analytical requirements.

Enables flexible data presentation supporting various analytical needs from newest-first chronology to price-based prioritization. Essential for effective data visualization and user interface organization in cart management interfaces.

page.description:
Pagination page number for cart item result set division and navigation. Defaults to page 1 if not specified.

Enables efficient browsing of large cart inventories while maintaining optimal response performance. Supports user interface pagination controls and large dataset management for comprehensive cart analysis operations.

limit.description:
Number of items to return per page for cart item analysis and reporting. Maximum limit of 100 items to prevent response size issues while maintaining optimal API performance.

Balances comprehensive data retrieval with system performance considerations. Enables flexible page sizing based on interface requirements and data volume needs while preventing excessive resource utilization.

IShoppingMallCart.ICheckout.description:
Request DTO for converting a shopping cart into a marketplace order within the multi-seller e-commerce platform.

Coordinating complex checkout process that transforms shopping cart contents into formal marketplace orders while managing multi-seller payment processing, inventory commitment, and fulfillment coordination. Supports comprehensive checkout workflows including payment method selection, shipping preference configuration, and order customization options.

The checkout process validates cart integrity, confirms inventory availability, and coordinates payment processing across multiple sellers when necessary. Maintains cart data integrity while enabling seamless transition to order processing systems and initiating seller notification workflows for efficient marketplace operations.

Handles complex scenarios including multi-seller cart compositions, promotional code application, shipping coordination, and payment method management while ensuring proper financial reconciliation and commission calculations across all marketplace stakeholders.

paymentConfiguration.description:
Payment method selection and configuration options for order processing within the multi-seller marketplace checkout workflow.

Manages payment method selection, billing address specification, and payment credential storage preferences. Supports multiple payment types while maintaining security standards and customer convenience. Essential for coordinating complex multi-seller payment processing and commission calculations across marketplace vendors.

The payment configuration accommodates various scenarios including new payment method capture, saved payment method utilization, and billing address customization. Enables seamless integration with payment gateways while supporting marketplace-specific requirements like seller payout coordination and platform fee calculations.

paymentMethodId.description:
Identifier of the saved payment method to use for this order. If not provided, new payment method will be captured during checkout process. Enables reuse of previously stored payment credentials for streamlined customer experience.

Required when useSavedPaymentMethod is true. Links to customer's stored payment methods for quick checkout processing while maintaining security standards for payment data handling. Supports various payment method types including credit cards, digital wallets, and vendor-managed payment solutions.

useSavedPaymentMethod.description:
Whether to use a previously saved payment method for this order. Enables quick checkout processing for returning customers with stored payment credentials.

When true, requires paymentMethodId to specify which saved method to use. When false, customer will provide new payment information during checkout process. Essential for optimizing checkout conversion rates and reducing payment friction for repeat customers.

billingAddress.description:
Billing address for payment processing. May differ from shipping address if customer has separate billing and shipping addresses for business or personal organization preferences.

Provides complete billing information for payment authorization and financial record maintenance. Supports address verification systems and fraud prevention measures while accommodating customer preferences for billing location specification.

rememberPaymentMethod.description:
Whether to save this payment method for future orders. Enables convenient checkout experience for returning customers while maintaining compliance standards for payment data security.

Allows customers to store payment credentials securely for subsequent purchases, reducing checkout friction and improving conversion rates. Implements proper data retention policies and customer consent management for payment method storage.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Primary order entity managing multi-seller transactions and customer purchases across the marketplace platform. Coordinates complex order lifecycle from placement through fulfillment while maintaining comprehensive tracking for all stakeholders including customers, sellers, and platform administrators.

Represents complete customer purchasing transactions containing items from potentially multiple sellers, payment processing coordination, shipment tracking, and status management. Each order maintains comprehensive financial records, shipping information, and communication preferences while supporting complex fulfillment scenarios including split shipments and multi-seller coordination.

The order system manages inventory allocation, payment authorization, seller notification workflows, and customer communication throughout the entire purchase lifecycle. It integrates with inventory management systems for real-time stock updates, payment processing systems for secure transaction handling, and shipping providers for delivery tracking and customer notifications.

Orders maintain detailed audit trails for financial reconciliation, regulatory compliance, and dispute resolution while supporting various fulfillment models including direct seller shipping, platform-managed fulfillment, and third-party logistics integration. The system provides comprehensive reporting capabilities for customers, sellers, and platform administrators while ensuring proper financial accounting and commission calculations.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for this order in the shopping mall order system.

order_number.description: Order number for customer reference and communication. Generated automatically using format ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN and provides unique customer-visible order identification.

status.description: Current status of the order indicating lifecycle stage. Values: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded and tracks order progression through fulfillment workflow.

total_amount.description: Total amount of the order including all items, shipping, and fees. Represents complete financial transaction value for customer billing and seller commission calculations.

currency.description: Currency code for the transaction following ISO 4217 standards and provides standardized monetary value representation across international marketplace operations.

shipping_address.description: Shipping address where order will be delivered to customer and provides complete delivery location specification for logistics coordination.

billing_address.description: Billing address for payment and invoice purposes and provides complete billing information for financial record maintenance and customer communications.

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number for delivery coordination and provides contact information for shipping providers and delivery scheduling communications.

delivery_instructions.description: Additional delivery instructions or special requirements for courier. Optional field for customer-specific delivery preferences and requirements.

preferred_delivery_time.description: Preferred delivery time or scheduling requests from customer. Optional field for delivery timing and scheduling preferences and coordination.

requires_special_handling.description: Whether the order requires special handling or fragile item precautions during shipping. Controls shipping method selection and special processing requirements.

internal_notes.description: Any internal notes or flags about the order for customer service or fulfillment teams. Internal operational notes for marketplace staff and order processing coordination.

contains_multiple_sellers.description: Whether the order contains items from multiple sellers requiring coordinated fulfillment. Indicates complexity for fulfillment coordination and multi-seller order management.

payment_confirmed.description: Whether payment has been successfully completed and confirmed in system. Tracks payment status and financial authorization completion.

customer_confirmation_received.description: Customer's email confirmation that they will accept delivery or terms. Acknowledgment confirmation for order terms and delivery acceptance verification.

created_at.description: Timestamp when order was first placed by customer. Records order creation timing for chronological tracking and analytics purposes.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when order status was last updated. Records modification timing for change tracking and order lifecycle management.

cancelled_at.description: Timestamp when order was cancelled if applicable. Cancellation timing for order status tracking and cancellation analytics.

cancellation_reason.description: Cancellation reason provided by customer or system for audit purposes. Documentation for order cancellation analysis and reporting.

price_lock_expires_at.description: Price lock expiration for items in multi-step checkout process. Checkout timing control for price stability and customer purchase protection.

customer.description: Customer who placed the order. Associates order with customer account and provides customer context for marketplace operations.

customerSession.description: Session during which order was placed. Links order to customer authentication session for security tracking and audit trail maintenance.

guest.description: Guest user who placed the order. Links order to guest session for anonymous purchase tracking and session correlation.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.description:
Order line item representation mapping directly to shopping_mall_order_items database table columns without phantom fields. Contains transactional line details for individual product selections within multi-seller marketplace orders.

Provides complete order item context including product references, pricing snapshots, fulfillment tracking, and seller attribution. Maintains referential integrity across product catalog, seller profiles, and order header records through proper foreign key relationships.

Supports complex marketplace scenarios including variant-specific orders, seller-specific fulfillment workflows, and historical pricing preservation for audit compliance across distributed multi-seller transaction environments.

id.description: Primary key from shopping_mall_order_items.id - unique identifier for individual order line item across marketplace order processing systems and inventory allocation workflows.

order_id.description: Foreign key to shopping_mall_orders.id - establishes parent order relationship for grouping multiple items under single customer transaction with referential integrity validation.

product_id.description: Foreign key to shopping_mall_products.id - links item to specific product in catalog for inventory management, order tracking, and fulfillment coordination through product lifecycle.

oneOf.description: Optional reference to shopping_mall_product_variants.id - enables specific variant selection when applicable including size, color, configuration or other attribute variations.
Null value for products without variants or default variant selection scenarios in marketplace product configuration workflows.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Nullable foreign key to shopping_mall_product_variants.id - provides variant-specific identification when order includes customized product configurations like size, color or feature variations.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Foreign key to shopping_mall_seller.id - identifies merchant responsible for specific line item fulfillment, pricing, and customer service within multi-seller marketplace order.

quantity.description: Quantity column from shopping_mall_order_items.quantity - determines item count purchased for inventory deduction, shipping calculations, and fulfillment planning across seller operations.

unit_price.description: Unit price column from shopping_mall_order_items.unit_price - stores per-item pricing at time of order for historical accuracy and commission calculations in marketplace fee processing.

line_total.description: Line total column from shopping_mall_order_items.line_total - calculated total for line item including quantity and discounts for order summary display and seller revenue calculation.

oneOf.description: Null shipping cost indicates vendor-paid shipping, digital products, or combined shipping scenarios across marketplace order consolidation systems.
Positive number representing seller-specific shipping charges per item line for fulfillment cost tracking, shipping method coordination, and delivery logistics management.

shipping_cost.description: Nullable shipping cost from shopping_mall_order_items.shipping_cost - contains item-specific shipping charges calculated by seller or null for free shipping scenarios in multi-seller order environments.

oneOf.description: Null discount indicates regular pricing without promotional campaigns, sales events, or seller-specific discount offerings during standard purchasing workflows.
Positive number representing line-specific discount amount including percentage discounts, fixed amount reductions, or promotional codes applied at order creation time.

discount_amount.description: Nullable discount amount from shopping_mall_order_items.discount_amount - contains promotional savings specific to individual line item or null for standard pricing in marketplace discount management systems.

variant_sku.description: SKU column from shopping_mall_order_items.variant_sku - unique product variant identifier for inventory tracking, order fulfillment, and seller inventory management with vendor-specific stock keeping unit standards.

product_name_snapshot.description: Product name snapshot from shopping_mall_order_items.product_name_snapshot - preserves product name at order time for historical accuracy against catalog changes, price modifications, or seller terminology updates in marketplace product catalog evolution.

oneOf.description: Null instructions indicate standard fulfillment procedures without special requirements for standard packaging, shipping, or delivery coordination within marketplace seller operations.
Custom fulfillment instructions for item-specific packing, handling, shipping preferences, or delivery requirements for specialized product categories or customer service enhancements.

fulfillment_instructions.description: Nullable fulfillment instructions from shopping_mall_order_items.fulfillment_instructions - contains seller-specific shipping preferences when applicable or null for standard marketplace fulfillment through established vendor processes and shipping protocols.

seller_confirmed.description: Seller confirmation from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_confirmed - indicates seller acknowledgment of item availability, pricing accuracy, and fulfillment capability within marketplace seller workflow confirmation systems.

oneOf.description: Null tracking number indicates non-shipped, backordered, cancelled, or in-process fulfillment stages within seller-specific order processing and marketplace order lifecycle management.
Valid carrier tracking number provided by seller after shipment departure for customer package tracking, delivery coordination, and marketplace shipment notification systems integration.

seller_tracking_number.description: Nullable seller tracking from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_tracking_number - contains valid carrier tracking identifier after seller shipment or null for pre-shipment order stages across marketplace fulfillment workflows.

oneOf.description: Valid datetime when seller completed order processing preparation including inventory allocation, quality checking, packaging completion, and order-ready status updates for marketplace transaction progression.
Null timestamp for items awaiting seller processing in marketplace order queues before fulfillment readiness confirmation and subsequent shipping preparation stages in seller workflow systems.

seller_processed_at.description: Nullable seller processing timestamp from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_processed_at - records preparation completion time when item is ready for shipment or null for items awaiting fulfillment in marketplace seller order processing pipeline.

oneOf.description: Shipping departure timestamp when carrier accepted package from seller facility for marketplace customer delivery including carrier handoff confirmation, logistics integration, and customer notification trigger events.
Null timestamp for items in pre-shipping stages including inventory preparation, quality assurance, or within seller processing workflows before handoff to carrier for customer delivery coordination.

seller_shipped_at.description: Nullable shipping timestamp from shopping_mall_order_items.seller_shipped_at - indicates exact carrier handoff time when seller completed shipment or null for items in pre-dispatch preparation stages throughout marketplace fulfillment process.

oneOf.description: Positive price adjustment amount representing post-order pricing modifications including tax corrections, shipping fee adjustments, or final calculated totals in marketplace order completion workflows.

Null adjustment indicates original pricing maintained throughout order lifecycle without marketplace-required corrections during final processing, tax calculation, or seller price synchronization scenarios.

price_adjustment.description: Nullable price adjustment from shopping_mall_order_items.price_adjustment - contains marketplace pricing corrections or seller synchronization adjustments applied after original order or null when original pricing remains accurate throughout order completion.

gift_wrap_requested.description: Gift wrapping column from shopping_mall_order_items.gift_wrap_requested - indicates customer preference for decorative packaging and customised wrapping services when selecting gift delivery options during marketplace checkout process.

oneOf.description: Null customization indicates standard product fulfillment without personalized modifications, special requirements, or customer-specific variations within marketplace product catalog standard configurations.

Customization instructions for personalized products, special handling, or customer-specific modifications enabling marketplace sellers to fulfill unique customer requirements and bespoke product requests within variant configuration limits.

customization_notes.description: Nullable customization notes from shopping_mall_order_items.customization_notes - contains customer personalization instructions when applicable or null for standard product fulfillment without marketplace-specific product modifications or custom parameter requirements.

oneOf.description: Null backup reference indicates primary fulfillment path with no marketplace coordination, order splitting, seller handoff, or backup processing scenarios in standard single-order completion workflows.

Alternative order reference for multi-seller coordination including order splitting events, seller transfer processing, backup fulfillment scenarios, or marketplace inventory redistribution system references during complex multi-party order management.

backup_order_reference.description: Nullable backup reference from shopping_mall_order_items.backup_order_reference - contains marketplace coordination identifier for complex multi-seller order management or null for standard single-seller fulfillment without distribution or backup processing requirements.

IShoppingMallOrder.IRequest.description:
Order search criteria and pagination parameters for advanced order filtering across the marketplace platform. This DTO enables comprehensive search capabilities supporting query complexity appropriate for different marketplace actors including customers, sellers, and administrators.

The request structure supports multi-dimensional filtering including status-based filtering, date range selections, and financial criteria. Granular control enables appropriate data access for different user roles while maintaining security boundaries and performance optimization.

Search capabilities include order status progression tracking, payment confirmation validation, multi-seller identification, and comprehensive date range analysis. Pagination support enables efficient handling of large result sets common in high-volume marketplace operations.

The system ensures appropriate data access boundaries where customers access only own orders, sellers view orders containing their products, and administrators access platform-wide order data. All queries maintain security constraints while providing comprehensive search functionality across the distributed order ecosystem.

CRITICAL SECURITY: Authentication context (customerId, sellerId) is managed by JWT tokens, not request parameters. The system automatically restricts data access based on the authenticated user's role and permissions.

page.description: Page number for paginated results starting from 1. Navigation through large result sets with controlled pagination.

limit.description: Number of results per page with maximum of 100 for performance management. Query result size control for optimal performance and user experience.

oneOf.description: Text-based search for order numbers, product names, and customer-relevant text attributes. Comprehensive text search limited to appropriate data visibility boundaries.

search.description: Text-based search for order numbers, product names, and customer-relevant text attributes. Comprehensive text search limited to appropriate data visibility boundaries.

statuses.description: Order status filtering allowing multiple status selection simultaneously. Comprehensive status management for complex order queries across lifecycle stages.

IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary.description:
Order summary representation containing only fields that exist in the shopping_mall_orders database table. This schema provides essential order metadata for list operations while maintaining direct correspondence to database schema columns.

Utilizes order-specific database columns including primary identifier, timestamp tracking for audit purposes, and cancellation state management. Designed for efficient database queries and proper relational integrity through foreign key references.

References shopping_mall_customer via customer_id relationship while maintaining performance optimization for order listing and dashboard operations across customer, seller, and administrative interfaces.

id.description: Primary key identifier from shopping_mall_orders.id - unique system reference for order tracking and customer service operations.

customer_id.description: Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_customer.id - links the order to the purchasing customer account for buyer identification and profile referencing.

seller_id.description: Foreign key reference to shopping_mall_seller.id - identifies the selling merchant responsible for order fulfillment and business relationship management.

created_at.description: Timestamp column from shopping_mall_orders.created_at - records order creation time for chronological sorting, audit trails, and analytics reporting with UTC timezone standardization.

updated_at.description: Timestamp column from shopping_mall_orders.updated_at - tracks most recent order modification for status change monitoring and data synchronization across marketplace systems.

oneOf.description: Cancellation timestamp from shopping_mall_orders.cancelled_at column for completed cancellation events with precise datetime tracking and localization support.
Null value representing active orders that have not been cancelled within the marketplace platform order lifecycle management system.

cancelled_at.description: Nullable datetime column from shopping_mall_orders table - contains specific cancellation timestamp for cancelled orders or null for active orders in marketpace lifecycle tracking.

IShoppingMallOrderPayment.description:
Financial transaction records coordinating order processing with payment system integration. Handles payment authorization, processing fees, seller allocation, and settlement tracking while maintaining comprehensive audit trail for financial reconciliation and dispute resolution across marketplace transactions.

Represents the financial coordination layer between customer orders and payment processing. Each payment record manages the allocation of funds across multiple parties including customers, sellers, and the platform while tracking fees, commissions, and settlement processes.

Payment records maintain detailed breakdowns of transaction amounts, processing fees, platform commissions, and seller net amounts while supporting complex payment scenarios including split payments, refunds, and multi-seller transactions. The system ensures accurate financial tracking and regulatory compliance through comprehensive audit trails.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the order payment record.

order.description: Order being paid for through this payment record. Provides complete order context including customer information, total amounts, and status for immediate understanding of payment relationship.

seller.description: Seller receiving this payment portion if multi-seller split. Contains seller business information for payment allocation context and seller attribution understanding.

payment_type.description: Type of payment record. Values: customer_payment, platform_commission, seller_payout, refund. Defines the payment processing workflow.

amount.description: Amount associated with this payment record component. Actual monetary value for the payment transaction.

currency.description: Currency code for the payment amounts following ISO 4217 standards. Ensures proper currency handling and conversion.

platform_commission.description: Platform commission amount deducted from seller portion. Marketplace fee for facilitating the transaction.

processing_fees.description: Payment processing fees charged by external providers. Gateway and processing service costs.

seller_net_amount.description: Net amount available for payout to seller after all deductions. Final amount received by seller.

status.description: Status of this payment record within order processing workflow. Tracks payment lifecycle and processing state.

settlement_date.description: Settlement date when funds will be available for payout or processing. Manages fund availability timing.

provider_reference.description: Reference number for payment service provider tracking and reconciliation. Used for external system integration.

tax_breakdown.description: Tax calculation details and breakdown information for financial reporting. Contains detailed tax allocation.

is_reconciled.description: Whether this payment component has been reconciled with accounting records. Financial accuracy tracking flag.

accounting_reference.description: Accounting ledger entries or journal references for bookkeeping. Integration reference for financial systems.

has_dispute.description: Whether customer disputes or chargebacks affect this payment record. Tracks dispute status and resolution.

created_at.description: Timestamp when payment record was created for audit trail.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when payment details were last modified.

order_items.description: Individual items being ordered with their quantities, variants, and configurations. Each item represents a specific product selection including variant choices, seller attribution, pricing details, and customization requirements. The array supports multi-seller marketplace scenarios where items may come from different sellers requiring independent fulfillment workflows and shipping coordination.

shipping_address.description: Complete shipping address where the order will be delivered to customer. Must include full street address, city, state/province, postal code, and country information formatted according to local postal standards. This address is used for delivery coordination, shipping label generation, and customer communication throughout the fulfillment process.

billing_address.description: Complete billing address for payment and invoice purposes. Must include all necessary billing information including street address, city, state/province, postal code, and country details. Used for payment processing verification, invoice generation, and financial record keeping in compliance with accounting standards.

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number for delivery coordination and shipping updates. Should be provided in international format including country code for reliable contact during delivery scheduling and shipment tracking communications. Critical for last-mile delivery coordination and customer service interactions.

oneOf.description: Additional delivery instructions or special requirements for courier.

delivery_instructions.description: Additional delivery instructions or special requirements for courier. Optional field allowing customers to provide specific delivery preferences such as building access codes, preferred delivery times, special handling requirements, or location details that facilitate successful delivery completion.

oneOf.description: Customer's preferred delivery window or scheduling preference.

preferred_delivery_time.description: Preferred delivery time or scheduling requests from customer. ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking. Captures the customer's device IP for security monitoring, fraud detection, and session correlation across multiple devices. Supports comprehensive audit trails and geographic analysis for marketplace security operations.

href.description: Connection URL - current page URL for session tracking. referrer.description: Referrer URL - previous page URL for session tracking. IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.description:
Order creation request data for initiating new marketplace transactions in the shopping mall platform.

This DTO serves as the primary entry point for converting customer shopping carts into formal marketplace orders while coordinating complex multi-seller transactions and initializing payment processing workflows. The creation process handles the entire scope of marketplace operations including inventory verification, seller validation, pricing confirmation, and payment initialization across potentially multiple sellers within a single order.

The operation supports both single-seller and multi-seller scenarios while maintaining referential integrity across products, customers, and payment systems throughout complex transaction orchestration processes. It integrates with inventory management for real-time stock verification, payment gateway systems for secure transaction initiation, and seller notification workflows for order processing coordination.

Critical fields include comprehensive customer contact information for delivery coordination, detailed shipping and billing addresses for fulfillment accuracy, and session context for security monitoring and comprehensive audit trails throughout the customer journey. Understanding order creation requirements is essential for marketplace functionality and enables complete transaction auditing while supporting complex scenarios such as multi-seller order splitting and independent fulfillment processing workflows.

shipping_address.description: Complete shipping address where the order will be delivered to customer. Can be updated to accommodate address corrections, delivery location changes, or customer relocation before order processing begins. Address changes may trigger shipping cost recalculation and delivery timeline adjustments depending on carrier capabilities and destination modifications.

billing_address.description: Complete billing address for payment and invoice purposes. Supports billing address corrections and updates for accurate financial record keeping, tax calculations, and invoice generation. Changes may require payment method re-validation and could affect tax calculations based on jurisdiction differences.

customer_phone.description: Customer's phone number for delivery coordination and shipping updates. Allows contact information updates for improved delivery communication, shipping provider coordination, and customer service interactions. Critical for maintaining accurate delivery contact information throughout the fulfillment process.

oneOf.description: Updated delivery instructions or special requirements for courier.

delivery_instructions.description: Additional delivery instructions or special requirements for courier. Can be modified to add new delivery preferences, update special handling requirements, or provide additional context for successful delivery completion. Changes may affect shipping costs if special services are required.

oneOf.description: Updated preferred delivery window or scheduling preference.

preferred_delivery_time.description: Preferred delivery time or scheduling requests from customer. Allows modification of delivery timing preferences to accommodate customer availability, schedule changes, or updated delivery constraints. Changes may require coordination with shipping providers and could affect delivery timelines.

requires_special_handling.description: Whether the order requires special handling or fragile item precautions during shipping. Can be toggled to add or remove special processing requirements based on updated product information or customer preferences. Changes automatically trigger fulfillment workflow updates and may affect shipping costs and processing timelines.

IShoppingMallOrder.IUpdate.description:
Order update request data for modifying existing marketplace transactions within the shopping mall platform.

This DTO provides flexibility for customers to adjust critical order information including shipping addresses, contact details, and delivery preferences before processing begins while maintaining order integrity and protecting marketplace operations through business rule constraints. The update process accommodates legitimate customer requests within defined operational boundaries that ensure seller protection and fulfillment accuracy.

Update capabilities are constrained by business rules based on order status and processing stage, with modifications typically allowed for orders in 'pending' or 'processing' states while restrictions increase as orders progress through fulfillment workflows. The system validates all changes against inventory availability, seller policies, payment processing requirements, and shipping logistics constraints to maintain operational integrity.

The operation maintains comprehensive audit trails documenting all changes with timestamps and attribution for accountability, dispute resolution, and customer service support. Critical for marketplace customer experience while balancing operational security through transparent change tracking and comprehensive accountability mechanisms throughout the complex order management lifecycle.

search.description:
Free-text search field for locating specific order items across the marketplace platform. Enables searching across multiple field types including product names displayed at time of order, product variant SKU codes, and seller identification codes.

This search capability supports customer service operations where agents need to quickly locate items in large orders, marketplace administrators monitoring order activity, and sellers managing their specific product fulfillment. The search engine matches partial text and handles typos through fuzzy matching algorithms.

Search results are ranked by relevance with factors including exact keyword matches, frequency of terms in the product name snapshot, and recency of order placement. This enables efficient navigation through complex multi-seller orders containing potentially dozens of individual items.

page.description:
Pagination control for navigating through large collections of order items. Represents the current page number in search results, starting from 1 for the first page.

Essential for handling multi-seller marketplace orders that can contain dozens or hundreds of items when customers make large purchases. The pagination system prevents timeouts and memory issues while providing smooth user experience for browsing extensive order contents.

Page navigation is calculated based on the limit parameter, with results sorted according to the order_by and order parameters. This enables efficient data discovery without overwhelming the client with massive result sets, particularly important for administrative dashboards and customer service interfaces.

limit.description:
Controls the number of order items returned in a single API response, with a maximum of 100 items per page and minimum of 1 item to prevent empty results.

This pagination constraint is critical for marketplace performance optimization, as multi-seller orders can be extremely large with hundreds of individual items spread across multiple sellers. The limit ensures responsive performance across web interfaces, mobile applications, and administrative dashboards.

Larger limits reduce the number of API calls needed for large orders but may impact response times for complex multi-seller items requiring database joins across products, sellers, and fulfillment data. The maximum of 100 items provides balance between usability and performance.

fulfillment_status.description:
Order item fulfillment tracking status that operates independently of overall order status in the multi-seller marketplace environment. Valid statuses include: pending (awaiting seller confirmation), confirmed (seller acknowledges item availability), processing (seller preparing for shipment), shipped (item departed seller location), delivered (item received by customer), and cancelled (item removed from order).

This status field enables sophisticated multi-seller order management where individual items can have different fulfillment timelines and shipping arrangements. For example, a customer order might contain items from three different sellers - one item could be delivered while another is still being processed.

The independent item-level status is crucial for accurate customer communication, marketplace dashboard reporting, and seller-specific fulfillment workflows. Each seller manages their own fulfillment timeline while customers track items independently, creating transparency in complex multi-seller transactions.

seller_code.description:
Business identifier code for marketplace sellers using an alphanumeric string format rather than UUID for intuitive operations. This represents the seller's business identification code used throughout the marketplace platform for operations, reporting, and customer-facing displays.

Filtering by seller code enables sophisticated marketplace operations including seller-specific order management, commission calculations, and seller dashboard reporting. Sellers can isolate their specific portions of multi-customer orders for efficient fulfillment processing and financial reconciliation.

This field is essential for marketplace administrators monitoring seller performance, resolving disputes, and collecting platform fees. The business code format makes it human-readable for customer service operations where sellers must be quickly identified across hundreds of marketplace sellers.
