Sort results by specified field
Sort results by specified field
Sort results by specified field

order_by.description:
Column selection for search result sorting that controls the ordering presentation of order items. Supports sorting by: created_at (order item addition timestamp), updated_at (last modification timestamp), unit_price (individual item price), quantity (number of items ordered), line_total (total price including quantity and discounts).

This sorting flexibility enables diverse marketplace use cases including price-based analysis for customer budgeting, quantity-based inventory management for sellers, and chronological tracking for order monitoring. The sorting system supports both ascending and descending orders through the order parameter.

Business users utilize different sort patterns for various operational workflows - customer service agents might sort by recent updates to see modification history, while sellers might sort by line totals for financial reconciliation, and administrators might sort by unit prices for marketplace analysis.

oneOf.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending, desc for descending
Sort direction: asc for ascending, desc for descending

order.description:
Directional control for result ordering with ascending (oldest first, lowest price first) or descending (newest first, highest price first) arrangement options.

Ascending order is preferred for natural chronological reading where users expect to see earliest items first, such as order history reviews or budget-conscious price comparisons showing lowest prices upward. This natural progression works well for tracking order development over time.

Descending order excels for prioritization workflows where most recent or most expensive items are most important, such as administrative dashboards focusing on recent activity or financial analysis prioritizing high-value transactions. The choice affects user experience patterns across different marketplace applications including seller dashboards, customer service tools, and administrative interfaces.

unit_price_min.description:
Minimum price threshold for filtering order items based on individual unit pricing. Uses a non-negative numeric value representing the lowest acceptable price per individual item unit, enabling sophisticated financial analysis across the marketplace platform.

This filter supports budget analysis scenarios where users need to identify high-value items within orders for financial planning or risk assessment. Customer service agents use it to identify expensive items requiring special attention or warranty tracking, while sellers apply it for pricing strategy analysis and competitive positioning.

The minimum price filter integrates with marketplace-wide price analytics, enabling administrators to identify price trends by filtering high-value items and analyzing seller behavior patterns. This supports both customer service operations and marketplace business intelligence through granular price-based item discovery.

unit_price_max.description:
Maximum price ceiling for filtering order items based on individual unit pricing. Uses a non-negative numeric value representing the highest acceptable price per individual item unit, enabling cost-conscious filtering across marketplace operations.

This maximum threshold is essential for budget analysis where organizations need to identify order items within specific price ranges for approval workflows, reimbursement policies, or financial auditing. Customer service operations often focus on items within certain price ranges that have different return policies or warranty coverage.

Marketplace administrators utilize maximum price filtering for competitive analysis, identifying pricing patterns across sellers and monitoring for potential price manipulation or unusual pricing behaviors. This helps maintain marketplace integrity while supporting customer service and seller management operations.

quantity_min.description:
Minimum quantity threshold for filtering order items, requiring at least 1 item to prevent negative filtering. Enables identification of orders with substantial item quantities for inventory management, bulk discount analysis, or shipping logistics planning.

This filter supports marketplace operations including bulk order management where large quantities might qualify for shipping discounts or special handling processes. Sellers use minimum quantity filters to identify orders requiring inventory allocation planning or special fulfillment workflows for large quantities.

Customer service applications include identifying orders with substantial quantities that might have different return policies, warranty requirements, or fulfillment complexities. The minimum quantity constraint helps distinguish between individual consumer purchases and bulk orders for tailored marketplace service approaches.

quantity_max.description:
Maximum quantity ceiling for filtering order items, requiring at least 1 item and enabling identification of bulk purchases for specialized marketplace handling. This constraint helps distinguish between individual consumer orders and wholesale transactions requiring different fulfillment approaches.

The maximum quantity filter is essential for marketplace operations where bulk items may require special shipping arrangements, extended fulfillment timelines, or seller-specific terms and conditions. Customers ordering large quantities often need coordination between multiple sellers for multi-seller marketplace orders.

Administrative reporting utilizes maximum quantity filtering to analyze marketplace purchasing patterns, identify business vs. consumer behavior, and adjust commission structures or seller requirements accordingly. This supports marketplace business intelligence while enabling operational differentiation between standard and bulk commerce operations.

date_from.description:
Temporal filtering boundary starting point using ISO 8601 date-time format for identifying order items created after this specific timestamp. This chronological filter enables date-range analysis across marketplace operations with absolute precision.

The from-date boundary supports comprehensive temporal analysis including seasonal marketplace patterns, seller performance tracking over time periods, and customer service escalation analysis for order aging. The precise timestamp enables integration with supply chain analytics and fulfillment timeline tracking across the multi-seller marketplace ecosystem.

Marketplace metrics analysis often combines date_from filters with other criteria to analyze seller performance during specific campaigns, seasonal shopping patterns, or policy effectiveness over specified time periods. This temporal precision supports both operational monitoring and strategic business intelligence gathering.

date_to.description:
Temporal filtering boundary endpoint using ISO 8601 date-time format for identifying order items created before this specific timestamp. This creates an absolute time boundary that enables precise date-range analysis across marketplace operations.

The to-date boundary is frequently paired with date_from to create specific time windows for marketplace analysis, such as monthly performance reviews, quarterly seller evaluations, or campaign effectiveness assessment within defined temporal bounds. This enables comprehensive operational reporting and performance monitoring.

When combined with other filters such as seller_code or fulfillment_status, temporal boundaries enable sophisticated marketplace analysis including seller behavior changes over time, policy impact assessment, and performance improvement monitoring. The precision enables detailed business intelligence gathering for marketplace optimization and strategic planning initiatives.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IRequest.description:
Advanced search and filtering parameters for shopping mall order item discovery with extensive marketplace operational support.

This DTO enables sophisticated order item analysis across multi-seller marketplace environments through comprehensive filtering capabilities including price ranges, quantity thresholds, fulfillment status tracking, temporal boundaries, and seller-specific identification. The filtering system supports complex operational workflows including customer service case management, seller performance monitoring, marketplace financial reconciliation, and business intelligence reporting.

The parameters provide granular control over order item retrieval with support for complex search queries, multi-criteria filtering, dynamic sorting, and efficient pagination for handling large marketplace data sets. This enables marketplace operators, sellers, customer service agents, and administrators to efficiently locate and analyze specific order items within potentially massive multi-seller order collections.

Leverages fuzzy text search algorithms, price-based financial analysis, quantity-based inventory tracking, chronologically-based performance monitoring, and seller-specific marketplace segmentation to empower sophisticated marketplace operations while maintaining responsive performance and system stability through intelligent filtering and pagination controls across the enterprise-grade marketplace platform.

quantity.description:
Modification of item quantity within the order, supporting scenarios including customer-requested quantity changes, inventory constraint adjustments, or seller capacity modifications. Requires a minimum value of 1 to prevent zero-quantity order lines that could invalidate marketplace transactions.

Quantity updates trigger complex marketplace logic including automatic line total recalculation, order subtotal updates, and commission recalculation across the multi-seller marketplace platform. This recalculation maintains financial accuracy while preserving audit trails through the order item modification history tracked in the updated timestamp field.

Business constraints include inventory availability validation, seller confirmation status checking, and order state verification that prevents modifications to locked or completed orders. The system may automatically cancel or modify fulfillment workflows, generate customer notifications, or trigger approval workflows for large quantity changes that affect overall marketplace financial calculations within strict audit compliance frameworks.

unit_price.description:
Price modification for individual item units, supporting correction of pricing errors, promotional discount applications, or marketplace policy-driven price adjustments. Must be non-negative to prevent invalid financial transactions within the multi-seller ecosystem.

Price updates immediately trigger automatic recalculation of the line_total field, potentially affecting order subtotals, seller commission calculations, and marketplace fee structures. The system maintains comprehensive audit trails of price modifications including timestamps, modifying entities, and reason codes for marketplace compliance and seller financial reconciliation with detailed change history preservation.

Marketplace-specific logic includes price lock validation that prevents modifications after specific order states, competitive pricing constraint checking to maintain marketplace integrity, and automatic customer notification generation for significant price changes that might affect purchase decisions or customer satisfaction within the complex multi-seller environment requiring strict financial accuracy and regulatory compliance.

shipping_cost.description:
Modification of item-specific shipping costs supporting multi-seller marketplace functionality where individual items may have different shipping arrangements, seller warehouse locations, or special delivery requirements. Must be non-negative to maintain valid transaction accounting with comprehensive financial integrity protection.

Shipping cost updates enable marketplace scenarios including seller-initiated shipping cost corrections, special handling fee additions, or delivery service level upgrades within the multi-seller order fulfillment framework. The modification maintains transaction integrity while reflecting actual fulfillment costs across diverse marketplace seller operations requiring accurate cost allocation and financial reconciliation.

Complex business logic governs shipping cost modification including seller authorization verification, fulfillment status constraint checking, and customer communication requirements. The system ensures cost modifications are transparent to customers while maintaining accurate financial transaction records across the multi-seller marketplace platform with proper audit trails, commission adjustments, and reconciliation capabilities supporting complex financial workflows and platform fee calculations.

discount_amount.description:
Modification of line-item discount amounts supporting promotional price adjustments, loyalty program discounts, or marketplace-sanctioned price modifications. Must be non-negative to prevent negative pricing scenarios within marketplace transaction accounting with comprehensive financial protection protocols.

Discount adjustments support sophisticated marketplace scenarios including seller-initiated promotional pricing, platform-wide campaign participation, or customer service gesture discounts within the multi-seller ecosystem. The modification preserves financial accuracy while enabling flexible pricing strategies across marketplace sellers with comprehensive audit trail maintenance and commission recalculation integration.

Marketplace-specific validation includes discount approval workflows for significant amounts, customer notification requirements for promotional price changes, and integration with loyalty program systems for point-based discount management. The system maintains marketplace integrity through transparent pricing while supporting flexible commercial arrangements between sellers, platform operators, and participating customers with comprehensive compliance monitoring and financial reconciliation accuracy.

fulfillment_status.description:
Update of item-level fulfillment progression status within the multi-seller marketplace order management system. Valid status values include: pending (awaiting seller action), confirmed (seller acknowledges availability), processing (seller preparing shipment), shipped (item departed seller location), delivered (item successfully delivered), or cancelled (item removed or order modification).

Fulfillment status updates enable independent seller management of individual items within complex multi-seller orders where different sellers maintain separate fulfillment timelines, shipping arrangements, and delivery schedules. This granular status tracking provides transparency for customer tracking and enables sophisticated marketplace operations coordination with comprehensive visibility across diverse seller operations.

Status transition validation includes business rule enforcement preventing invalid state changes, customer notification automation for significant milestone events, and integration with marketplace-wide analytics for performance monitoring and average fulfillment time calculations. The system maintains comprehensive audit trails of all status changes including timing, authorized entities, and transition reasons for both customer service operations and seller performance analytics with detailed historical tracking and compliance monitoring.

fulfillment_instructions.description:
Modification of special handling instructions for marketplace sellers managing complex fulfillment scenarios including gift wrapping requests, custom packaging requirements, specialized shipping handling, or product-specific delivery arrangements within the multi-seller order environment with comprehensive customer service integration.

Special instruction updates support customer personalization requests, seller-specific fulfillment capabilities, platform-wide fulfillment policy enforcement, or customer service-mediated resolution of fulfillment disputes within complex multi-seller marketplace operations. The system ensures instruction visibility to appropriate sellers while maintaining customer privacy and platform security requirements with sophisticated access control and privacy protection protocols.

Business constraints include instruction length limits for system performance optimization, content filtering for marketplace appropriateness compliance, and seller capability verification ensuring specific instructions can be accommodated within individual seller fulfillment operations. Marketplace administrators monitor instruction content for seller compliance while using the field for dispute resolution and customer satisfaction enhancement across the platform ecosystem with operational quality assurance and service standardization protocols.

seller_confirmed.description:
Modification of seller availability confirmation status that validates product availability and seller readiness to fulfill specific order items within the multi-seller marketplace environment. This boolean state directly impacts marketplace reliability and customer satisfaction through accurate availability representation and transaction integrity maintenance.

Confirmation modifications support sophisticated marketplace workflows including inventory validation after order placement, seller-initiated availability corrections when product availability changes between order placement and fulfillment, and customer service authorization for transaction modifications when seller confirmation fails in complex multi-seller order scenarios. The field enables marketplace operational resilience while maintaining transaction accuracy and system integrity.

Marketplace validation rules govern confirmation state changes including integration with inventory management systems, notification requirements for confirmation failure scenarios, and transaction cancellation workflows when confirmation cannot be obtained from marketplace sellers. The system uses confirmation status for seller performance analytics, dispute resolution procedures, and platform-wide fulfillment reliability metrics with comprehensive operational monitoring and quality assurance protocols.

seller_tracking_number.description:
Modification of carrier tracking numbers assigned by marketplace sellers after item shipment departure, enabling customer package tracking and delivery coordination across diverse shipping providers and fulfillment methods within the multi-seller marketplace ecosystem with comprehensive delivery visibility integration.

Carrier tracking modifications support multi-seller order scenarios where individual items have separate shipping carriers, delivery timelines, and shipment reference numbers within unified customer order contexts. This enables customer self-service tracking coordination while providing customer service agents comprehensive shipment visibility across multiple seller fulfillment operations within complex order management scenarios.

System integration includes carrier API validation for tracking number authenticity, automatic customer notification deployment for significant shipment milestone events, and fallback mechanisms for carriers lacking real-time tracking integration. The field supports marketplace-wide shipping analytics, seller performance validation, and comprehensive delivery dispute resolution while maintaining delivery audit trails and e-commerce platform integration supporting diverse marketplace operational requirements and customer satisfaction optimization initiatives.

seller_processed_at.description:
Temporal timestamp modification indicating when marketplace sellers completed item-specific processing operations including inventory allocation, packaging completion, or fulfillment preparation within their individual warehouse and shipping operations across the multi-seller marketplace environment with comprehensive operational analytics integration.

Processing timestamp modifications enable marketplace-wide performance analytics including average fulfillment processing times calculation, individual seller efficiency monitoring, and customer delivery expectation validation across diverse marketplace seller operations with comprehensive metric collection and performance assessment capabilities. The field supports operational coordination and strategic business intelligence for platform optimization initiatives with detailed temporal analysis and seller comparison capabilities.

Timestamp validation includes integration with business hour consideration for shipping timeline accuracy in multi-timezone marketplace operations, automatic calculation systems for average processing duration analytics, and timezone normalization across diverse seller geographic locations for accurate performance benchmarking. The field enables sophisticated seller performance monitoring including procedural efficiency evaluation and competitive benchmarking across marketplace participants with comprehensive temporal analysis supporting operational optimization and seller development programs.

seller_shipped_at.description:
Temporal timestamp modification indicating actual shipment departure from marketplace seller facilities, marking the transition from seller preparation to carrier responsibility within the multi-seller order fulfillment workflow while enabling sophisticated delivery timeline calculation and customer expectation management across complex transaction scenarios.

Shipment timestamp updates support complex marketplace coordination including carrier pickup scheduling, delivery timeline synchronization across multiple sellers within single customer orders, and integration with customer notification systems announcing shipment departure across different carriers and shipping methods within unified multi-seller order contexts requiring comprehensive logistics coordination.

Comprehensive system integration includes automatic customer notification deployment for significant shipment milestones, delivery timeline calculation with carrier service level agreement integration, and cross-seller shipment coordination within multi-seller marketplace orders requiring sophisticated logistics management. The field enables marketplace-wide shipment tracking analytics, delivery performance monitoring, and customer satisfaction optimization while supporting dispute resolution processes and comprehensive marketplace logistics optimization initiatives for enhanced customer experience delivery and operational excellence.

price_adjustment.description:
Modification of item-level pricing corrections supporting error remediation scenarios including original pricing calculation mistakes, inventory availability adjustments affecting per-unit pricing, or marketplace policy-driven pricing modifications within the multi-seller ecosystem transaction framework with comprehensive financial protection protocols.

Price adjustment updates enable sophisticated marketplace operations including pricing error correction workflows, inventory-constraint-driven pricing changes when product availability changes between order placement and fulfillment, or platform intervention scenarios requiring seller pricing modification for marketplace policy compliance or customer dispute resolution within complex multi-seller order environments requiring comprehensive financial accuracy preservation.

Comprehensive business validation includes adjustment amount limitation policies protecting marketplace financial stability, customer notification requirements for price changes that might affect purchase decisions, and integration with marketplace commission recalculation systems that adjust platform fee structures based on modified pricing within diversified seller arrangements. The system maintains pricing integrity while enabling necessary corrections and marketplace policy compliance enforcement across complex multi-seller transaction scenarios with comprehensive audit trail maintenance and financial reconciliation accuracy.

gift_wrap_requested.description:
Modification of customer gift wrapping service requests indicating personalized packaging service requirements for individual marketplace order items, supporting enhanced customer experience initiatives and seller-specific value-added services within the multi-seller marketplace order management environment with comprehensive quality assurance protocols.

Gift wrap status modifications enable marketplace service enhancement including seller workflow adjustment for special packaging requirements, shipping cost calculation updates reflecting additional packaging materials and handling time, and integration with customer service operations for gift wrapping quality assurance and customer satisfaction validation through marketplace-wide service standardization initiatives with operational excellence integration.

Service integration includes seller capability verification enabling individual merchant assessment of gift wrapping service provision, pricing calculation adjustments reflecting service upgrade costs, and quality assurance procedure integration ensuring consistent marketplace gift wrapping standards across diverse seller operations. The field enables sophisticated value-added service management while maintaining marketplace service quality consistency and customer satisfaction optimization across the multi-seller platform ecosystem with comprehensive operational monitoring and service quality control protocols.

customization_notes.description:
Modification of product-specific customization and personalization instruction details supporting marketplace operations where customers request individualized product modifications, personal engraving services, or other personalized alterations requiring special handling by marketplace sellers within their individual fulfillment operations and service workflows with comprehensive quality control integration.

Customization note updates enable complex marketplace personalization scenarios including gift message integration, product specification modifications requiring seller approval, and customer service assistance with customization order details that exceed standard marketplace transaction parameters within multi-seller order fulfillment environments requiring specialized coordination and seller collaboration protocols.

Comprehensive customization workflow integration includes seller capability verification ensuring individual merchant assessment for personalization service provision, quality assurance procedure requirements for custom product verification before shipment, and customer communication protocols for customization confirmation and delivery timeline adjustment reflecting additional processing requirements. The system enables sophisticated customization service delivery while maintaining marketplace service standardization and customer satisfaction optimization across complex multi-seller platform operations with comprehensive quality assurance and customer service integration protocols.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IUpdate.description:
Advanced update request for modifying individual order items within the sophisticated multi-seller marketplace transaction environment through comprehensive field-level modification capabilities supporting complex fulfillment workflow adjustments and marketplace operational refinement.

This DTO enables marketplace operators, customer service representatives, and authorized sellers to modify detailed item-level information within active market transactions while maintaining data integrity, financial accuracy, and comprehensive audit trails across complex multi-seller order management operations requiring sophisticated coordination and authorization protocols. Advanced features support marketplace business intelligence through modification tracking, seller performance analytics, and customer satisfaction optimization while maintaining comprehensive order item audit trails and financial reconciliation accuracy across the multi-seller ecosystem with detailed operational monitoring and compliance enforcement protocols. The system maintains transaction integrity while enabling sophisticated marketplace operations through granular control over individual item properties within complex multi-seller marketplace orders for optimal customer experience delivery and operational efficiency maximization with comprehensive authorization frameworks and quality control standards.

IShoppingMallPaymentTransaction.description:
Financial transaction processing records capturing complete payment lifecycle from authorization through settlement in the shopping mall marketplace platform. Manages multi-party transactions between customers, sellers, and the platform while maintaining transaction integrity, security standards, and audit compliance across the entire payment processing ecosystem.

Represents individual payment transactions within the marketplace payment processing system. Each transaction record contains complete processing details including gateway responses, authorization status, risk assessment scores, and financial reconciliation information. The system supports complex transaction scenarios including split payments, partial authorizations, multi-currency processing, and comprehensive fee management.

Transactions maintain comprehensive audit trails with detailed processing timestamps, gateway communications, merchant reference codes, and risk assessment scores calculated during fraud detection processing. The entity enables real-time transaction monitoring, dispute resolution support, regulatory compliance reporting, and comprehensive financial reconciliation for the payment processing ecosystem while maintaining PCI DSS security standards.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the payment transaction record generated by the payment processing system for internal reference and audit tracking.

order_payment.description: Associated order payment record containing financial transaction coordination details and multi-party payment management context. References the complete payment coordination framework for this specific transaction including order details, seller allocations, and commission calculations.

payment_gateway.description: Payment gateway configuration including processing parameters, API endpoints, authentication credentials, and gateway-specific settings used for transaction routing and processing. Provides complete gateway context for transaction processing and troubleshooting.

payment_method.description: Payment method configuration defining available payment types, validation rules, processing requirements, and customer-facing payment options used in the transaction. Complete payment method context for customer verification and processing method identification.

transaction_id.description: External transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway system for cross-system reference, reconciliation, and dispute resolution. Used for tracking transactions across external payment processing systems and financial institutions.

amount.description: Transaction amount in the original currency with precision support for fractional currency amounts. Includes all transaction fees, charges, and applicable taxes for complete financial tracking and reconciliation.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount ensuring proper financial tracking and multi-currency processing support. Required for international transaction processing and currency conversion calculations.

transaction_type.description: Transaction type distinguishing authorizations, captures, refunds, and voids for proper accounting treatment and processing workflow management. Defines the specific transaction processing workflow and financial categorization.

gateway_response_code.description: Raw gateway response code returned by the payment processor for technical troubleshooting, detailed transaction analysis, and gateway-specific error handling. Provides technical diagnostic information for payment processing issues and gateway communication problems.

gateway_message.description: Human-readable gateway response message for customer service communications, user notifications, and merchant dashboard displays. Provides user-friendly transaction status information and error explanations for customer-facing interfaces.

is_successful.description: Transaction success indicator for quick status assessments, reporting aggregation efficiency, and dashboard filtering. Boolean flag enabling efficient transaction status queries and success rate calculations.

is_authorized.description: Authorization status flag distinguishing between authorized and completed transaction states. Tracks authorization completion status for payment processing workflow management and fund capture eligibility.

is_captured.description: Capture completion status indicating whether funds have been transferred for settlement processing. Final processing confirmation flag showing completion of fund transfer from customer to merchant.

expires_at.description: Authorization expiration timestamp for pre-authorized transactions requiring completion within specified time limits. Manages authorization timeout periods and ensures proper authorization lifecycle management.

processed_at.description: Transaction processing timestamp for audit trail maintenance, financial reporting compliance, and processing time analysis. Records the actual completion time of transaction processing operations.

merchant_reference.description: Internal reference identifier for merchant reconciliation, accounting system integration, and comprehensive financial tracking. Used for internal business reference and bookkeeping system correlation.

risk_score.description: Fraud detection risk score calculated during transaction processing with range from 0 (lowest risk) to 1 (highest risk). Used for security monitoring, fraud prevention, and transaction approval decisions based on risk assessment algorithms.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp for audit trail maintenance and transaction sequence tracking. Provides chronological ordering for transaction history and compliance reporting.

updated_at.description: Record modification timestamp for change tracking, data integrity maintenance, and audit trail completion. Tracks the last update to transaction processing details and status changes.

payment_type.description: Payment processing category distinguishing customer payments, platform commission collection, seller settlement distribution, and refund processing operations.

amount.description: Payment component amount in specified currency encompassing product costs, shipping charges, and applicable marketplace service fees for accurate financial tracking.

currency.description: ISO 4217 standard currency code (USD, EUR, JPY) for pricing, commission calculation, and financial reporting consistency across marketplace jurisdiction requirements.

platform_commission.description: Marketplace platform service commission calculated as percentage of transaction gross amount - applied to seller portions for comprehensive business fee collection and revenue tracking.

processing_fees.description: External financial processing fees charged by credit card processors, payment gateway vendors, and bank transaction services for detailed cost transparency.

seller_net_amount.description: Final net proceeds available for seller payout after deducting platform commission and processing fees from gross transactional amounts.

settlement_date.description: Projected bank settlement availability date when customer funds will be processed and available for distribution to sellers and platform fee collection scenarios.

provider_reference.description: External payment gateway transaction identifier for third-party service provider reconciliation, financial institution tracking, and comprehensive audit trail maintenance.

tax_breakdown.description: Applicable tax computation details including jurisdiction-specific rates, product taxability categories, customer location requirements, and digital service taxation applicability determination.

IShoppingMallOrderPayment.ICreate.description: Payment record creation data for financial transaction processing in multi-seller marketplace operations. Establishes payment authorization, fee calculations, commission structures, and settlement coordination while supporting complex business scenarios including split payments, promotional discounts, and international currency handling for comprehensive business model implementation.

IShoppingMallPaymentTransaction.ICreate.description:
Payment transaction creation data for new financial transaction processing within the shopping mall marketplace. Contains all necessary information to initiate payment processing with external gateways while maintaining security standards and regulatory compliance.

Supports comprehensive transaction creation including multi-party payments, split transactions, and complex financial scenarios. The data structure ensures proper validation of payment methods, gateway compatibility, currency support, and amount calculations before processing initiation.

Transaction creation triggers automatic fraud detection, risk assessment, and gateway communication while maintaining comprehensive audit trails for dispute resolution and financial reporting requirements. Relationship fields are determined by business context and order processing workflow rather than client selection to ensure payment integrity.

shopping_mall_order_payment_id.description: Associated order payment's {@link shopping_mall_order_payments.id} for transaction correlation. Determined by business context from active order processing workflow rather than client selection to ensure payment integrity and prevent manipulation.

shopping_mall_payment_gateway_id.description: Processing gateway's {@link shopping_mall_payment_gateways.id} for routing identification. Selected based on transaction characteristics, gateway availability, and business rules rather than direct client specification.

shopping_mall_payment_method_id.description: Payment method's {@link shopping_mall_payment_methods.id} used for this transaction. Determined by customer selection validated against available methods for the specific transaction context.

amount.description: Transaction amount in the original currency. Must be non-negative and support precision for fractional currency amounts. Amount is validated against order totals and business rules before processing.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. Required for proper financial tracking and multi-currency processing support. Must be exactly 3 uppercase letters (USD, EUR, etc.).

transaction_type.description: Transaction type distinguishing authorizations, captures, refunds, and voids. Determines the transaction processing workflow and accounting treatment based on the payment operation being performed.

merchant_reference.description: Internal reference identifier for merchant reconciliation and accounting system integration. Used for internal tracking, reporting, and financial reconciliation across systems.

IShoppingMallPaymentTransaction.IUpdate.description:
Payment transaction update data for modifying existing transaction records within the shopping mall marketplace. Supports transaction lifecycle management including status updates, gateway synchronization, and processing detail modifications while maintaining comprehensive audit trails.

Enables various transaction operations including authorization completions, fund captures, refund processing, and transaction voids. All update operations maintain transaction integrity through comprehensive validation and ensure consistency between internal records and external gateway systems.

Update operations include fraud detection updates, risk score modifications, and processing timestamp adjustments while preserving the complete transaction history for audit compliance and regulatory reporting requirements. Fields are updated based on gateway responses and processing state changes.

status.description: Current transaction status reflecting processing state. Updated to reflect transaction lifecycle changes, gateway responses, and processing state transitions during authorization, capture, or refund operations.

gateway_response_code.description: Raw gateway response code for technical troubleshooting and detailed transaction analysis. Updated when new gateway communications occur, response codes change, or additional technical details become available.

gateway_message.description: Human-readable gateway response message for customer service and user communication. Updated to reflect new communication status, error messages, or customer-facing status information from payment processors.

is_successful.description: Transaction success indicator for quick status assessments and reporting aggregation efficiency. Updated to reflect transaction completion status or failure states based on gateway responses and processing outcomes.

is_authorized.description: Authorization status flag distinguishing between authorized and completed transaction states. Updated when authorization state changes during transaction processing lifecycle, such as after authorization completion or expiration.

is_captured.description: Capture completion status indicating whether funds have been transferred for settlement processing. Updated when fund capture operations complete or capture attempts fail during the settlement process.

processed_at.description: Transaction processing completion timestamp for audit trail and financial reporting compliance. Updated to reflect actual processing time when transaction reaches final state for accurate audit trail maintenance.

risk_score.description: Fraud detection risk score calculated during transaction processing for security monitoring. Updated when new risk assessments are performed, fraud detection rules are applied, or transaction patterns trigger security analysis.

amount.description: Payment component amount adjustments for partial payment corrections, promotional discount applications, shipping fee modifications, and commission recalculations requiring amount modifications.

currency.description: Updated currency code changes for payment component conversions, international transaction adjustments, and multi-currency settlement scenarios with proper ISO 4217 standardization.

platform_commission.description: Modified marketplace platform commission percentages resulting from policy adjustments, category-specific recalculations, or administrative commission modifications during processing lifecycle.

processing_fees.description: Adjusted gateway processing fee amounts for updated card network charges, vendor service modifications, or cost structure changes reflecting current provider pricing agreements.

seller_net_amount.description: Revised net seller proceeds calculations after commission modifications, processing fee adjustments, or transaction correction scenarios affecting final business revenue distribution amounts.

provider_reference.description: Modified external payment gateway reference identifier for transaction correlation updates, barrier repair coordination, and external financial system reconciliation examination movements across provider platforms.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering order shipments across the shopping mall marketplace platform. Enables customers, sellers, and administrators to apply granular filters for shipment tracking, inventory management, and operational oversight.

This request DTO supports advanced filtering by shipment characteristics including carrier selection, service level classification, tracking status monitoring, and delivery date range queries. The filtering system enables efficient logistics management and customer communication throughout the fulfillment process.

Parameters are designed for comprehensive shipment search capabilities while maintaining optimal performance through indexed query patterns. The system supports complex multi-criteria filtering combined with flexible sorting and pagination for large-scale marketplace operations.

page.description: Current page number for pagination results. Represents the sequence number of results pages, starting from 1. When null or omitted, defaults to the first page of results. Used to navigate through large result sets efficiently.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page for pagination. Controls the result set size returned in each page, with sensible limits to prevent excessive data loading. Valid range is 1-100 items per page, balancing performance and usability.

sort_by.description: Field name for sorting result order. Determines which shipment field is used to order the results, supporting logical sorting by date, cost, carrier, and life-cycle status. When null, results are sorted by most recent shipments first.

direction.description: Sort direction for result ordering. Specifies ascending (earliest to latest) or descending (latest to earliest) order for the selected sort field. Defaults to descending for temporal fields to show most recent results first.

search.description: General text search across shipment fields. Searches tracking numbers, carrier names, status messages, and delay reasons to find shipments matching the search terms. Minimum 3 characters for meaningful search results with a maximum of 100 characters for performance optimization.

carrier.description: Filter by specific carrier name or code. Matches shipments handled by the selected shipping provider (e.g., 'FedEx', 'UPS', 'USPS'). Enables carrier-specific analysis and customer service optimization for delivery partner management.

service_level.description: Filter by shipping service level classification. Filters shipments by delivery speed commitment including standard (5-7 days), expedited (2-3 days), overnight (1 day), and two-day services. Enables premium service monitoring and customer expectation management.

tracking_status.description: Filter by current tracking status. Matches shipments in specific delivery states such as 'in_transit', 'delivered', 'out_for_delivery', or 'exception'. Enables status monitoring and customer communication workflows.

requires_signature.description: Filter shipments requiring delivery signature confirmation. Provides visibility into shipments with enhanced security requirements or high-value items that mandate recipient acknowledgment at delivery.

created_at_start.description: Filter shipments created after this date and time. Established lower bound for shipment creation timeframe, supporting date range queries and historical analysis with ISO 8601 datetime format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z').

created_at_end.description: Filter shipments created before this date and time. Establishes upper bound for shipment creation timeframe, complementing the start date to create comprehensive historical analysis windows with ISO 8601 datetime format.

estimated_delivery_start.description: Filter shipments with estimated delivery dates after this moment. Enables delivery schedule analysis and customer expectation management by focusing on shipments expected to arrive within a specific timeframe using ISO 8601 datetime format.

estimated_delivery_end.description: Filter shipments with estimated delivery dates before this moment. Supports delivery deadline analysis and proactive customer communication about shipments expected to arrive imminently using ISO 8601 datetime format.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.description:
Fulfillment tracking records managing the physical delivery process from sellers to customers.

Coordinates multi-seller shipping scenarios, carrier integrations, tracking information, and delivery confirmation while maintaining comprehensive logistics documentation for customer communication and business analytics.

Each shipment is linked to a specific order and seller via foreign keys (shopping_mall_order_id and shopping_mall_seller_id), enabling sellers to manage their portion of order fulfillment while maintaining overall order tracking visibility. The system supports complex scenarios including consolidated shipments from multiple sellers and inventory locations.

Shipments maintain relationships with orders (transaction tracking), sellers (fulfillment responsibility), carriers (logistics coordination), and customers (delivery management) through proper foreign key references. The tracking system provides real-time visibility throughout the shipping lifecycle, from pickup to delivery confirmation.

Used by sellers to initiate fulfillment workflows, update tracking information, manage delivery exceptions, and provide comprehensive shipping service to marketplace customers. The system integrates with carrier APIs for automatic tracking updates and customer notifications.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the shipment record. Generated automatically using UUID v4 for system tracking and API reference.

carrier.description: Carrier providing shipping service. Must be from approved carrier list including USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL, and regional providers. Determines tracking API integration and service level capabilities.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number provided by carrier for customer tracking. Must be unique across all shipments. Format varies by carrier - USPS: 20 digits, FedEx: 12-14 digits, UPS: 18 characters, DHL: 10 digits.

service_level.description: Shipping service level selected by customer. Valid values: standard (3-7 business days), expedited (1-3 business days), overnight (next business day), international (7-21 business days). Determines delivery expectations and cost calculations.

weight.description: Weight of shipment in pounds for shipping cost calculation. Must be positive number with maximum 150 lbs for standard carriers. Used for rate calculations and logistics optimization.

dimensions.description: Package dimensions in format 'LxWxH inches' for shipping calculations. Example: '12.5x8.3x4.7'. Maximum dimension varies by carrier - typically 130 inches combined length + girth for standard services.

shipping_cost.description: Shipping cost charged to customer for this shipment in order currency. Calculated based on weight, dimensions, service level, and carrier rates. Includes any marketplace markup or discounts applied.

origin_location.description: Origin warehouse or pickup location coordinates in 'latitude,longitude' format. Used for logistics optimization and delivery time calculations. Example: '40.7128,-74.0060' for New York location.

destination_location.description: Destination delivery address coordinates for logistics optimization in 'latitude,longitude' format. Enables route planning and delivery time estimation. Example: '34.0522,-118.2437' for Los Angeles location.

estimated_delivery_date.description: Estimated delivery date provided by carrier or calculated by system. Must be in ISO 8601 format. Based on service level, origin/destination, and carrier processing times. Used for customer communication and expectation management.

delivered_date.description: Actual delivery date when package was delivered to customer. Automatically updated when carrier confirms delivery. Used for performance analytics and delivery guarantee calculations.

requires_signature.description: Whether delivery requires customer signature confirmation. Required for high-value orders (>$500), international shipments, or sensitive items. Affects delivery process and customer notification requirements.

delivery_proof.description: Proof of delivery information including signature image, photo confirmation, or delivery receipt. Stored as base64 encoded image or text description. Required for signature-required deliveries and dispute resolution.

delay_reason.description: Shipping delay reasons or explanations if estimated date is extended. Common values: weather_delay, carrier_delay, address_issue, customs_delay, recipient_unavailable. Used for customer communication and service recovery.

pickup_scheduled_at.description: When shipment pickup is scheduled from seller's location. Must be in ISO 8601 format. Used for carrier pickup coordination and seller preparation notifications.

picked_up_at.description: When package was actually scanned into carrier system. Automatically updated when carrier scans package. Confirms shipment initiation and starts delivery countdown.

tracking_status.description: Current shipment status in carrier's tracking system. Valid lifecycle states: pre_transit, in_transit, out_for_delivery, delivered, failed_attempt, exception, returned_to_sender. Determines customer notifications and system workflows.

last_status_message.description: Last activity message from carrier tracking updates. Contains detailed status information like 'Arrived at sorting facility' or 'Delivery attempted - recipient not available'. Used for customer communication and issue identification.

is_consolidated.description: Whether shipment contains items from multiple order items consolidated from same seller. Enables cost optimization and simplified tracking for multi-item orders from single seller.

created_at.description: Timestamp when shipment record was created for logistics tracking. Automatically set on creation. Used for audit trails and performance analytics.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when shipment details were last updated. Automatically updated on modifications. Used for change tracking and system synchronization.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a new shipment record for an existing order in the shopping mall marketplace platform.

Enables sellers to initiate fulfillment workflows by creating comprehensive shipment records that coordinate the delivery process. The shipment creation process validates order ownership, calculates shipping costs, and establishes tracking capabilities for customer communication.

This schema provides essential logistics information including carrier selection, service level determination, package specifications, and delivery cost calculations. Sellers use this to transition orders from processing to fulfillment status while maintaining comprehensive audit trails.

The creation process integrates with carrier APIs for rate calculations, validates shipping addresses, and establishes customer notification workflows. All shipment records maintain relationships with orders, sellers, and customers for complete marketplace coordination.

carrier.description: Carrier providing shipping service. Must be from approved carrier list: USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL. Carrier selection affects shipping rates, delivery times, and tracking capabilities available to customers.

service_level.description: Shipping service level determining delivery speed and cost. Valid options: standard (economy), expedited (faster), overnight (next day), international (cross-border). Selection affects customer delivery expectations and shipping costs.

weight.description: Package weight in pounds for accurate shipping cost calculation. Must be positive value between 0.1 and 150 lbs. Used with dimensions to determine shipping rates and carrier service eligibility.

dimensions.description: Package dimensions in 'LxWxH inches' format for shipping calculations. Example: '12.5x8.3x4.7'. Required for dimensional weight pricing and carrier service validation.

shipping_cost.description: Total shipping cost charged to customer in order currency. Calculated from carrier rates plus any marketplace fees. Must be non-negative and reflect actual shipping expenses plus service margins.

tracking_number.description: Unique tracking number from carrier for shipment monitoring. Must be unique across all shipments. Format varies by carrier and is required for customer tracking and system integration.

estimated_delivery_date.description: Expected delivery date in ISO 8601 format based on service level and carrier estimates. Used for customer communication and delivery expectation management. Should account for processing and transit times.

requires_signature.description: Whether delivery requires customer signature confirmation. Required for high-value shipments (>$500) or sensitive items. Affects delivery process complexity and customer notification requirements.

tracking_status.description: Initial shipment tracking status for system workflows. Valid values: pre_transit (before pickup), in_transit (after pickup). Sets system state and triggers appropriate customer notifications.

is_consolidated.description: Whether this shipment consolidates multiple order items from the same seller. Enables cost optimization and simplified tracking for multi-item orders. Defaults to false for single-item shipments.

IShoppingMallOrderShipment.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema for updating existing shipment details for an order in the shopping mall marketplace platform.

Provides comprehensive capability to modify all mutable shipment information as the fulfillment process progresses, supporting carrier changes, delivery status updates, and exception management. This schema enables real-time tracking information maintenance and customer communication throughout the shipping lifecycle.

Enhanced with session context fields for proper audit trail maintenance and seller authentication tracking throughout the fulfillment process. These fields enable comprehensive activity logging for dispute resolution and operational oversight while maintaining security standards.

service_level.description: Shipping service level selected by customer. Values: standard, expedited, overnight.

weight.description: Weight of shipment for shipping cost calculation.

dimensions.description: Dimensions (LxWxH) of package for shipping calculations.

shipping_cost.description: Shipping cost charged to customer for this shipment.

delivered_date.description: Actual delivery date when package was delivered to customer.

requires_signature.description: Whether delivery requires customer signature confirmation.

delivery_proof.description: Proof of delivery information including signature or photo confirmation.

delay_reason.description: Shipping delay reasons or explanations if estimated date is extended.

picked_up_at.description: When package was actually scanned into carrier system.

tracking_status.description: Current shipment status in carrier's tracking system.

last_status_message.description: Last activity message from carrier tracking updates.

ip.description: IP address of the seller updating the shipment for security audit and tracking purposes.

href.description: Current page URL from which the shipment update was initiated for proper session tracking and operator verification.

referrer.description: Previous page URL that referred the seller to the shipment update form for complete audit trail documentation.

IShoppingMallOrderRefund.description:
Financial compensation records managing customer returns, seller credits, and dispute resolution processes. Handles partial and full refunds while maintaining transparent accounting across all marketplace participants and supporting comprehensive financial reconciliation for platform operations and regulatory compliance.

Represents individual refund requests within the shopping mall marketplace, tracking the complete lifecycle from customer request through seller response, administrative review, and final processing. The entity maintains detailed documentation of refund reasons, amount calculations, responsibility assignment, and resolution outcomes.

Each refund record is linked to the original order, specific order items (for partial refunds), the associated payment refund transaction, and the seller responsible for the refund amount. The system tracks customer satisfaction scores, administrative approval workflows, and supporting evidence documentation to ensure fair and transparent refund processing.

The refund entity supports various refund scenarios including defective products, incorrect shipments, customer satisfaction issues, and seller-initiated refunds. It maintains audit trails for regulatory compliance, provides dispute resolution capabilities, and ensures proper financial accounting through integration with the payment processing system.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for this refund record in the shopping mall refund system.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Original order being partially or fully refunded. References shopping_mall_orders.id and establishes the financial transaction context.

shopping_mall_order_item_id.description: Specific item being refunded if partial refund. References shopping_mall_order_items.id and enables item-level refund granularity.

shopping_mall_payment_refund_id.description: Associated payment refund from payment system. References shopping_mall_payment_refunds.id for financial transaction coordination.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Seller responsible for this refund amount. References shopping_mall_seller.id and determines financial liability distribution.

refund_reason.description: Reason category for the refund request. Categorizes refund motivations for analytics and process optimization.

refund_explanation.description: Detailed explanation of why refund was requested or approved. Provides comprehensive context for refund decision-making and audit trail maintenance.

fault_determination.description: Whether refund was due to seller issue, customer issue, or platform problem. Assigns responsibility for refund costs and affects platform fee adjustments.

refund_amount.description: Amount being refunded in original transaction currency. Represents the financial compensation provided to the customer.

currency.description: Currency code following ISO 4217 standards for financial transactions. Ensures accurate monetary value representation across international transactions.

customer_timeline_estimate.description: Suggested time frames for customers to receive different refund types. Provides customer communication and expectation management.

customer_satisfaction_score.description: Whether customer is satisfied with the refund resolution. Measures refund process effectiveness and customer experience quality.

admin_approval_status.description: Administrative review status for refunds requiring manual approval. Tracks manual review workflows for complex or high-value refund scenarios.

supporting_evidence.description: Evidence or documentation supporting refund decision making. Includes photos, communication records, and other relevant documentation.

requires_return.description: Whether original product must be returned before refund is processed. Controls refund eligibility based on product return requirements.

seller_response.description: Seller response to refund request including acceptance or dispute details. Captures seller perspective and dispute resolution communications.

admin_decision.description: Administrative decision and reasoning for complex refund scenarios. Documents final authority decisions and rationale for controversial cases.

affects_commission.description: Whether refunded amount affects seller commission calculations. Determines financial impact on seller earnings and platform revenue.

platform_fee_adjustment.description: Platform fee refund amount if commission was adjusted. Tracks platform revenue adjustments due to refund processing.

processing_timeline_estimate.description: Estimated processing time for refund based on payment method and fraud checks. Provides operational timeline expectations.

is_completed.description: Whether refund has been fully processed and completed in payment system. Indicates final completion status for financial reconciliation.

requested_at.description: Timestamp when refund request was initiated by customer or system. Records the start time of the refund process.

decided_at.description: Timestamp when refund was approved or rejected by appropriate authority. Documents decision timing for audit trails.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when refund was actually processed in payment system. Records actual fund transfer completion timing.

order.description: Original order associated with this refund request. Provides order context and customer information.

orderItem.description: Specific order item being refunded if partial refund. Enables item-level refund tracking and inventory adjustments.

paymentRefund.description: Associated payment refund transaction. Links to financial processing and fund transfer records.

seller.description: Seller responsible for this refund amount. Provides seller information and business context.

IShoppingMallOrderRefund.ICreate.description:
Refund creation request submitted by customers for order returns, seller credits, and dispute resolution in the shopping mall marketplace platform.

Manages financial compensation requests for defective products, incorrect shipments, customer satisfaction issues, and seller-initiated refunds while maintaining transparent accounting across all marketplace participants including customers, sellers, and platform administrators.

Each refund request captures comprehensive documentation including reason categorization, detailed explanation, supporting evidence, and customer communication preferences to support informed decision-making and maintain complete audit trails for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

The creation process integrates with inventory management systems for returns processing, payment processing frameworks for fund transfers, and financial accounting systems for accurate revenue tracking and seller commission calculations while implementing customer satisfaction tracking and notification workflows.

Refund requests support both partial refunds for specific order items and full order refunds with automatic calculation of appropriate refund amounts including taxes, fees, promotional adjustments, and currency conversions for international marketplace operations.

seller_id.description:
Business identifier (code field) for the seller responsible for this refund amount.

Determines financial liability assignment across marketplace participants and properly allocates refund costs according to business agreements and seller relationships.

Used for external API consistency and internal financial reconciliation while maintaining proper seller accountability for refund processing costs and platform fee adjustments.

refund_reason.description:
Standardized reason category for the refund request categorizing refund motivations for analytics, process optimization, and automated business rule application.

Enables systematic refund analysis, seller performance tracking, and marketplace trend identification while supporting customer service workflows and dispute resolution processes through consistent reason classification.

refund_explanation.description:
Comprehensive documentation explaining the circumstances requiring refund including detailed product issues, service problems, or transaction concerns that justify financial compensation.

Provides complete context for refund decision-making, audit trail maintenance, seller notification communications, and regulatory compliance documentation while supporting customer satisfaction tracking and feedback collection processes.

fault_determination.description:
Responsibility assignment determining whether refund costs should be allocated to seller issues, customer errors, platform problems, or external factors for financial reconciliation and accountability tracking.

Affects seller commission calculations, platform fee adjustments, supplier relationships, and dispute resolution processes while maintaining transparent financial accounting across marketplace participants.

refund_amount.description:
Monetary compensation amount being refunded using original transaction currency with precision support for partial refunds, tax calculations, fee adjustments, and promotional credit reversals.

Represents the financial compensation provided to the customer while maintaining accurate accounting records for seller settlements, platform revenue recognition, and regulatory compliance across international transactions.

currency.description:
ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for accurate monetary value representation supporting international marketplace transactions, multi-currency operations, and proper financial aggregation for reporting and analysis purposes.

Ensures consistent currency handling across payment processing, seller settlements, platform accounting, and customer communications for global marketplace operations with appropriate currency symbol and formatting support.

customer_timeline_estimate.description:
Customer communication suggesting appropriate time frames for different refund types including payment method processing times, seller response expectations, and administrative review requirements for setting realistic customer expectations.

Supports customer service workflows, dispute resolution processes, and automated communication systems while providing operational transparency and managing customer satisfaction throughout refund processing lifecycle.

supporting_evidence.description:
Documentation, photographs, correspondence records, or other evidence supporting the refund request decision for audit trail maintenance, seller response gathering, administrative review processes, and dispute resolution scenarios.

Enables informed decision-making, regulatory compliance documentation, quality improvement initiatives, and customer feedback collection while supporting seller education and product quality enhancement programs across the marketplace ecosystem.

requires_return.description:
Controls whether original product or specific order items must be physically returned before refund processing can be completed, affecting logistics requirements, customer communication, seller inventory management, and quality control processes.

Determines refund eligibility criteria, shipping arrangement responsibilities, quality verification processes, and inventory adjustment workflows while managing customer expectations and seller operational requirements for damaged or unwanted item processing.

IShoppingMallOrderRefund.IRequest.description:
Advanced search and filtering parameters for retrieving refund records associated with specific orders in the shopping mall marketplace platform.

Enables administrative oversight, customer service workflows, financial reconciliation processes, and regulatory compliance monitoring through comprehensive filtering capabilities including refund status management, fault determination tracking, approval workflow integration, and temporal analysis capabilities.

The request parameters support sophisticated query construction combining text-based searches, categorical filtering, administrative workflow state management, financial transparency requirements, and customer service excellence objectives while maintaining efficient database query optimization for high-volume marketplace operations.

Administrators and customer service representatives can construct targeted queries for specific refund scenarios including disputed refunds requiring manual review, seller performance analysis, customer satisfaction tracking, and financial reporting across multiple currencies, sellers, and marketplace channels with appropriate access control and audit trail maintenance.

Date range filtering enables period-based financial reporting, trend analysis, and operational efficiency evaluation while supporting business intelligence initiatives, regulatory compliance requirements, and performance optimization strategies through comprehensive refund data analysis and marketplace insight generation.

search.description: Text-based search across refund reason explanations, administrative resolution notes, seller response communications, and evidence descriptions using partial matching and fuzzy search capabilities for comprehensive customer service query support across refund request content and associated communications.

oneOf.description: Product manufacturing defects, functional failures, or quality issues requiring financial compensation and potential seller quality review processes for marketplace improvement initiatives.
Incorrect product delivery including wrong size, color, variant, or completely different item shipments requiring logistical coordination and inventory correction processes.
Product damage occurring during transportation impacting product usability or aesthetic appeal with carrier claim processes and quality assessment requirements.
Product characteristics, features, or specifications differing from marketplace listing information affecting customer trust and seller credibility with listing improvement opportunities.
Customer-initiated returns for non-defective products within marketplace return policy timelines with customer service support and retention initiatives.
Seller-initiated refunds including pricing corrections, order modifications, customer service gestures, or administrative adjustments demonstrating merchant responsibility.
Marketplace platform issues including payment processing failures, technical errors, system malfunctions, or operational problems requiring platform accountability acknowledgment.
Miscellaneous refund categories not fitting standard classifications enabling flexible refund processing while maintaining proper categorization and operational procedures.

reason_category.description: Standardized refund reason categorization filtering for targeted analysis, seller performance evaluation, quality improvement initiatives, and marketplace trend identification supporting business intelligence decisions and operational optimization strategies.

oneOf.description: Refund requests awaiting seller response, administrative review, or customer communication maintaining operational queue management and workflow state tracking.
Approved refund requests awaiting payment processing, fund transfer coordination, and financial system integration with completion timeline management.
Rejected refund requests requiring customer notification, dispute resolution processes, appeal workflows, or alternative compensation arrangements.
Active refund processing including payment gateway coordination, fund transfer execution, seller notification delivery, and administrative oversight management.
Successfully processed refunds with completed fund transfers to customers, proper seller settlements, and appropriate accounting record maintenance.
Cancelled refund requests due to customer reversal, order reactivation, alternative resolution agreements, or administrative intervention processes.

status.description: Refund workflow state filtering enabling progress tracking, completion analysis, seller performance monitoring, and administrative oversight management while supporting customer service prioritization and operational efficiency evaluation procedures.

Marketplace platform issues affecting refund eligibility including technical errors, policy inconsistencies, or operational system failures requiring administrative recognition and system optimization processes.

fault_determination.description: Financial responsibility assignment filtering supporting liability analysis, cost allocation calculations, seller performance evaluation, dispute resolution processes, and customer service decision-making with comprehensive accountability tracking across marketplace participants.

admin_approval_required.description: Administrative oversight flag identifying refunds requiring manual review, compliance verification, high-value authorization, or policy exception approval for quality assurance and regulatory compliance management.

oneOf.description: Standard refund processing without administrative intervention enabling automated workflows and efficient customer service operations for routine refund requests.
