Administratively approved refund requests demonstrating policy compliance, business rule satisfaction, and authorized financial transaction processing for high-value or complex cases.
Administratively rejected refunds requiring alternative resolution approaches, customer communication initiatives, policy clarification procedures, or appeal process management.

admin_approval_status.description: Administrative workflow state filtering for compliance monitoring, approval queue management, regulatory oversight requirements, and quality assurance processes supporting marketplace governance and policy enforcement initiatives.

date_range.description: Temporal filtering parameters enabling period-based financial reporting, trend analysis, operational efficiency evaluation, and business intelligence metrics calculation across refund processing workflows with ISO 8601 date-time format compliance.

start.description: Filtering start timestamp using ISO 8601 date-time format for comprehensive temporal query construction supporting precise refund request timing analysis and chronological data organization.

end.description: Filtering end timestamp using ISO 8601 date-time format for complete temporal range specification enabling period-based financial reconciliation and comparative analysis across operational timelines.

oneOf.description: Requested timestamp ordering providing chronological arrangement for workflow analysis and operational timeline tracking supporting audit trail maintenance and process flow optimization.
Decision timestamp ordering for approval workflow analysis supporting administrative efficiency evaluation and timely resolution metrics calculation enabling performance optimization initiatives.
Completion timestamp ordering for financial reconciliation analysis supporting seller settlement coordination and customer satisfaction monitoring with operational completion tracking.
Financial amount ordering for monetary analysis supporting financial trend identification, impact assessment calculations, and revenue pattern analysis for marketplace optimization strategies.
Status-based ordering enabling workflow state analysis supporting operational efficiency evaluation and process improvement identification across refund lifecycle management procedures.

sort_by.description: Result organization criteria supporting analytical requirements, workflow optimization, financial reporting needs, and operational efficiency evaluation through standardized data arrangement and comparative analysis capabilities.

oneOf.description: Ascending arrangement from smallest to largest, earliest to latest, or beginning to end enabling forward chronological reading, lowest amount analysis, or early stage focus requirements.
Descending arrangement from largest to smallest, latest to earliest, or end to beginning enabling recent activity emphasis, highest amount analysis, or latest stage focus requirements.

sort_order.description: Data arrangement direction supporting analytical objectives, communication preferences, and visual presentation requirements through consistent ordering standards applicable across all sort criteria.

page.description: Pagination page number for large dataset management supporting efficient result processing, memory utilization optimization, and responsive user interface design while maintaining comprehensive data accessibility for analysis requirements.

limit.description: Results per page limitation for performance optimization with configurable page size supporting responsive loading times, memory management, and user experience customization while maintaining data accessibility within reasonable computational constraints.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.ISummary.description:
Customer session management entity tracking authenticated user sessions across the shopping mall marketplace platform.

Sessions enable secure multi-device authentication while providing comprehensive audit trails for security monitoring, activity analysis, and customer behavior tracking throughout shopping activities, order management, and account preference management workflows.

The session system maintains security boundaries by tracking device origins, connection contexts, and activity timestamps while supporting automatic session expiration and concurrent session management for enhanced user experience across the marketplace ecosystem.

Each session is associated with a specific customer account and includes detailed tracking information for authentication verification, device fingerprinting, and security incident investigation capabilities essential for fraud prevention and platform trust maintenance.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Associated customer's {@link shopping_mall_customer.id} establishing session ownership and enabling authentication tracking across the marketplace platform while maintaining customer relationship integrity for activity correlation and personalized experience delivery.

id.description: Primary key identifier for the session record enabling efficient session lookup, authentication verification, and cross-system reference for security monitoring and activity analysis across the shopping mall platform.

ip.description: Originating device IP address for session origin identification enabling geographic access tracking, security monitoring, and potential fraud detection through IP address analysis and geographic restriction enforcement within the marketplace security framework.

Enables efficient navigation through large transaction datasets for administrative oversight and detailed investigation workflows. Page numbers must be positive integers starting from 1, with automatic bounds checking to prevent invalid navigation requests.

Larger limits enable comprehensive data export while smaller limits support responsive interface interactions for transaction monitoring dashboards.

Enables keyword-based transaction discovery using partial matching algorithms for enhanced search flexibility. Supports values like 'stripe', 'paypal', 'adyen' for targeted gateway assessment. Enables comparative analysis between different payment providers and specialized troubleshooting for gateway-specific issues.

Response codes indicate specific processing outcomes like '00' for approval, '05' for decline, '14' for invalid card number. Supports investigation of recurring technical issues and gateway-specific error pattern analysis for system optimization.

status.description: Filter by transaction status for workflow tracking and status-based transaction monitoring. Critical for fraud detection workflows, payment gateway performance assessment, and customer service investigation of payment issues.

IShoppingMallPaymentGateway.ISummary.description:
Payment gateway configuration summary providing essential operational information for transaction processing and system integration decisions. Represents the core payment processing infrastructure that enables financial transactions across the shopping mall marketplace platform.

Gateways serve as the bridge between customer payment methods and financial institutions, handling authorization, settlement, and security compliance requirements. Each gateway configuration defines specific integration parameters, fee structures, geographic limitations, and operational capabilities that determine transaction routing decisions.

These summaries expose critical gateway metadata for transaction listing, dashboard displays, and administrative oversight while protecting sensitive configuration details like API credentials and webhook secrets. The data enables informed payment method presentation to customers and supports operational monitoring of payment processing performance across different gateway providers.

gateway_code.description: Unique gateway identifier code for system references and API routing decisions. Used internally for gateway selection logic and transaction processing workflows.

gateway_type.description: Gateway category distinguishing credit card processors, digital wallets, and alternative payment methods. Determines business logic behavior, integration patterns, and customer interface requirements.

is_primary.description: Primary gateway designation for preferred routing and default payment method prioritization in checkout flows and transaction processing logic.

is_available.description: Availability status for new transactions while maintaining existing payment processing capabilities. Used for gateway rotation and failover scenarios.

sandbox_endpoint.description: Testing environment endpoint for development and integration testing activities. Enables safe testing of payment flows without affecting production transaction processing.

webhook_secret.description: Webhook authentication secret for secure callback verification and event validation. Used to verify payment status updates and transaction notifications from the gateway provider.

processing_fees.description: Fee structure definition in JSON format for transparent cost calculations and pricing models. Contains percentage rates, fixed fees, and transaction type-specific pricing information.

max_transaction_amount.description: Maximum transaction amount limit for risk management and regulatory compliance requirements. Defines upper bounds for single transaction processing to prevent fraud and manage exposure.

configuration_schema.description: Configuration parameter schema definition for gateway-specific settings and capabilities. JSON schema defining required parameters, validation rules, and integration requirements.

risk_score_threshold.description: Maximum acceptable risk score for automatic transaction processing with manual review triggers. Establishes fraud detection thresholds and risk management parameters.

retry_configuration.description: Retry policy configuration for failed transactions with backoff strategies and limits. JSON structure defining retry attempts, delays, and escalation procedures for payment failures.

updated_at.description: Configuration modification timestamp for maintenance and monitoring accuracy. Tracks the last time gateway settings were modified for operational oversight.

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.description:
Refund processing management system handling return of funds from completed monetary transactions across the shopping mall marketplace platform. This financial entity coordinates complex refund scenarios including full refunds, partial refunds, chargebacks, and administrative adjustments while maintaining complete audit trails for regulatory compliance and financial reporting.

The system manages comprehensive refund authorization workflows, automated approval processes, customer communication protocols, and multi-party settlement coordination across diverse payment methods and international currencies. Refund transactions maintain strict accounting relationships with original payment records, ensuring accurate financial reconciliation and complete transaction lineage documentation throughout dispute resolution and compliance audit processes.

Refund operations integrate with marketplace seller management, customer service workflows, and external payment gateway systems to provide seamless refund processing experiences while maintaining platform trust indicators and merchant credibility. The system supports real-time status tracking, automated SLA monitoring, comprehensive analytics gathering, and detailed reporting capabilities essential for marketplace governance and financial oversight.

id.description: Primary Key - Factory-generated UUID v4 identifier providing unique system identification for this refund transaction across all marketplace payment processing operations. Generated automatically upon refund creation ensuring collision-resistant identification for financial reconciliation, audit trail maintenance, and transaction correlation with external payment systems.

refund_reference.description: Unique business identifier code following standardized alphanumeric patterns for external communication, customer service interactions, and financial tracking system integration. Generated automatically using business rules ensuring platform-wide uniqueness for merchant reconciliation, customer communication, and regulatory compliance documentation requirements across all refund scenarios.

amount.description: Monetary refund amount expressed in original transaction currency with decimal precision supporting partial refund calculations, fee adjustments, and accurate financial reporting. Represents the gross amount returned to customers excluding any processing fees or platform deductions while maintaining compliance with currency-specific precision requirements and international accounting standards.

currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code identifier ensuring accurate multi-currency financial processing and proper accounting treatment across international marketplace operations. Supports complete currency ecosystem including major global currencies, regional payment methods, and specialized monetary units while maintaining proper foreign exchange compliance and tax reporting requirements.

refund_type.description: Standardized refund category classification distinguishing merchant refunds, chargeback disputes, and administrative adjustments for proper accounting treatment and business intelligence analytics. Enables automated workflow routing, distinct approval processes, regulatory compliance tracking, and platform governance through systematic categorization of diverse refund circumstances.

reason_code.description: Standardized alphanumeric refund reason code supporting automated decision making, analytics reporting, and consistent customer communication across all marketplace refund scenarios. Provides structured categorization of refund circumstances enabling business intelligence, trend analysis, regulatory reporting, and automated workflow triggering in customer service and seller notification systems.

reason_description.description: Comprehensive textual explanation of refund circumstances providing detailed context for customer service representatives, dispute resolution procedures, and audit trail documentation. Supports thorough examination of refund justification, seller communication requirements, and financial reconciliation processes while maintaining clear communication channels between marketplace participants.

status.description: Current refund processing lifecycle stage indicating workflow progress from initial request through completion, rejection, or investigation procedures. Manages transaction state transitions, customer communication timing, seller notification scheduling, and appropriate system integrations while supporting regulatory compliance tracking and operational oversight requirements.

is_approved.description: Manual authorization indicator for refunds requiring administrative or seller approval before processing completion. Controls workflow gates, notification routing, audit trail requirements, and appropriate financial control processes while supporting complex approval hierarchies for high-value refunds, chargeback disputes, and administrative adjustments requiring human oversight.

is_processed.description: Processing completion boolean flag indicating successful fund return to customers with confirmation across payment gateway systems, bank transfer mechanisms, and financial institution integrations. Triggers audit trail completion, notification workflows, and appropriate accounting ledger entries while maintaining regulatory compliance through proper transaction finalization procedures.

external_refund_id.description: External system credential containing payment gateway refund identifier for reconciliation with third-party payment processors, banking systems, and financial service integrations. Maintains correlation between internal refund records and external financial transactions ensuring complete audit trails and cross-system verification capabilities.

processing_fee.description: Platform retention amount covering operational costs, payment processing charges, gateway fees, and marketplace service expenses associated with refund transactions. Calculated according to agreed-upon fee structures while maintaining transparent pricing relationships and accurate financial reconciliation between platform revenue and third-party service costs.

requested_at.description: Original refund request timestamp indicating customer initiation, seller approval timing, or system identification of refund circumstances for SLA tracking and customer communication scheduling. Provides chronological baseline for processing duration calculations while supporting workflow prioritization and service level agreement monitoring throughout refund lifecycle management.

processed_at.description: Refund completion timestamp confirming successful fund transfer completion, payment gateway confirmation, and external system settlement for comprehensive audit trail documentation. Updates upon final transaction confirmation while supporting financial reporting, regulatory compliance documentation, and operational analytics for marketplace performance measurement.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp establishing chronological baseline for audit trail maintenance, change history tracking, and system integration verification throughout refund lifecycle operations. Provides foundational timing reference for all subsequent modification activities and supports comprehensive database sequence ordering across high-volume transaction environments.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp indicating recent change activity including status updates, approval decisions, external system notifications, reconciliation changes, or administrative adjustments throughout refund processing workflows. Enables chronological ordering of modification events while supporting differential analytics, audit compliance, and change propagation monitoring across integrated systems.

paymentTransaction.description: Enhanced summary reference containing complete payment transaction context including gateway identification, method characteristics, processing status, and operational details through transformed foreign key relationship enabling single-call comprehensive refund understanding.

reviewingAdministrator.description: Administrative authorization reference through converted foreign key relationship providing approving administrator identification, role verification, and approval authority context for manual refund authorization processes and approval hierarchy tracking.

payment_transaction_id.description: Associated payment transaction ID for refund correlation. Must reference an existing payment transaction. Provides direct reference to original transaction for financial reconciliation and refund amount validation.

amount.description: Refund amount in original currency. Must be positive and not exceed the original transaction amount. Enables precise refund calculations respecting currency constraints and business rules.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the refund amount. Must match the original transaction currency to ensure proper accounting accuracy and prevent foreign exchange complications across the platform.

refund_type.description: Refund category distinguishing refund scenarios. Must be one of: merchant_refund, chargeback, administrative_adjustment. Specifies processing workflows, approval requirements, and accounting treatment for different refund scenarios.

reason_code.description: Standardized refund reason code for categorization. Examples: customer_return, product_defect, order_cancellation, seller_error, chargeback_dispute. Enables analytics, automated workflows, and consistent reporting across the platform.

reason_description.description: Detailed explanation of refund circumstances. Should provide context for customer service and potential dispute resolution. Enables effective communication and thorough audit trail documentation for financial operations.

processing_fee.description: Optional processing fee to be retained by the platform. If provided, must be non-negative and reasonable for the refund amount. Covers operational costs and gateway charges while maintaining transparent pricing structure.

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.ICreate.description:
Refund creation information including payment transaction reference, refund amount, type selection, and detailed reasoning documentation. This DTO enables administrators to initiate refund processes with proper authorization and audit trail establishment.

The refund creation requires association with an existing payment transaction, ensuring proper financial reconciliation between original payments and subsequent refunds. Currency must match the original transaction to maintain accounting accuracy and prevent foreign exchange complications.

is_approved.description: Approval status for refunds requiring manual authorization. Set to true only after proper review of refund circumstances and documentation. Changes trigger automated workflows including customer notifications, payment gateway coordination, and compliance reporting updates. Approval decisions must be made by authorized administrators with appropriate financial oversight permissions.

is_processed.description: Processing completion status. Must be set to true only after confirmation that funds have been successfully returned to the customer's original payment method. This status serves as the final indicator of successful transaction reversal and triggers financial reconciliation processes across payment gateway and internal accounting systems.

processed_at.description: Timestamp of actual refund processing completion when funds were successfully returned to the customer. Must be provided when is_processed is set to true for accurate financial reporting and audit trail documentation. Represents the definitive moment when the financial transaction reversal was completed successfully.

refund_reference.description: Updated refund reference identifier for external communication and financial tracking systems. Must remain unique across all refunds for effective correlation with external payment processors and bank statements. Reference format should align with organizational standards for financial transaction identification and reconciliation processes.

amount.description: Updated refund amount in the original transaction currency. Supports precision amounts for partial refunds and administrative adjustments. Amount modifications require careful validation to ensure they don't exceed original transaction value and maintain proper financial accuracy for customer compensation calculations.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the refund amount ensuring accurate accounting across multiple currencies. Must match the original transaction currency for proper exchange rate application and cross-border transaction compliance. Currency consistency is critical for international payment processing and regulatory reporting requirements.

refund_type.description: Updated refund type categorization distinguishing merchant refunds, chargebacks, and administrative adjustments. Type selection affects accounting classification, seller reconciliation processes, and compliance reporting requirements. Different refund types trigger distinct financial workflows and stakeholder notification processes.

reason_code.description: Updated standardized refund reason code for automated analytics, reporting, and decision-making processes. Reason codes should reflect the primary cause of the refund requirement and support customer service improvement initiatives and quality management programs while enabling automated refund approval workflow routing.

reason_description.description: Updated detailed explanation of refund circumstances for customer service documentation and dispute resolution records. Comprehensive reasoning supports quality assurance programs, dispute mediation processes, and regulatory compliance requirements while providing clear audit documentation for financial transaction reviews and customer communication transparency.

status.description: Updated refund processing status from initiation through completion for workflow management and tracking accuracy. Status changes must follow predefined workflow transitions to maintain process integrity and ensure appropriate stakeholder notifications, financial system updates, and regulatory compliance documentation throughout the refund lifecycle.

external_refund_id.description: Updated external system refund identifier from payment gateway for enhanced reconciliation and multi-party tracking capabilities. External IDs enable correlation across payment processor platforms, banking systems, and financial audit trails while supporting integrated reporting requirements across different financial service providers and regulatory bodies.

processing_fee.description: Updated refund processing fee amount retained by the platform to cover operational costs and payment gateway charges. Fee calculations must maintain transparency for customer communication while ensuring appropriate cost allocation for platform service provision and third-party payment processing expense recovery.

reviewing_administrator_notes.description: Administrative notes and review comments supporting the refund approval or modification decision-making process. Review notes provide essential context for audit trails, quality assurance evaluations, and internal communication between administrative staff while maintaining comprehensive documentation for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance verification processes.

IShoppingMallPaymentRefund.IUpdate.description:
Comprehensive refund update request enabling administrators to modify critical refund processing information throughout the transaction reversal lifecycle. This DTO supports modern refund management operations including approval decisions, status transitions, amount adjustments, and audit documentation.

Administrative updates maintain financial accuracy through proper workflow orchestration involving payment gateway coordination, seller notification systems, customer communication channels, and internal accounting reconciliation processes. All modifications are tracked through comprehensive audit trails ensuring regulatory compliance and operational transparency.

The system enables complex refund scenarios including partial refunds, dispute processing, administrative overrides, and multi-party coordination while maintaining strict financial integrity and providing comprehensive tracking for both customer service and financial management purposes throughout the entire refund transaction lifecycle.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.description:
Customer support tickets managing issue resolution workflows across the marketplace ecosystem.

The ticket system serves as the primary interface for customers to report problems, request assistance, and track resolution progress. Each ticket captures the complete customer service interaction chain from initial issue reporting through final resolution and follow-up feedback collection. Provides complete foreign key transformations to object references for better developer experience and contextual information.

Tickets support complex multi-party scenarios where issues may involve multiple sellers, various platform services, or require coordination between different support teams. The system maintains detailed audit trails for quality assurance, performance analytics, and regulatory compliance requirements.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering and searching customer support tickets in the shopping mall platform. This DTO enables customers, support agents, and administrators to query tickets based on various criteria including status, priority, category, customer information, and temporal constraints.

The request supports sophisticated filtering capabilities for different user roles while maintaining appropriate access controls. Customers can filter their own tickets, while administrators have broader visibility across all customer support cases. Search parameters are designed to facilitate efficient ticket management and resolution workflows.

Common use cases include customers viewing their open tickets, support agents finding high-priority cases, and administrators generating reports on ticket resolution performance. The combination of search parameters enables targeted queries for specific support scenarios and operational analytics.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified. Used in conjunction with limit parameter to control result pagination for large ticket datasets.

limit.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 20 with maximum of 100 items per page. Controls the size of paginated response for optimal performance and user experience.

search.description: Text-based search term for ticket content, subject lines, or customer information. Supports partial matching and enables quick ticket discovery by keywords or customer's first/last name.

status.description: Filter tickets by current workflow status. Valid values: new, open, in_progress, pending_customer, pending_internal, resolved, closed. Enables filtering tickets in specific lifecycle stages for targeted management and analysis.

priority.description: Filter tickets by urgency level. Valid values: low, medium, high, urgent. Helps identify and prioritize critical customer issues requiring immediate attention and specialized resource allocation.

category.description: Filter tickets by issue classification. Common categories: order_issue, product_inquiry, account_problem, payment_dispute, technical_support. Enables departmental routing and specialized support allocation.

customerId.description: Filter tickets by specific customer. Customers can only query their own tickets while administrators can filter by any customer ID. Enables targeted customer service management and account-specific support scenarios.

ticketNumber.description: Exact match filter for ticket tracking numbers following pattern TKT-{year}{sequence}. Enables direct ticket lookup by the customer's reference number for support interactions.

agentId.description: Filter tickets by assigned support agent. Used by support managers to track agent workload and performance metrics. Enables assignment-based ticket management and staff resource planning.

createdAfter.description: Filter tickets created after this timestamp (inclusive). Enables time-based reporting and helps identify recent support issues requiring attention or different handling approaches.

createdBefore.description: Filter tickets created before this timestamp (inclusive). Useful for historical analysis and generating reports on ticket trends over specific time periods or during platform events.

sortBy.description: Field to sort results by. Valid values: created_at, updated_at, priority, status, ticket_number. Defaults to created_at with descending order for most recent tickets first.

sortOrder.description: Sorting direction. Valid values: asc, desc. Defaults to desc for chronological ordering. Enables reverse chronological viewing when set to asc for historical review purposes.

product_name.description: Human-readable product name displayed throughout the marketplace for customer identification and catalog organization. seller_business_name.description: Official business name of the selling merchant displayed for customer trust and brand recognition. total_sales_amount.description: Aggregate gross revenue generated by this product across all marketplace transactions including product sales, shipping fees, and promotional adjustments. total_quantity_sold.description: Complete unit count of successful product sales across marketplace orders indicating customer demand volume and inventory turnover velocity. margin_amount.description: Calculated profit margin per unit for comprehensive business analysis including all costs, fees, and operational expenses. created_at.description: Timestamp indicating record creation time supporting audit trail integrity, performance measurement analysis, and historical trend evaluation. IStatisticsTopProducts.ISummary.description:
Top performing products statistics summary providing comprehensive business intelligence metrics for marketplace analytics and strategic decision making.

This summary aggregates critical product performance indicators including sales revenue, unit volume, customer satisfaction metrics, and profitability analysis. The analytics serve as the foundation for top product rankings, performance benchmarking, merchandising optimization, and strategic product placement decisions across competitive marketplace segments.

The summary maintains comprehensive relationships linking products to their sellers, categories, and customer feedback systems while tracking financial performance, market acceptance, and profitability indicators. Used extensively in executive dashboards, seller performance programs, market trend analysis, and strategic planning initiatives to identify successful products while enabling data-driven decisions about product promotion, inventory investment, and marketplace positioning for revenue optimization and competitive advantage development.

IShoppingMallPlatformOverview.description:
Comprehensive platform overview data aggregation for administrative dashboard display.

This schema represents the unified analytics snapshot that provides marketplace administrators with complete visibility into platform performance across all operational dimensions. It consolidates critical business metrics including user acquisition, transaction volumes, revenue figures, seller performance indicators, and system health statistics into a single cohesive dashboard data structure.

The platform overview serves multiple strategic purposes including executive reporting, operational monitoring, trend analysis, and performance benchmarking. Data is aggregated from disparate sources across the marketplace ecosystem including user registration systems, transaction processing engines, inventory management platforms, and analytical monitoring tools to deliver holistic business intelligence.

Administrators rely on this comprehensive overview to make data-driven decisions about marketplace strategy, resource allocation, seller management, and platform optimization initiatives. The data structure supports both real-time monitoring needs and historical comparative analysis to identify growth patterns, performance trends, and operational improvement opportunities.

totalUsers.description: Total count of all registered users across the platform including customers, sellers, and administrators. This metric provides foundational insight into marketplace scale and user base growth trajectory while serving as a key performance indicator for platform adoption and market penetration effectiveness.

totalCustomers.description: Count of active customer accounts who have made at least one purchase or engaged meaningfully with the platform. This metric indicates marketplace viability and customer base health while serving as a foundation for retention analysis and customer lifetime value calculations.

totalSellers.description: Count of verified sellers with active storefronts and product listings on the platform. This metric reflects marketplace diversity and product availability while indicating seller confidence in platform effectiveness for reaching target customers and generating sales.

totalOrders.description: Cumulative count of all orders placed across the marketplace including completed, processing, and cancelled transactions. This metric provides insight into marketplace transaction volume and customer engagement levels while serving as a foundation for revenue analysis and operational capacity planning.

totalRevenue.description: Aggregate gross revenue across all marketplace transactions including product sales, shipping fees, and service charges before tax calculations and platform fee deductions. This represents total platform economic activity including taxable revenue, platform commission earnings, and total cash flow while serving as the primary financial performance indicator for marketplace operations and growth assessment across all active business segments and revenue channels.

averageOrderValue.description: Calculated average monetary value per order across all marketplace transactions. This metric indicates customer spending patterns and marketplace premium positioning while providing insight into pricing strategy effectiveness and customer purchasing behavior trends.

conversionRate.description: Percentage of platform visitors who complete purchase transactions indicating marketplace effectiveness in converting browsing activity into commercial outcomes. This conversion ratio reflects user experience optimization quality, product-market alignment, and overall platform commercial success rates while supporting performance benchmarking against industry standards and competitive positioning analysis within target market segments.

topSellingCategories.description: Ranked array of product categories generating highest sales volumes and revenue contributions. This data enables category-specific strategic planning and helps identify marketplace strengths and growth opportunities while supporting inventory and marketing optimization decisions.

recentOrders.description: Chronological array of recent marketplace orders providing insight into current transaction activity and customer purchasing patterns. This data supports real-time operational monitoring and helps identify emerging trends or issues requiring administrative attention.

sellerPerformance.description: Comprehensive seller ecosystem performance metrics including new registrations, active sellers, average seller ratings, and fulfillment performance indicators. This data enables seller relationship management and marketplace quality assessment while supporting seller development initiatives.

systemHealth.description: Technical infrastructure performance indicators including system availability, response times, error rates, and capacity utilization metrics. This data ensures platform reliability and supports proactive technical maintenance while maintaining optimal user experience standards.

data_refresh_timestamp.description: System timestamp indicating the last time platform overview data was refreshed from source systems. This timestamp enables administrators to understand data currency, verify system operational status, assess analytical system performance, and ensure they are working with current information for critical business decisions. Regular refresh timestamps indicate healthy system integration and reliable data synchronization across marketplace monitoring and reporting platforms.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache time-to-live duration in seconds indicating how long overview data remains valid before requiring refresh from source systems. The TTL setting supports performance optimization by balancing dashboard responsiveness with data accuracy requirements while enabling administrators to understand data refresh schedules and analytical capabilities for strategic planning and operational decision making processes.

ICategoryPerformance.description:
Performance metrics for individual product categories within the marketplace platform.

This data structure captures comprehensive category-level business intelligence including sales performance, product assortment metrics, and revenue contribution analysis. Category performance tracking enables strategic merchandising decisions, inventory optimization, and marketplace positioning strategies based on data-driven insights.

Category analytics support both operational optimization and strategic planning by revealing customer preferences, seasonal trends, and market opportunities. The data enables category-specific marketing campaigns, seller recruitment targeting, and product line expansion decisions based on comprehensive performance evaluation and comparative analysis across the marketplace catalog.

categoryId.description: Unique identifier for the product category within the marketplace taxonomy system. Serves as the primary reference key for category-specific analytics and performance tracking while enabling correlation with product catalog and inventory management systems.

categoryName.description: Human-readable name for the product category providing intuitive identification for administrative reference and report generation. Represents the category label displayed in merchant tools and analytical dashboards while serving as a navigation reference for marketplace browsing experiences.

totalSales.description: Aggregate monetary value of all transactions within this category representing the complete economic contribution of this product segment to marketplace revenue. This metric indicates category commercial success and supports comparative analysis against other categories for strategic planning purposes.

totalOrders.description: Total count of marketplace orders containing products from this category providing insight into customer purchasing frequency and category popularity. This metric supports inventory planning and helps identify categories driving customer acquisition and retention within the marketplace ecosystem.

averageOrderValue.description: Calculated average monetary contribution per order for this specific category indicating customer spending patterns and category-specific purchase behavior. This metric supports pricing strategy development and helps identify categories with premium positioning potential or upselling opportunities.

growthRate.description: Percentage change in category performance over a defined time period indicating growth trajectory and market momentum. This metric supports trend analysis and helps identify emerging opportunities or declining segments requiring strategic intervention or resource reallocation.

IRecentOrder.description:
Recent marketplace order transaction snapshot for administrative monitoring and trend analysis.

This data structure captures essential order information for real-time marketplace monitoring and trend identification purposes. Recent order data provides immediate insight into marketplace activity levels and supports operational decision-making by highlighting current transaction patterns and customer engagement levels.

Administrative teams use recent order information to monitor marketplace health, identify potential issues requiring attention, and assess the effectiveness of promotional campaigns or platform changes. The data structure balances comprehensiveness with performance considerations to enable efficient dashboard loading and trend analysis capabilities.

orderId.description: Unique identifier for the recent marketplace order enabling correlation with detailed order management systems and customer service processes. Serves as the primary reference key for order-specific follow-up and resolution while supporting integration with payment processing and fulfillment systems.

orderNumber.description: Human-readable order identifier for customer reference and customer service communication. Provides meaningful order identification for administrative review and helps correlate recent activity with specific marketplace transactions and customer interactions.

customer.description: Customer summary information providing essential buyer context for administrative review and customer service identification. Includes key customer details needed for marketplace monitoring and trend analysis while maintaining performance through lightweight representation.

totalAmount.description: Monetary value of the recent order indicating transaction size and marketplace revenue contribution. This metric supports immediate assessment of marketplace performance and helps identify unusual transaction patterns or potential issues requiring administrative investigation or customer service intervention.

orderDate.description: Timestamp indicating when the recent order was placed providing chronological context for administrative review and trend analysis. Enables real-time marketplace monitoring and helps identify patterns in customer behavior and transaction timing across different marketplace segments and time periods.

status.description: Current order processing status indicating fulfillment stage and readiness for shipment or delivery. Provides standardized status representation for administrative review and helps identify orders requiring attention or intervention due to processing delays or complications.

ISellerPerformanceOverview.description:
Comprehensive seller ecosystem performance metrics and marketplace quality indicators for administrative oversight and strategic decision making.

This data structure aggregates critical seller-related business intelligence including registration trends, seller activity levels, quality ratings, compliance metrics, and marketplace contribution analysis. Seller performance overview data enables administrative oversight of seller relationship programs and supports strategic decisions about seller recruitment, development, and retention initiatives.

Seller ecosystem health is fundamental to marketplace success, and comprehensive performance tracking ensures optimal merchant experience while maintaining marketplace quality standards. The data structure provides both current state metrics and trend analysis capabilities to support proactive seller relationship management and marketplace quality enhancement programs.

seller.description: Seller summary information providing essential merchant context for administrative review and seller relationship management. Includes verification status, business identification, and account establishment details needed for performance evaluation and marketplace quality assessment while maintaining efficiency through lightweight representation. This reference enables administrative identification of specific sellers within performance analytics workflows.

newSellerRegistrations.description: Count of new seller applications and registrations processed during the specified time period indicating marketplace attractiveness for potential merchants. This metric supports seller acquisition analysis and helps evaluate the effectiveness of seller recruitment programs and marketplace positioning strategies. Registration trends reflect marketplace competitive positioning and business development success in attracting quality merchants to the platform ecosystem.

verifiedSellers.description: Count of sellers who have completed verification processes and meet marketplace business requirements for selling activities. This metric indicates qualified seller population and supports quality assessment of seller onboarding procedures and verification process effectiveness. Verified seller counts reflect marketplace quality standards and regulatory compliance while enabling administrative oversight of merchant qualification programs.

averageSellerRating.description: Composite satisfaction rating calculated from multiple quality dimensions including seller performance, order fulfillment, customer communication, and marketplace compliance. This metric reflects overall seller ecosystem quality and supports comparative analysis with marketplace quality standards and customer expectations. Rating calculations incorporate customer feedback, order success rates, and administrative quality assessments to provide comprehensive merchant performance evaluation.

sellerRetentionRate.description: Percentage of sellers maintaining active marketplace participation over defined time periods indicating seller satisfaction and platform value proposition effectiveness. This metric supports seller relationship management and helps identify factors contributing to seller loyalty and long-term marketplace commitment. Retention analysis enables proactive intervention for at-risk merchants and supports development of seller success programs that enhance marketplace stability and merchant satisfaction.

totalListingCount.description: Aggregate count of active product listings across all marketplace sellers providing insight into catalog diversity and product assortment breadth. This metric indicates marketplace content richness and supports inventory analysis alongside order processing efficiency assessment. Listing counts reflect seller engagement levels and marketplace attractiveness for customer browsing while supporting catalog management and product discovery optimization initiatives.

averageListingsPerSeller.description: Calculated average number of active product listings per seller indicating merchant engagement and marketplace utilization levels. This metric supports seller development programs and helps identify opportunities for seller catalog expansion and inventory optimization initiatives. Average listing analysis enables marketplace administrators to understand merchant behavior patterns and develop targeted support programs that enhance seller success and catalog diversity within the platform ecosystem.

ISystemHealth.description:
Technical infrastructure performance metrics and operational reliability indicators for marketplace platform systems.

This data structure monitors system performance characteristics including availability, response times, error rates, and capacity utilization to ensure optimal platform functionality and user experience quality. Infrastructure health monitoring supports proactive maintenance planning and technical issue identification while maintaining marketplace reliability standards and customer satisfaction objectives.

System health metrics enable technical operations teams to identify performance bottlenecks, plan infrastructure scaling, and ensure platform reliability for optimal commerce operations. The data structure provides both real-time monitoring capabilities and historical trend analysis to support technical planning and capacity management while maintaining service level agreements and operational excellence standards.

availabilityPercentage.description: System uptime percentage calculated against total operational time indicating platform reliability and availability for customer access. High availability percentages support customer trust and marketplace credibility while ensuring continuous commerce operations and customer satisfaction maintenance. This metric reflects infrastructure stability and supports service level agreement compliance while enabling proactive identification of system reliability issues that could impact marketplace functionality and merchant operations.

responseTimeMs.description: Average system response time measured in milliseconds for customer-facing operations indicating platform performance and user experience quality. Lower response times support optimal customer experiences and facilitate efficient marketplace browsing while supporting conversion rate optimization and customer satisfaction goals. Response time monitoring enables identification of performance bottlenecks and supports capacity planning for maintaining optimal user experiences during peak traffic periods and promotional events.

errorRate.description: Percentage of system operations resulting in error conditions indicating system stability and reliability for business-critical functions. Low error rates support marketplace reliability and help maintain customer confidence in platform functionality while enabling effective commerce operations core business requirements. Error rate analysis enables proactive issue identification and supports technical maintenance planning to minimize service disruptions and maintain optimal marketplace performance standards.

capacityUtilization.description: Percentage of available system resources currently utilized for platform operations indicating infrastructure scalability and readiness for continued growth. Appropriate utilization levels ensure system responsiveness while providing capacity for marketplace expansion and traffic increases during peak shopping periods. Capacity monitoring enables proactive scaling decisions and supports infrastructure investment planning while maintaining operational cost efficiency and performance optimization across the marketplace platform ecosystem.

IDateRange.description:

Date range parameters enable analytical flexibility supporting different business analysis requirements including seasonal performance evaluation, comparative period analysis, and trend identification across variable time frames. The structure supports both absolute period definitions and relative time period specifications based on specific operational requirements and strategic analysis needs.

Administrative analytical workflows require precise temporal control to enable accurate performance assessment and comparative business intelligence generation across different historical periods and operational contexts. The parameter format enables standardization while maintaining flexibility for diverse analytical use cases and reporting timeline requirements.

startDate.description: Inclusive start date marking the beginning of the analysis period using ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). endDate.description: Inclusive end date specifying the conclusion of the analysis period using ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). IAnalyticsSorting.description:

This configuration object provides sophisticated sorting capabilities that support data-driven strategic planning and operational oversight across the e-commerce marketplace ecosystem. Administrative teams leverage these parameters to prioritize analytical results based on diverse performance criteria including revenue generation, customer satisfaction metrics, operational efficiency measures, and business growth indicators throughout the multi-seller marketplace environment.

The flexible parameter structure enables targeted analysis of marketplace participant performance while supporting comparative evaluation activities essential for vendor relationship management, growth opportunity identification, and strategic resource allocation decisions. These sorting mechanisms ensure administrative staff can efficiently identify top-performing sellers, assess development opportunities, and optimize marketplace operations through comprehensive data organization and systematic performance ranking methodologies across diverse business scenarios and analytical contexts.

field.description:
Specific performance metric or data attribute to use for analytical result arrangement within the shopping mall marketplace platform. This field supports comprehensive administrative reporting and strategic business intelligence activities across multiple marketplace evaluation dimensions.

Valid sorting options span diverse business metrics including sales-based criteria (sales_volume, revenue_amount, transaction_count), operational performance measures (customer_satisfaction, order_count, fulfillment_rate), growth indicators (growth_rate, customer_base_expansion, search_ranking_improvement), and administrative tracking fields (registration_date, last_activity, account_status_changes). Practical usage involves flexible performance evaluation where administrators might prioritize revenue-based sorting for financial planning activities, select customer satisfaction metrics for quality assurance reviews, or utilize growth-rate indicators for development opportunity identification. These sorting controls ensure administrative teams can systematically evaluate marketplace participant effectiveness while supporting comparative analysis across different business performance categories and operational success measures.

oneOf.description:

Ascending arrangement displays lower-performing or lower-valued data elements first in result sets, enabling systematic review of development opportunities and gradual performance improvement patterns across marketplace participants.

Ascending sort direction is particularly effective for identification activities where administrators need to locate sellers requiring developmental support, discover underperforming segments requiring operational attention, or systematically review gradual improvement patterns across time-based analytical sequences. This display preference supports comprehensive marketplace oversight activities while enabling targeted assistance for marketplace participants needing business development guidance and operational optimization recommendations.

These threshold parameters enable sophisticated performance segmentation ensuring analytical results meet specific operational criteria while supporting strategic planning activities focused on different performance tiers, achievement levels, or marketplace quality segments. Administrative analytical workflows require precise performance control to enable targeted analysis of specific marketplace segments while supporting comparative evaluation across different performance categories and strategic planning initiatives focused on specific marketplace quality, growth, or operational excellence objectives within the multi-vendor e-commerce environment. The parameters support comprehensive business intelligence reporting enabling administrators to efficiently analyze seller performance, identify growth opportunities, and maintain marketplace quality standards through systematic performance-based segmentation and evaluation activities across the complete seller ecosystem.

minimumRevenue.description:

This threshold filters marketplace participant population to include only merchants meeting defined revenue performance standards enabling comprehensive analysis of established market participants while supporting growth identification and top-performer recognition activities across different business scales and commercial categories.

These financial boundaries ensure marketplace operators can efficiently segment merchant populations while maintaining comprehensive oversight across diverse business scale segments through systematic revenue-based performance classification and commercial effectiveness evaluation throughout the multi-seller marketplace environment essential for strategic planning and resource allocation activities.

maximumRevenue.description:

These maximum revenue specifications ensure marketplace operators can systematically evaluate business growth patterns, assess progression opportunities, and maintain comprehensive revenue-distributed oversight across the complete spectrum of marketplace commercial activities while supporting strategic decision-making processes focused on business development and merchant relationship management activities throughout platform operations.
maximumRevenue.description_en_US: Maximum revenue threshold for upper boundary seller analysis

minimumOrderCount.description:

minimumRating.description:

This quality-based filtering enables marketplace performance segmentation and supports systematic reputation-based evaluation alongside comprehensive commercial effectiveness assessment throughout administrative oversight activities within merchant relationship management workflows.

Rating-based administrative filtering ensures marketplace participants included in analytical evaluations maintain established service quality standards while supporting comprehensive vendor relationship management and marketplace oversight activities. These customer satisfaction boundaries facilitate quality-focused analysis activities, enable targeted quality improvement programs, and maintain marketplace reputation management through systematic integration of customer feedback into administrative evaluation processes while supporting strategic decision-making related to vendor relationship development and marketplace quality standard maintenance throughout complex multi-seller operational environments essential for maintaining platform reputation and customer trust.

IShoppingMallGlobalSearchResult.description:
Global search results aggregating information across multiple entities in the shopping mall platform.

Provides comprehensive search functionality spanning customers, sellers, products, categories, and analytics data. Enables users to discover relevant content through a unified search interface regardless of entity type.

Results are organized by entity type with appropriate context and metadata to support informed decision-making during navigation and discovery activities.

categories.description: Product categories matching the search criteria with full hierarchical context and metadata.

products.description: Product items matching the search criteria with essential product information and pricing.

sellers.description: Seller accounts matching the search criteria with business information and verification status.

customers.description: Customer accounts matching the search criteria with profile information and account status.

analytics.description: Analytics data relevant to the search including recent sales metrics and performance indicators.

total_results.description: Total count of all search results across all entity types for pagination and UI display.

IShoppingMallAnalyticsSummary.description:
Aggregated analytics summary providing key performance indicators and recent marketplace activity.

Presents essential business metrics in a consolidated format suitable for dashboard displays and operational oversight. Combines multiple analytics data sources to provide current snapshot views of platform performance.

Used in administrative dashboards, seller analytics interfaces, and high-level performance monitoring throughout marketplace operations.

total_revenue.description: Current total revenue across the platform providing financial performance snapshot for recent period.

total_orders.description: Current order volume providing transaction activity snapshot for operational awareness.

total_customers.description: Active customer count providing user engagement snapshot for platform growth tracking.

total_sellers.description: Active seller count providing merchant ecosystem snapshot for business relationship health.

IShoppingMallSearchAnalytics.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of shopping mall search analytics optimized for dashboard displays and high-volume analytics reporting. Provides essential search performance metrics and success indicators while including contextual customer and session information without the computational overhead of complete relationship traversal.

Contains core search engagement metrics including query text, result counts, performance ratios, and success indicators along with customer context for enhanced analytics interpretation. Enables rapid identification of search performance patterns and customer engagement trends while providing meaningful user context for dashboard analytics and search experience optimization initiatives.

return_rate.description: percentage of orders resulting in returns calculated from analytics data

click_through_rate.description: Search result click-through percentage as engagement metric

top_selling_category.description: product category with highest sales volume based on performance data

session.description: Customer session context providing search session metadata for analytics interpretation and user journey tracking

conversion_rate.description: Search conversion success rate highlighting commercial effectiveness

id.description: Unique identifier for the seller analytics summary

created_at.description: record creation timestamp for analytics snapshot

average_order_value.description: calculated average value per customer order

search_query.description: Core search query text for pattern identification and trend analysis

search_timestamp.description: Search initiation timestamp for chronological plotting and trend visualization

search_location.description: Platform location identifier for contextual analysis

search_successful.description: Binary search success indicator for dashboard status display

search_result_count.description: Total number of search results returned

results_viewed.description: Number of search results user viewed or clicked

total_revenue.description: total gross revenue across all sales in marketplace currency

device_type.description: Device category summary for multi-platform analytics

search_duration_seconds.description: Search session duration in seconds for engagement analysis

search_type.description: Search interface type categorization for dashboard filtering

customer.description: Complete customer entity reference providing user context for search analytics including customer demographics and shopping behavior patterns

seller.description: Complete seller entity reference for analytics attribution including business name and seller details

ISecurityContext.description:
Security context validation including session information and device fingerprinting.

Contains validation data to ensure the MFA setup request originates from a legitimate authenticated session and trusted device context.

This structure provides comprehensive security validation for multi-factor authentication operations, including session verification and device identification. The session ID validates the current authenticated state, device fingerprinting helps detect unusual access patterns, and IP address logging supports audit trail requirements.

session_id.description: Current authenticated session identifier for validation during MFA setup process

ip_address.description: Client IP address for security logging and session validation. Provides IP tracking for security audit trails and geographic analysis during MFA operations.

device_fingerprint.description: Device fingerprint identifier for security validation during MFA setup

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) for session tracking and security context during MFA setup operations. Provides context about the environment where MFA setup was initiated for audit and support purposes.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) for session tracking and security context validation during MFA setup. Helps identify the navigation path that led to MFA setup initiation for security monitoring and user experience optimization.

IQrCodeData.description:
QR code image data as base64 encoded string for easy TOTP setup scanning.

Customers can scan this QR code with their authenticator app to automatically configure the MFA method. The image data represents a PNG format QR code containing the TOTP configuration parameters.

This field provides convenient setup integration for time-based one-time password applications, enabling customers to configure their MFA through simple QR code scanning rather than manual key entry.

items.description: Single-use backup authentication code containing 8 alphanumeric characters

IBackupCodes.description:
Array of backup authentication codes for account recovery when primary MFA method is unavailable.

Each code can be used once for emergency access, providing customers with reliable backup authentication options when their primary MFA method is inaccessible due to device loss, service interruptions, or other technical issues.

The backup codes are randomly generated during MFA setup and should be stored securely by the customer. These codes provide a critical account recovery mechanism that ensures customers can regain system access even when their primary authentication device or method is unavailable.
